title: Systems Architect - TS/SCI w/ Poly required
description:
we are seeking a hands-on systems architect (sme) with deep expertise across infrastructure, platforms, and

application ecosystems spanning cloud and on-premises environments. this role requires a proven practitioner

who can analyze existing (“as-is”) systems and applications, document current state architectures, design future-

state solutions, and implement system enhancements or technology transformations end-to-end.

the ideal candidate is a technical leader and doer, not just an advisor – someone who can seamlessly

collaborate across infrastructure, platform, application, devsecops, information systems security, and data

teams while maintaining ownership of system reliability, performance, scalability, and security.

qualifications

 bachelor’s degree in computer science, it or related technical discipline, or the equivalent combination of

education, technical training, or work/military experience.

 minimum ten (10) years of related experience

required knowledge/skills

candidates must demonstrate hands-on experience in all the following areas:

infrastructure & platforms

 enterprise networking (e.g., routing, switching, firewalls, load balancers, dns)

 storage technologies (e.g., san, nas, object storage)

 container platforms (e.g., kubernetes, docker)

 linux (redhat, centos) operating systems (administration, hardening, automation)

 idam – public key infrastructure (pki) hands-on for authn and authz

engineering & automation

 infrastructure as code – scripting & automation: python, bash, powershell, terraform, ansible, or

cloudformation

 configuration management and scripting (e.g., powershell, bash, python, etc.)

 ci/cd integration with infrastructure and platforms (e.g., jenkins, gitlab ci/cd, github actions, gitops,

argocd)

 security best practices and system hardening

 monitoring & incident response: proficiency with tools like prometheus, grafana, splunk, elk stack,

cloudwatch

architecture & design

 ability to create:

o to-be architecture and detailed engineering designs

o implementation and migration plans

 data analytics, ai/ml platform exposure

title: AI Engineer
description:
**company information**

fríant is a leading manufacturer of innovative, accessible office furniture. operating at the intersection of style and function, we’re passionate about upholding the ethos that quality craftsmanship and practicality aren’t mutually exclusive. from panel systems and seating to desks, storage, and more, our team is busy year-round creating everything needed for a total office solution. with headquarters and manufacturing in san leandro, california and a plant in suffolk, virginia, our 630,000 square feet of facilities are equipped with state-of-the-art equipment and skilled fabric and woodworkers. we craft product that helps teams get things done while feeling good doing it, regardless of industry — because at fríant, all work styles are welcome.

**summary/objective**

the ai engineer designs, develops, deploys, and maintains scalable ai-powered solutions that improve operational efficiency, business intelligence, customer engagement, and process automation across fríant. this hands-on role combines software engineering, machine learning, large language models, ai automation, and enterprise system integration. the position works with business stakeholders, it, customer success, operations, sales, and product teams to translate complex requirements into secure, production-ready ai solutions and supports the full ai lifecycle from architecture and development through deployment, monitoring, governance, and continuous improvement.

**responsibilities**

**ai solution development**

* design, build, and deploy ai and machine learning solutions that address business challenges and improve operational efficiency.
* develop and optimize machine learning and deep learning models for predictive analytics, classification, recommendation systems, and automation.
* build applications using large language models, generative ai, and intelligent agents.
* design retrieval-augmented generation architectures that securely connect enterprise knowledge bases and business systems.

**ai automation and agents**

* develop and manage ai agents that automate workflows, support business operations, and improve employee productivity.
* create intelligent document processing solutions for extracting, classifying, and analyzing structured and unstructured data.
* implement conversational ai solutions, virtual assistants, copilots, and chatbot platforms.
* design workflow automation using ai orchestration platforms, apis, function calling, and tool-use architectures.

**data and integration**

* build and maintain reliable data pipelines for model training, inference, evaluation, and analytics.
* integrate ai solutions with crm, erp, customer support, ecommerce, knowledgebase, and other enterprise applications.
* develop apis, microservices, webhooks, middleware, and event-driven architectures that support ai deployment.
* partner with data engineers, it, and business teams to define practical and scalable ai architecture.

**ai operations and governance**

* monitor model and application performance, reliability, quality, cost, and business impact.
* implement mlops and llmops practices for deployment, version control, automated evaluation, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* apply responsible ai, privacy, security, data governance, and access-control requirements.
* establish guardrails and risk controls for ai applications, and continuously improve accuracy, latency, scalability, and efficiency.
* create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operating procedures, and user guidance.

**competencies**

* strong analytical, critical-thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* ability to translate business challenges and user requirements into practical ai solutions.
* excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder collaboration, and technical documentation skills.
* ability to work independently while contributing effectively across cross-functional teams.
* comfort working in a fast-paced environment where technologies, priorities, and requirements evolve.
* strong commitment to responsible ai, security, privacy, and data governance.

**required education and experience**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, data science, software engineering, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying ai or machine learning solutions in production environments.
* strong proficiency in python and practical experience with sql, git/github, rest apis, and at least one application framework such as fastapi or flask.
* experience with machine learning frameworks such as tensorflow, pytorch, scikit-learn, or hugging face transformers.
* strong understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, neural networks, natural language processing, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
* hands-on experience with enterprise generative ai and llm technologies such as openai apis, azure openai, anthropic apis, langchain, llamaindex, semantic kernel, mcp, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, function calling, ai agents, and rag.
* experience with vector databases or search platforms such as pinecone, weaviate, faiss, chroma, or azure ai search.
* experience with at least one major cloud platform, including microsoft azure, aws, or google cloud platform.
* knowledge of docker, kubernetes, ci/cd pipelines, infrastructure as code, mlflow, model versioning, observability, performance monitoring, or automated evaluation frameworks.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience implementing ai within crm, erp, customer service, ecommerce, or knowledge-management platforms.
* experience with zoho crm, salesforce, hubspot, microsoft dynamics, microsoft 365, teams, sharepoint, or power platform.
* knowledge of ocr, document intelligence, intelligent document processing, analytics, reporting, or forecasting solutions.
* experience supporting customer success, operations, sales, manufacturing, or warehouse-distribution environments.
* experience with javascript or typescript and ai observability or prompt-monitoring platforms.
* relevant azure ai, aws ai/ml, google cloud, or other industry certifications are a plus.

**work environment**

while performing the duties of this job, the employee operates in both a professional office environment and production environment, when necessary. appropriate personal protective equipment will be required when visiting production areas.

**physical demands**

the physical demands described here are representative of those required to perform the essential functions of the position. the employee is regularly required to communicate, use a computer and related equipment, and remain seated or stand for extended periods.

**position type/expected hours of work**

this is a full-time position working on a regular monday-friday schedule, with occasionally early morning, evening or weekend duties. all employees receive support from san leandro. as there is a second plant located in suffolk, va, and as there are employees working remotely from other various u.s. cities, the occasional need may arise for working outside of san leandro hours.

**travel requirements**

travel to our suffolk, va plant/office may be required in rare situations and for periods of a week or less

**supervisory responsibility**

this position has no supervisory responsibilities

\*\*disclaimer: this job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the job. while this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks be performed as assigned.

job type: full-time

pay: $135,000.00 per year

benefits:

* 401(k)
* dental insurance
* employee discount
* flexible spending account
* health insurance
* paid time off
* vision insurance

application question(s):

* will you now or in the future require visa sponsorship?
* are you located in the bay area/california?

title: Software Engineer III - Enterprise Architecture
description:
**software engineer, one data platform**

american express is seeking a highly skilled and experienced software engineer to join the one data platform team within enterprise architecture. this role is a key part of the organization’s technology strategy and supports the design, development, and delivery of scalable platform capabilities that enable engineering teams across the enterprise to build and deploy microservices at scale.

enterprise architecture plays a critical role in shaping the company’s technology direction through four core pillars: architecture as code, architecture as design, governance, and colleague enablement. the one data platform team is focused on building foundational technologies that empower teams across american express to deliver modern, resilient, and high-performing software solutions.

  

* 5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in java and working knowledge of python for backend or data-driven applications.
* deep experience with java ecosystems and frameworks such as spring, spring boot, or equivalent technologies.
* proven experience in full-stack development, including backend services and modern frontend frameworks such as react, angular, or similar.
* strong experience designing and implementing restful apis, microservices, and service-to-service integrations.
* solid understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and performance optimization.
* hands-on experience with relational and/or nosql databases, including postgresql, mysql, oracle, cassandra, dynamodb, or mongodb.
* experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as docker and kubernetes.
* familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as terraform or cloudformation.
* experience with messaging and streaming platforms such as kafka, rabbitmq, or jms.
* practical experience with cloud platforms such as aws, azure, or gcp and cloud-native development patterns.
* hands-on experience in test data generation, unit testing, and test execution.
* experience with api design standards, open api/swagger, versioning, and contract-driven development.
* hands-on experience with ci/cd pipelines and tools such as jenkins, github actions, or gitlab ci.
* proficiency in agile/scrum methodologies and modern software development lifecycle practices.
bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred.  

**preferred qualifications**

* basic understanding of ai/ml concepts and generative ai technologies, including llms, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation (rag).
* strong linux and unix shell proficiency, including shell scripting and troubleshooting.
* experience with nginx, haproxy, envoy, docker, kubernetes, terraform, or similar technologies.
* strong source control skills using git.
* experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as splunk, elastic, datadog, prometheus, or grafana.
* good understanding of jvm internals and the ability to diagnose issues using thread dumps, heap dumps, jfr, visualvm, or similar tools.
* a proactive and collaborative mindset with a strong desire to document technical knowledge and improve team productivity.

  **core competencies**
* systems thinking and the ability to reason about edge cases, failure modes, and operational behavior.
* strong communication and collaboration skills, including asynchronous communication and cross-functional coordination.
* enthusiastic, ownership-driven approach to problem solving and continuous improvement.
* ability to deliver quickly, iterate rapidly, and adapt to changing priorities in a dynamic environment.
    
    
  depending on factors such as as business unit requirements, the nature of the position, cost and applicable laws, american express may provide visa sponsorship for certain positions.

  

at american express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and leadership behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. from delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

as part of team amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of american express.

  

we back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. this means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

* competitive base salaries
* bonus incentives
* 6% company match on retirement savings plan
* free financial coaching and financial well-being support
* comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits
* flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need

you will work closely with machine learning engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders to build scalable data pipelines, ci/cd workflows, and etl processes.

the ideal candidate will have experience in retail, personalization web technologies, and cutting-edge ai methods, including large language models (llms), agentic ai, and knowledge graphs.

**key responsibilities**

### **machine learning & ai development**

* develop and optimize predictive and prescriptive models to extract insights and enhance decision-making. knowledgeable in supervised and unsupervised learning.

* utilize mlops to efficiently deploy, monitor, and maintain ml models in production.

### **agentic ai capabilities**

* design, build and deploy reliable ai agents capable of planning, reasoning, using tools, maintaining context and completing multi-step business workflows.

* strong understanding of information retrieval concepts and search relevance, including indexing, tokenization, query understanding, lexical, vector and hybrid search, embeddings, reranking, relevance tuning, and evaluation metrics such as precision@k, recall@k, ndcg and mrr.
* experience with agent state, memory, event-driven workflows, queues, retries, timeouts, idempotency and long-running or resumable processes.
* familiarity with llm evaluation and observability tools such as langsmith, opentelemetry, phoenix, arize, weights & biases or equivalent platforms.

**in this role you will:**

* develop enterprise-wide and scalable cloud-based mlops, llmops capabilities that span the full life cycle of machine learning, deep learning and generative ai models
* develop reusable, secure, and robust ai and ml pipelines, monitor model performance, monitor data drift, utilize insights to train models, enable automatic audit trails, llm traces creation for all artifacts, deploy across a wide range of business applications, and sustain a high level of automation across all ai/ml lifecycle activities. this includes developing code and making sure that ai/ml models are production ready

* ability to program in python and sql
* experience with cloud deployment and runtime operations using docker and azure kubernetes service (aks); familiarity with gitops and environment promotion patterns is a plus
* experience building/hosting ml and genai services using azure app services and/or aks (apis, asynchronous workers, scheduled jobs), with attention to reliability and production readiness
* familiarity with the azure ai ecosystem, including azure ai foundry, ai services, azure ml, and enterprise governance for model access, secrets, and data protection
* strong applied ml understanding (e.g., regression, tree-based methods, neural networks, nlp) and the ability to translate business problems into measurable metrics and experiments
* experience with bi/analytics tools (especially power bi) and awareness of data and analytics platforms such as azure databricks
* rapid prototyping and experimentation using low-code/no-code genai tools (e.g., microsoft copilot studio) to quickly validate use cases, iterate on conversational flows, and transition successful prototypes into production-grade implementations
* experience accelerating daily workflows with genai coding assistants (e.g., databricks genie, github copilot) while maintaining engineering rigor through code review, testing, security controls, and ci/cd
* strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts to senior stakeholders and connect technical delivery to measurable business and financial outcomes
* proven ability to manage multiple workstreams in a time-sensitive environment and collaborate to solve problems creatively
* experience/certification in azure, azure ai, ml, databricks, or equivalent such as aws and gcp, mlops, data architecture, container orchestration, streaming, h2o, spark, and linux
* knowledge of transactional, analytical databases and data analysis techniques for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data modeling and analysis (rdbms, columnar data-parquet, json, etc.)
* broad knowledge of networking concepts including tcp/ip, subnetting, routing, dhcp, and others is desirable
understanding of cybersecurity principles

build and ship production-ready ml and data applications that turn complex scientific and enterprise data into real-world impact, from model training to cloud and edge deployment.

* strong python skills plus working knowledge of java, javascript and c/c++.
* practical experience with pytorch, tensorflow, scikit-learn, opencv and pandas.
* familiarity with docker, git/github, linux and aws cloud services.
* experience with nosql or graph databases (mongodb, neo4j) and search tools like elasticsearch.
* an understanding of reinforcement learning, nlp, or model tuning and optimization.
* experience working in agile teams, with solid version-control habits.
* strong communication skills, including writing technical reports and presenting at conferences.
* curiosity and a research mindset. a publication record or exposure to life sciences or pharma is a plus.

=================

at newpage, we’re building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. we offer:

* a people-first culture - supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging
* smart, purposeful collaboration - work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges
* balance that lasts - we respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life
* room to grow - opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you
* meaningful rewards - competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential

let’s build the future of health together. apply below or reach out to:

*bhavik.rathod@newpage.io*

newpage is a digital health solutions company. we devote ourselves to advancing the quality of life by enhancing health and optimizing the longevity of people. we do this by, passionately building futuristic technologies for global organizations across the healthcare ecosystem. we partake at every stage from problem definition, strategy & service design, user research, ux design, and agile software development – utilizing lean practices to deliver and validate highly innovative digital health solutions that drive user value and business transformation.

newpage is recognized by ‘cio’s review’ as “top 50 promising healthcare solution providers” and great place to work certified (gptw) 2023 & 2024.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
### **ai/ml engineer – generative ai platforms (remote)**

### **about cognizant**

cognizant is one of the world's leading professional services companies, helping clients modernize technology, reimagine processes, and transform experiences. we engineer modern businesses to improve everyday life. our associates around the globe help clients build stronger, more agile, and innovative organizations.

our ai and digital engineering practice helps clients unlock value through artificial intelligence, machine learning, intelligent automation, cloud transformation, and data modernization. we partner with global enterprises to build scalable ai-powered solutions that accelerate innovation, improve productivity, and drive business outcomes.

### **role overview**

cognizant is seeking an experienced **ai/ml engineer – generative ai platforms** to join our growing ai engineering team.

this is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, developing, deploying, and supporting ai-powered document processing and ai authoring platforms. the ideal candidate will have deep experience building enterprise generative ai solutions leveraging large language models (llms), retrieval-augmented generation (rag), intelligent document processing (idp), semantic search, and cloud-native ai architectures.

you will collaborate with solution architects, product owners, data engineers, and software engineering teams to develop innovative ai solutions that deliver scalable, secure, and production-ready business capabilities.

### **work model**

this position is **fully remote within the united states**, providing the flexibility to work from home while collaborating with global teams across multiple locations and time zones.

occasional travel may be required for client meetings, planning sessions, team collaboration events, and strategic initiatives.

### **key responsibilities**

### **generative ai solution development**

* design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade generative ai solutions using large language models (llms).
* build intelligent document processing and ai-assisted authoring capabilities supporting complex business workflows.
* develop and optimize retrieval-augmented generation (rag) architectures to enhance response quality and contextual relevance.
* implement prompt engineering strategies to improve ai performance, accuracy, and reliability.
* collaborate with product and business teams to translate business requirements into scalable ai solutions.

### **document intelligence & ai authoring**

* develop capabilities for:
  + document extraction
  + document classification
  + data validation
  + knowledge retrieval
  + ai-assisted content generation
* design workflows that automate document understanding and content creation processes.
* build validation frameworks that improve accuracy, traceability, and confidence in ai-generated outputs.
* support end-to-end lifecycle management of ai-powered document solutions.

### **rag, semantic search & knowledge retrieval**

* design and optimize embedding strategies for enterprise data and document repositories.
* implement vector search and semantic retrieval solutions to improve knowledge discovery.
* develop grounding mechanisms that ensure ai responses are accurate, contextual, and explainable.
* build and maintain retrieval pipelines that support high-performance search and content generation capabilities.
* evaluate and enhance retrieval effectiveness using modern ai evaluation methodologies.

### **api & microservices development**

* design and develop apis and microservices using python and fastapi.
* build scalable and reusable backend services supporting ai applications and integrations.
* develop secure api-based connections between ai platforms, enterprise systems, and third-party applications.
* support microservice deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and optimization activities.

### **aws cloud & ai platform engineering**

* build and support cloud-native ai solutions leveraging aws services.
* develop and maintain solutions utilizing:
  + aws bedrock
  + aws lambda
  + amazon s3
  + amazon rds
  + related aws services
* implement scalable, secure, and highly available cloud architectures for ai workloads.
* collaborate with cloud and platform engineering teams to optimize performance and cost efficiency.

### **testing, quality & operational excellence**

* create and execute:
  + functional tests
  + integration tests
  + ai quality validation tests
  + performance tests
* support ai model evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* troubleshoot production issues and implement long-term solutions.
* contribute to quality engineering processes and automated testing frameworks.

### **security, governance & responsible ai**

* ensure solutions comply with enterprise security standards and governance requirements.
* implement responsible ai practices that support explainability, transparency, and risk management.
* adhere to data privacy, compliance, and information security requirements.
* support auditability, monitoring, and governance controls within ai platforms.

### **required qualifications**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* strong hands-on experience developing enterprise ai/ml solutions.
* expertise in:
  + python
  + fastapi
  + rest apis
* experience with:
  + large language models (llms)
  + generative ai
  + prompt engineering
  + retrieval-augmented generation (rag)
* strong understanding of:
  + embeddings
  + vector databases
  + semantic search
  + knowledge retrieval
* hands-on experience with:
  + aws bedrock
  + aws lambda
  + amazon s3
  + amazon rds
* experience with:
  + postgresql
  + git
  + docker
  + ci/cd pipelines
* strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* excellent communication and collaboration skills.

### **preferred qualifications**

* experience building enterprise generative ai applications.
* experience with intelligent document processing (idp) platforms and solutions.
* expertise in:
  + semantic search
  + knowledge retrieval systems
  + ai authoring applications
* experience with:
  + langchain
  + langgraph
* knowledge of:
  + ai evaluation frameworks
  + model monitoring
  + ai governance
* experience working within life sciences, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated industries.
* familiarity with cloud-native architecture patterns and microservices frameworks.

### **technical expertise**

candidates should demonstrate experience in:

* generative ai
* large language models (llms)
* prompt engineering
* retrieval-augmented generation (rag)
* intelligent document processing (idp)
* semantic search
* knowledge retrieval
* vector databases
* pgvector
* python development
* fastapi
* rest api design
* aws bedrock
* aws lambda
* amazon s3
* amazon rds
* postgresql
* docker
* git
* ci/cd
* langchain
* langgraph
* responsible ai

### **salary and other compensation**

the annual salary for this position is anticipated to be between **$120,000 and $145,000**, depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, skills, and other factors permitted by law.

in addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for:

* annual performance-based bonus
* merit-based compensation increases
* employee referral bonuses, where applicable

the compensation information provided is accurate as of the date of this posting. cognizant reserves the right to modify compensation information based on business needs and applicable laws.

### **benefits**

cognizant offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* medical, dental, and vision coverage
* prescription drug coverage
* life and disability insurance
* employee assistance program (eap)
* paid vacation and company holidays
* retirement savings programs (subject to eligibility)
* parental and family support benefits
* employee wellness programs
* tuition reimbursement and professional development opportunities
* access to training, certifications, and career development programs

benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and applicable provincial regulations.

### **why cognizant**

* help shape the future of enterprise ai and generative ai solutions.
* develop cutting-edge ai-powered document processing and authoring platforms.
* work with leading cloud, ai, and data technologies.
* collaborate with experienced architects, engineers, and data scientists across global teams.
* gain exposure to large-scale enterprise ai transformation initiatives.
* access ongoing learning, certification, and career advancement opportunities.

### **equal opportunity employer**

cognizant is an equal opportunity employer. we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives. all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

**applications will be accepted until the position is filled.**

title: Software Engineer
description:
surescripts serves the nation through simpler, trusted health intelligence sharing, in order to increase patient safety, lower costs and ensure quality care . we deliver insights at critical points of care for better decisions — from streamlining prior authorizations to delivering comprehensive medication histories to facilitating messages between providers.

**job summary**
===============

  

design, develop, assess, and troubleshoot software applications in an agile environment for the one of the nation's largest and most trusted healthcare information network. collaborate with architects, customers, product partners, and other engineers to solve complex engineering challenges by building high-volume applications that process millions of transactions a day, store multiple terabytes of data, and serve hundreds of thousands of customers.

software engineers are expected to use approved ai tools to improve speed, quality, and outcomes while remaining fully accountable for results.

  

**responsibilities**
====================

* develop and troubleshoot software applications in an agile environment, collaborating with others to produce high quality working tested software.
* contribute throughout the software development life cycle by estimating work, refining requirements, iterating on designs, delivering working software, communicating with partner teams, and supporting critical applications.
* lead or participate in design and code reviews; create and maintain automated tests; validate acceptance criteria; and monitor production systems to identify defects, incidents, and opportunities for improvement.
* apply shift-left quality practices to shorten feedback loops, reduce rework, prevent recurring defects, and ensure software is secure, reliable, observable, maintainable, and production-ready.
* cultivate and share application development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, security, data privacy, and agile best practices.
* use approved ai-assisted development tools across design, implementation, testing, debugging, analysis, and documentation; review all output and remain accountable for delivered software’s correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
continuously improve ai-assisted workflows based on measurable impact to delivery speed, quality, operations, and customer outcomes.  

  

**qualifications**
==================

**basic requirements:**
-----------------------

* bachelor’s degree in software engineering, computer science, a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 2+ years of experience in related, progressive software engineering roles.
* experience with multiple programming languages, such as c#, java, groovy, scala, python, typescript, or javascript.
* experience with current tools and platforms for developing, building, testing, deploying, and monitoring software systems.
* experience using modern ai-assisted software development tools to support coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and software delivery workflows.
demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively, communicate clearly, learn continuously, and ask for help or escalate issues when appropriate.  

  

**preferred qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* experience with high-volume, data-intensive applications.
* experience building web services and distributed systems.
* hands-on software troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and production support experience.
* familiarity with relational and non-relational database technologies.
* knowledge of application security, observability, data privacy, and responsible software delivery practices.
* healthcare technology industry experience.
* understanding of ai governance, security, privacy, compliance, quality, and responsible-use practices for software systems.
experience effectively leveraging generative ai tools, such as github copilot, claude, gemini, chatgpt, or similar tools, throughout the software development life cycle.  

  

**some of the technologies we use:**

* **languages:** c#, java, groovy, scala, python, typescript, javascript

title: Full-Stack Senior Developers
description:
natoli engineering is hiring two senior full-stack developers to design, build and run our software portfolio. for more than 50 years, natoli has made tablet compression tooling, tablet presses and related equipment for manufacturers worldwide from its headquarters in st. charles, missouri. our software includes instrumentation and control software for our presses, tooling management and inspection tools, customer portals such as tabletcad and our online store, internal business systems, and natoli.com.

this is a hands-on, senior individual-contributor role. you will write production code most days and take work from first conversation with a stakeholder through requirements, design, testing, deployment and support. the two developers share ownership of the portfolio and report to the head of it; neither role leads or manages a team.

ai is central to how we will build software. we want developers who already use ai coding assistants and agents every day, know how to build ai into development tools and practices, and know where ai output needs a careful human check. you should also have shipped and maintained real enterprise software, care about quality and documentation, and explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical people.

**key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **portfolio ownership and technical direction**

* share ownership of natoli's software portfolio with the other senior developer: software sold with our equipment, customer portals, internal business systems and natoli.com. divide the work and back each other up.
* shape the technical roadmap and architecture for each application, and agree priorities with the head of it: new features, customer commitments, security fixes and technical debt.
* help set and follow engineering standards: coding conventions, branching strategy, code review and definition of done.
* review code from peers and contractors, and pair on the hardest problems.
* recommend build-vs-buy decisions and evaluate frameworks, libraries, vendors and tools.

### **ai-enabled development**

* use ai coding assistants and agents [such as claude code, github copilot or cursor] every day across the sdlc: design, coding, refactoring, testing, code review and documentation.
* review, test and take responsibility for every line of ai-generated code before it ships.
* build ai into natoli's development tools and practices: ai-assisted pull request review, test generation inside a tdd workflow, documentation generation, and ai steps in ci/cd pipelines.
* maintain the shared context that makes ai tools effective here: repository instruction files, prompt libraries, coding conventions, and connectors (such as mcp servers) to internal systems and documentation.
* work with the head of it on ai guardrails: approved tools, what code and data may go to which ai service, security review of ai output, and licensing and ip.
* add ai features to natoli products and internal apps where they earn their place, such as search and assistants over technical documentation, using llm apis, retrieval and evaluation.
* measure the effect of ai on cycle time, defect rates and review effort, and evaluate new models and tools as they appear.
* share what works with colleagues across it through demos, short guides and pairing.

### **requirements and sdlc**

* gather requirements from customers, sales, support and internal users, and turn them into user stories, acceptance criteria and technical specs.
* own the full sdlc: discovery, design, build, test, release, maintenance and retirement.
* work in an agile cadence (scrum or kanban as each product needs) and help run backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives.
* estimate effort, track delivery and report status, risks and trade-offs to the head of it.
* plan releases and versioning for customer-facing products, including release notes and upgrade paths.

### **architecture, data and performance**

* design secure, scalable, maintainable systems: front ends, apis, services and integrations with third-party systems (erp, crm, payments, identity).
* design relational schemas: normalization, keys and constraints, indexing, and safe, versioned migrations.
* choose the right data store for each job (relational, document, key-value, search) and tune queries for performance.
* design caching at every layer (cdn, http, application, distributed caches such as redis), including invalidation strategy.
* design multi-tenant patterns for saas products, including tenant data isolation.

### **quality and testing**

* practice and champion test-driven development (tdd).
* maintain a layered automated test suite: unit, integration, contract and end-to-end tests.
* build quality gates into the pipeline: test coverage, static analysis, linting and dependency and security scanning.
* triage production incidents, find root causes and write blameless post-incident reviews.

### **ci/cd, cloud and operations**

* build and maintain ci/cd pipelines that take every change from commit to production safely and repeatably.
* manage environments (dev, test, staging, production) with infrastructure as code, containers, feature flags and fast rollback.
* set up monitoring, logging and alerting, and define uptime and performance targets for each application.
* own application security: owasp top 10, secrets management, patching, access control, and support for customer and regulatory audits.

### **documentation**

* write and maintain architecture diagrams, architecture decision records (adrs), api docs (openapi), data dictionaries and runbooks.
* keep onboarding guides current so a new developer can ship code in their first week.
* work with support and marketing on customer-facing technical documentation.

### **company website**

* own the natoli.com platform, hosting, performance, security and uptime.
* keep it accessible (wcag 2.2 aa), fast (core web vitals), and technically sound for seo and analytics.
* partner with marketing on new pages, forms, campaigns and integrations (crm, marketing automation).

**required qualifications**
---------------------------

replace the bracketed technologies with your actual stack; keep the rest as written.

* bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 7+ years of professional software development, including 3+ years at a senior level owning the design and delivery of production systems.
* a track record of shipping and supporting enterprise applications in production, ideally several products at once.
* expert, daily use of ai coding assistants and agents [claude code, github copilot, cursor or similar] in professional work, with concrete examples of faster delivery or higher quality.
* hands-on experience integrating ai into developer tools and workflows: repository instruction files, prompt libraries, and ai steps in pull requests and ci/cd.
* experience building with llm apis [anthropic, openai, azure openai]: prompt design, structured output, tool use, retrieval and evaluation.
* sound judgment about ai risks: incorrect or insecure generated code, prompt injection, data leakage, and licensing and ip.
* strong front-end skills with a modern framework [react / angular / vue] and typescript, and strong back-end skills in at least one of [c#/.net, java/spring, node.js, python], including rest api design.
* expert relational database design in [sql server / postgresql / mysql] (schema design, normalization, indexing, query plans and migrations), plus working knowledge of a non-relational store.
* hands-on caching experience with [redis or similar], cdns and http caching, including invalidation strategy.
* daily practice of tdd and automated testing with tools such as [xunit/nunit, junit, jest, playwright or cypress].
* built and maintained ci/cd pipelines in [github actions / azure devops / gitlab ci / jenkins], and deployed to [aws / azure] with docker and infrastructure as code.
* several years in agile teams (scrum or kanban), including requirements gathering: running stakeholder sessions and writing user stories, acceptance criteria and specs.
* clear technical writing (architecture docs, api docs, runbooks) and clear communication with non-technical colleagues and customers.
* solid application security fundamentals: owasp top 10, oauth 2.0 / openid connect, secrets management.

**preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* software for fda-regulated manufacturing: 21 cfr part 11 (electronic records and signatures), gamp 5 and computer system validation.
* integration with manufacturing equipment and instrument data, for example opc ua, plc data or machine data acquisition.
* commercial software sold to customers: licensing, customer portals, e-commerce, backward compatibility and support escalations.
* custom ai tooling: mcp servers, agent workflows, ai code-review bots or internal developer assistants.
* search and retrieval over technical content: embeddings, vector databases and hybrid search.
* cloud certification such as aws certified solutions architect or microsoft azure solutions architect expert.
* event-driven systems using message queues or streams such as [rabbitmq, kafka, azure service bus, amazon sqs].
* kubernetes or another container orchestration platform.
* observability platforms such as [datadog, new relic, azure application insights, grafana].
* website platforms such as [wordpress, a headless cms, or a static-site framework], plus technical seo.
* background in manufacturing, industrial equipment or pharmaceutical technology.

post both openings at **$135,000–$165,000 base plus a 5–10% target bonus**. that prices a senior st. louis developer with broad product scope and proven ai skills, without a team-lead premium.

title: Senior Health Data Modeler
description:
for over twenty-seven years rcr technology corporation has delivered the highest quality services to our clients with an expansive portfolio of industry-relevant services, and deep technical capabilities around data management and application development.

  

we are seeking a hands-on senior health data modeler to support the illinois enterprise data warehouse (edw) within the enterprise data warehouse & analytics group. the data modeler will work with large healthcare datasets and translate the client’s business requirements into enterprise systems, applications, and process designs for large, complex health data solutions.

this role owns the design, governance, and evolution of the conceptual, logical, and physical data models that underpin the edw platform and its modernization initiatives. it drives and supports initiatives for the il edw while participating in the wider edw group’s focus areas — data usage and governance, information management, privacy and security, data analytics and visualization, and information modeling — bridging the current-state teradata edw to the future-state cloud (azure / snowflake) architecture.

working closely with data architects, etl/data engineers, bi developers, dbas, and business subject matter experts, the senior health data modeler ensures data structures are scalable, standards-compliant, well-documented, and aligned to enterprise and regulatory requirements across the health and human services ecosystem.

roles & responsibilities

data architecture & strategy

* develop and deliver long-term strategic goals for data architecture vision and standards in conjunction with data users, clients, and other key stakeholders.

* lead data architecture, data modeling, and data movement initiatives to enhance the data warehouse supporting analytics for medicaid, medicare, and commercial healthcare data — including domains such as claims, provider, tpl, and member information subject areas.

* create an end-to-end vision for how logical design translates into one or more physical databases and how data flows through successive stages.

* document data architecture and the enterprise environment to maintain a current, accurate view that supports a single version of the truth and scales to future analytical needs.

data modeling & design

* analyze and translate business needs into long-term solution data models; evaluate existing data systems and work with the development team to create conceptual data models and data flows.

* design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models across staging, integration, and semantic/presentation layers.

* develop dimensional models (kimball star/snowflake), normalized (oltp/3nf), olap, and data vault patterns; implement slowly changing dimensions, role-playing dimensions, dimensional hierarchies, surrogate keys, and data classification.

* define primary/foreign keys, indexes, partitioning, constraints, and referential integrity rules to ensure data quality and performance.

* produce and maintain entity-relationship diagrams (erds), data flow diagrams, and model documentation using erwin or equivalent tools.

governance, quality & compliance

* ensure data strategies and architectures are in regulatory compliance; identify where existing policies and procedures require change or where new ones are needed.

* oversee the mapping of data sources, data movement, interfaces, and analytics with the goal of ensuring data quality.

* create and maintain data model and metadata policies and procedures for functional design; maintain data dictionaries, business glossaries, and lineage documentation.

* support classification and protection of sensitive data (pii, phi) in alignment with hipaa, phi, and sox requirements.

collaboration & delivery

* provide technical recommendations and engage with etl architects, business smes, and other stakeholders throughout the solution/data architecture and implementation lifecycle to develop high-performance, highly scalable data solutions (data marts/warehouse, data mining, and advanced analytics).

* address data-related problems regarding systems integration, compatibility, and multiple-platform integration.

* develop and implement key components and testing criteria to guarantee the fidelity and performance of data architecture.

* communicate with the customer and project team in a timely manner and escalate issues and risks appropriately.

modernization & migration support

* contribute to migration of legacy teradata models to modern cloud platforms (azure synapse / databricks lakehouse, snowflake).

* design target-state models leveraging medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture, delta lake, and parquet patterns.

* assess existing models for modernization opportunities, redundancy, and optimization; recommend improvements to architects.

qualifications:

education

* bs or ms in computer science, business information systems, engineering, or a related field.

* 10 or more years of it experience.

required skills:

* strong problem-solving, influencing, communication, and presentation skills; self-starter.

* 7+ years of experience in data modeling, data strategy, and roadmap for large and complex health entities and systems; implemented large-scale, end-to-end data management & analytics solutions for more than one large client.

* 5+ years of strong knowledge of regulatory security requirements regarding hipaa, phi, pii, and other healthcare data security standards.

* 5+ years of experience with erwin data model (or comparable tools such as er/studio, sql developer data modeler).

* 5+ years of strong healthcare domain knowledge of medicaid, medicare, and commercial healthcare data sets.

* expertise with normalized oltp, olap, mdm, and dimensional modeling techniques — star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, role-playing dimensions, dimensional hierarchies, and data classification.

* 5+ years of expert-level sql skills with direct experience writing complex analytic queries, stored procedures, ddl, dml, and dcl; thorough knowledge of query optimization and the ability to write to ansi standards and review others’ code.

* 5+ years of experience in data quality, data profiling, data governance, data security, metadata management, mdm, data archival, and data migration strategies using appropriate tools.

* demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, changing environment with short deadlines, interruptions, and multiple concurrent tasks/projects.

* ability to work independently with strong planning, strategy, estimation, and scheduling skills.

preferred skills

* experience with microsoft azure cloud infrastructure and services (azure data lake storage, azure data factory, purview, azure maps, etc.).

* experience with snowflake dbms, including object design and performance tuning.

* experience with power bi or tableau.

* experience supporting state medicaid edw, mmis, or federal reporting programs (t-msis, perm, mars, quality of care).

* exposure to teradata vantage 20 and modernization of teradata workloads onto cloud platforms.

* familiarity with delta lake / lakehouse architecture and microsoft fabric.

* exposure to ai/ml and genai tools (e.g., github copilot, microsoft 365 copilot, snowflake cortex) for accelerating modeling, documentation, and metadata enrichment.

* hands-on experience with etl tools (e.g., informatica, azure data factory).

* hands-on experience with bi tools and reporting software.

* experience with a scripting language used for analytics such as python or r.

title: DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer
description:
* **geo**: europe — remote, eu hours with us overlap
* **position**: full-time
* **experience**: 5+ years in devops / infrastructure / sre, 7+ preferred
* **flexible location**: remote; hybrid or in office depending on the city
* **corporate language**: english
* **hours**: eu hours with us overlap. the role includes substantial on-call responsibility within a small team.

### **why this role exists**

scientists spend a staggering amount of time wrangling data instead of running experiments. we build the ai-native platform that changes that: the system of record and the intelligence layer for r&d labs formulating everything from next-gen batteries to sustainable materials to alternative proteins. our software doesn't just store lab data, it designs experiments, recommends formulations, surfaces insights, and automates the busywork that stands between a researcher and their next discovery.

alchemy is a multi-tenant enterprise eln, lims, plm and qc platform used by applied science companies in chemicals, materials and aerospace as well as all cpg categories. our platform runs on aws across multiple regions, including regulated environments. core technologies include terraform, ecs/fargate and aurora mysql.

you’ll help operate and modernize an established cloud platform, expanding terraform coverage while maintaining existing cloudformation infrastructure. the role combines ongoing production operations with improvements to reliability, automation, security and cost efficiency.

  

### **what you'll do**

you’ll take end-to-end responsibility for infrastructure operations and improvement:

* infrastructure as code. expand and maintain terraform coverage, safely bring existing resources under code management, diagnose configuration drift and maintain cloudformation infrastructure as it is progressively modernized.
* deployment and release pipelines. own and improve github actions and jenkins pipelines, environment automation and regular releases across our cloud environments.
* production reliability. monitor and troubleshoot application infrastructure, databases, containers and networking. handle incidents, improve observability and take substantial on-call responsibility as part of a small team.
* cloud cost optimization. improve cloud efficiency through right-sizing, capacity planning, resource lifecycle management and cost visibility.
* customer-hosted deployments. support deployments into customer-managed aws environments and produce clear technical documentation for customer infrastructure and security teams.
* security and compliance. remediate infrastructure and dependency vulnerabilities, strengthen platform security and support audit evidence and compliance requirements.
* internal tooling. build and improve tools for environment management, deployments and operational visibility. java or vue expertise is not required, but practical automation and tool-building skills are essential.

### **who you are**

#### **must have**

* **terraform** — modules, state, multi-environment and multi-region layout, and specifically import, state mv/rm, targeted applies, and diagnosing drift on infrastructure you did not create.
* **aws depth, not breadth** — vpc and networking (peering, nat, security groups, nacls), iam, ecs/fargate, aurora mysql including serverless v2, alb/nlb, s3, secrets manager and ssm, cloudwatch, lambda, batch.
* **cloudformation you can author and deploy, not only read** — legacy templates are still load-bearing here and will be for a while.
* **ci/cd ownership** — github actions and jenkins, building and maintaining pipelines rather than consuming them.
* **bash and python** for automation, tooling and operational glue.
* **aurora mysql operations** — sizing and scaling, snapshots, clones and restores, failover, connection and pool behaviour, and reading a slow query. the application's schema is not yours to own.
* **incident discipline** — scope by time window, form a hypothesis, prepare a rollback before you touch anything, write up what happened.
* **cost awareness** as an engineering skill, not a finance report.
* **ai-assisted engineering -** practical experience using coding agents, writing clear guidance for them and building automated checks around their output. sound engineering judgment and human review of production changes are essential.
* **clear written english** and the habit of documenting so someone else can operate it.

#### **strongly preferred**

* multi-region operations (eu + us) and data-residency awareness.
* experience with aws govcloud or other regulated cloud environments, including controlled access and operational requirements.
* deploying a product into a customer's own cloud account, and writing the documents their security review consumes.
* pr-based infrastructure change and review culture — plan output read as evidence, not as a formality.
* sso/oidc, cloudfront behaviour and debugging.
* vulnerability patching at image and dependency level (ecr, trivy, scout, dependabot or equivalents).
* iso 27001 / soc 2 exposure from the engineering side.

#### **nice to have**

* aws certifications (solutions architect, devops engineer professional).
* azure or gcp exposure.
* java / spring boot familiarity, enough to read the application and reason about deployment behaviour.
* waf and edge security, eks/kubernetes, datadog or grafana-stack experience are signals of range, not requirements.

#### **how you work**

* you automate repetitive work and maintain clear operational documentation
* you are comfortable improving established systems while keeping them running reliably
* you treat infrastructure as code as an ongoing engineering responsibility
* you take ownership of operational problems across infrastructure and application behaviour
* you balance planned improvements with internal engineering support. around half of the team’s incoming work involves helping other teams resolve blockers
* you document decisions and procedures so others can operate the systems you maintain

### **your impact**

you’ll help shape how we operate and improve the infrastructure behind an enterprise platform. your work will improve deployment reliability, cloud efficiency, security and the day-to-day experience of our engineering teams.

this is a hands-on role in a small team, with broad ownership across an established platform. you’ll balance infrastructure modernization with production operations, on-call responsibilities and substantial internal engineering support.

description:
agentic ai cloud development engineerthis role has been designed as 'hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an hpe office.

**who we are:**

hewlett packard enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. we help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. we know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. we have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. we make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. if you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. open up opportunities with hpe.

**job description:**

agentic ai cloud development engineer builds and operationalizes the core **agentic workflows that power marvis, juniper's next-generation ai assistant for network operations**. working at the intersection of data science, generative ai, and production engineering, this role is responsible for designing, implementing, and evaluating the reasoning pipelines, tool-calling patterns, skills, and mcp server integrations that enable marvis to autonomously diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex networking problems. the ideal candidate combines practical experience with llm-based agentic frameworks (langgraph preferred) with the software engineering discipline needed to deliver reliable, observable ai systems in a cloud-native environment

***management level definition:***

contributions impact technical components of products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainably. applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business and technical problems and is regarded as a subject matter expert in agentic ai and applied genai. provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. may lead projects and mentor colleagues.

***responsibilities:***

* design, implement, and iterate on agentic workflows using langgraph.
* develop and maintain mcp (model context protocol) servers and skills — defining tool schemas, implementing domain-specific tools, writing skill playbooks (skill.md), and managing server lifecycle (versioning, deployment, monitoring).
* application design and development in streaming or batch mode over kafka and spark
* integrate and optimize llm capabilities at production scale, including structured outputs, streaming, function/tool calling, prompt engineering, and robust error handling across agent execution paths.
* collaborate with domain experts (network engineers, product managers) to formalize networking problems as agentic workflows, translating troubleshooting playbooks into skills, tools, and data pipelines.
* develop data analysis and transformation logic that runs in sandboxed execution environments (code mode), including multi-tool orchestration scripts, data aggregation, and visualization.
* deploy and operate containerized services in kubernetes, contributing to ci/cd pipelines, container image management, health probes, and resource optimization.
* own observability for agentic workflows — implementing tracing, logging, cost tracking, and performance monitoring to ensure reliability of non-deterministic systems in production.

***education and experience required:***

* bachelor’s, master's in computer science degree.
* typically, 2-4 years of experience building production ml/ai systems, with at least a year of hands-on work with generative ai and llm-based applications

***knowledge and skills:***

*data engineering (required):*

* proficient python developer with experience in production codebases (not just notebooks).
* backend service development: fastapi or equivalent; rest/graphql api design.
* expertise in big data technologies such as apache spark, kafka with at least 2 year of relevant experience

*agentic ai & genai (required):*

* experience with agentic orchestration frameworks: langgraph (strongly preferred), langchain, claude agent sdk, or equivalent — beyond prototypes.
* hands-on experience with mcp (model context protocol) or equivalent tool-serving protocols: tool schema design, server implementation, registry management.

*infrastructure & production systems (required):*

* kubernetes: deploying, scaling, and managing workloads (deployments, services, configmaps, secrets, health probes).
* ci/cd pipelines for automated build, test, and deploy (jenkins, github actions, argocd, or similar).
* container image management: building, tagging, versioning via docker; familiarity with a container registry (ecr, gcr).
* observability for ai systems: experience with tracing, monitoring, and logging tools (langfuse, prometheus, or equivalent)..

*additional preferred skills:*

* networking domain knowledge (wireless/wired diagnostics, network troubleshooting) is preferred but not required.
* experience with aws bedrock, opensearch serverless, or similar managed ai/ml services.
* great written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate technical designs to senior leadership

description:

the senior ai engineer - voice & conversational ai is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing ai-powered voice solutions that enhance customer engagement and operational efficiency at tower loan. this position plays a key role in advancing the company's use of artificial intelligence to support customer service, account servicing, payment reminders, and other business operations. the ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer with a strong background in conversational ai, real-time technologies, and developing secure, scalable solutions.

**duties/responsibilities:**

* design, develop, and maintain real-time ai voice applications using large language models, speech-to-speech technologies, and conversational ai platforms.
* develop automated conversational workflows for customer service, payment reminders, promise-to-pay interactions, account servicing, and other business needs.
* configure ai prompts, conversation policies, security controls, escalation procedures, and automated tool-calling capabilities.
* implement conversation management features, including interruption handling, contextual awareness, fallback logic, and transfers to live representatives.
* develop and integrate applications using openai live/realtime apis and other real-time ai technologies.
* manage streaming audio, transcription, session processing, and system integrations to ensure reliable, responsive ai interactions.
* integrate ai voice applications with sip, voip, pbx systems, and enterprise telecommunications infrastructure to support inbound and outbound calling.
* develop and maintain applications, apis, and microservices using c#, .net, python, javascript/typescript, or other appropriate technologies.
* integrate ai applications with company databases, customer systems, payment platforms, messaging systems, and other business applications.
* develop secure ai-enabled functions for account lookup, customer verification, payment-related interactions, scheduling, and transfers to live representatives.
* implement safeguards to ensure ai interactions comply with company policies, security requirements, and applicable legal and regulatory standards.
* maintain accurate and auditable records of ai conversations, system activities, decisions, and automated transactions.
* develop and perform automated testing, conversation evaluations, and quality assurance processes to improve ai accuracy, reliability, and performance.
* monitor system performance, including call outcomes, response times, errors, escalation rates, and other operational metrics.
* design and maintain scalable, highly available systems with appropriate controls for system capacity, error handling, and service interruptions.
* lead technical development from initial concept through production implementation while maintaining system security, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* serve as a senior technical resource for conversational ai technologies and provide guidance to other engineers.
* perform all other duties as assigned.

**required skills/abilities:**

* strong software engineering skills with experience developing and supporting production applications.
* advanced knowledge of apis, microservices, distributed systems, and real-time application architectures.
* strong understanding of large language models, generative ai, conversational ai, and prompt engineering.
* advanced troubleshooting, problem-solving, and systems analysis skills.
* ability to design secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions.
* strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

**education and experience:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, artificial intelligence, or a related field preferred. equivalent professional experience may be considered.
* five or more years of professional software development experience preferred.
* demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software systems required.
* experience developing ai-powered applications, particularly conversational ai or large language model solutions, strongly preferred.
* experience with real-time voice technologies, streaming apis, sip, rtp, webrtc, websocket, or enterprise telephony systems preferred.
* experience with openai live/realtime apis and related ai development platforms preferred.
* proficiency with c#, .net, python, javascript/typescript, or similar programming languages preferred.
* experience with technologies such as sql server, redis, kafka, docker, kubernetes, rest apis, git, and ci/cd pipelines preferred.
* familiarity with speech recognition, text-to-speech, retrieval-augmented generation (rag), ai evaluation frameworks, and ai safety controls preferred.
* experience in consumer finance, lending, collections, banking, payment processing, telecommunications, or another regulated industry preferred.

**physical requirements:**

* stand, walk, and/or sit for eight (8) hours a day.
* communicate effectively, verbally, written, in person, via telephone, or electronically.
* lift and maneuver up to 20 lbs.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**overview**
------------

at ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. make your move.

* job type: full time
* work type: hybrid

  

we made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. you'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. at ford, you can build more than vehicles. come build what matters.

**enterprise technology** plays a critical part in shaping the future of mobility. if you’re looking for the chance to leverage advanced technology to redefine the transportation landscape, enhance the customer experience and improve people’s lives, this is the opportunity for you. join us and challenge your it expertise and analytical skills to help create vehicles that are as smart as you are.

**in this position...**

we are seeking a data scientist with a strong background in natural language processing and a focus on large language models (llms) and generative ai. in this role, you will collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and business teams to translate complex business needs into intelligent, reliable, scalable, and production-ready ai solutions. the ideal candidate will combine strong applied data science and machine learning expertise with hands-on experience developing llm-powered applications, model evaluation frameworks, responsible ai controls, and cloud-based ai solutions using google cloud platform (gcp). experience with agentic ai—including tool-enabled agents, workflow orchestration, and multi-agent systems—is a plus

  

based in dearborn, mi, this is a hybrid position with a requirement to be onsite four or more days per week.relocation assistance may be available for qualified candidates.

**what you'll do...**

* design, prototype, evaluate, and productionize llm-powered applications for enterprise and customer-facing use cases.
* develop prompt strategies, structured-output workflows, model routing, context-management approaches, and fine-tuning or adaptation methods when appropriate.
* create rigorous llm evaluation frameworks covering task quality, factuality, relevance, robustness, latency, cost, safety, and user experience.
* explore and implement agentic ai patterns such as planning, tool and function calling, memory, reflection, human-in-the-loop approvals, and multi-step workflow execution.
* develop and deploy scalable ai and machine learning solutions on gcp using services such as vertex ai, bigquery, cloud storage, cloud run, cloud functions, pub/sub, and related data and ai services.
* build reusable python components, apis, experimentation pipelines, and data products that integrate with enterprise platforms and applications.
* create and maintain data pipelines that prepare structured and unstructured data for modeling, experimentation, evaluation, and production use.
* perform exploratory analysis, feature engineering, statistical modeling, and machine learning to support broader data science needs.
* implement observability, monitoring, guardrails, automated testing, and feedback loops to improve model and application performance after deployment.
* communicate technical findings, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* stay current with emerging generative ai methods and translate promising research into practical business value.

**you'll have...**

* bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering or similar field or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
* 2+ years of experience applying statistical analysis and traditional machine-learning methods to solve business problems.
* 2+ years of experience delivering end-to-end data science solutions, from data exploration and feature engineering through model validation, deployment, and monitoring.
* 2+ years professional experience in data science, machine learning, applied ai, natural language processing, or a related technical role.
* 2+ years of programming skills in python and proficiency with sql; experience writing maintainable, testable, production-quality code.
* 1+ years of experience developing applications with commercial or open-source llms.
* 1+ years of experience with prompt engineering, llm evaluation, model integration, and core nlp concepts.
* 1+ years of experience working with gcp data and ai services, particularly vertex ai and bigquery, or comparable experience on another major cloud platform with the ability to transition to gcp.
* 1+ years of experience with modern software development and cloud deployment practices, including git, apis, containers, ci/cd, identity and access management, and production monitoring.

**even better, you may have...**

* master’s degree in data science, computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering or related field.
* 5+ years experience designing or deploying agentic ai systems, including tool-using agents, graph-based workflows, multi-agent collaboration, or human-in-the-loop controls.
* ability to translate ambiguous business needs into measurable technical objectives and deliver iteratively in a cross-functional environment.
* strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* hands-on experience with vertex ai capabilities, including model garden, generative ai studio, custom training, model endpoints, pipelines, evaluation, and model monitoring.
* experience building analytics and machine learning workflows with bigquery, bigquery ml, dataflow, or related gcp services.
* experience with fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, synthetic-data generation, distillation, or model serving and optimization.
* experience developing evaluation datasets, automated evaluators, adversarial tests, red-team scenarios, and regression test suites for generative ai.
* knowledge of llmops and mlops practices, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, monitoring, scalable inference, and cost optimization.
* experience delivering ai solutions in a regulated, safety-conscious, or large-enterprise environment.

you may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to ford motor company, we encourage you to apply!
  
  
as an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. you can choose what your ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? no matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

* immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
* flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up childcare and more
* family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
* vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
* tuition assistance
* established and active employee resource groups
* paid time off for individual and team community service
* a generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between christmas and new year’s day
paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.
