title: Senior Data Engineer - Vehicle Quality Engineering
description:
**job description**

**this role is categorized as hybrid. this means the successful candidate is expected to report to warren global technical center or austin technical center three times per week, at minimum [or other frequency dictated by the business if more than 3 days].**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  

**the role**
------------

  

the senior data scientist will develop and operationalize data science solutions that identify emerging vehicle, software, and product-quality issues before they become larger customer or launch risks. this role partners closely with product quality, warranty, vehicle engineering, software teams, and other subject matter experts to translate complex operational questions into trustworthy metrics, detection algorithms, dashboards, and alerting workflows.

  

the successful candidate will combine strong statistical and analytical judgment with the ability to build production-ready data products. they will work across the full lifecycle: understanding the customer problem, validating the data, developing and testing an analytical approach, deploying the solution, monitoring its performance, and continuously improving adoption and scalability.

  

**what you’ll do**
------------------

* partner with subject matter experts to define meaningful metrics, analytical objectives, thresholds, and decision criteria.
* conduct comprehensive, unbiased analysis to identify trends, anomalies, relationships, and emerging risks in vehicle, software, warranty, diagnostic, fleet, and product-quality data.
* design, test, and deploy anomaly-detection and pre-emptive-monitoring algorithms for customer-impacting issues.
* build end-to-end analytical pipelines that transform raw data into reliable insights, dashboards, alerts, and operational workflows.
* create customer-focused visualizations that allow engineering and quality teams to investigate fleet, vin, and software-version,
* develop alerting solutions that help internal customers respond quickly to high-priority vehicle and product issues.
* establish validation approaches using historical data, controlled testing, domain expertise, and—when appropriate—real-world observations.
* communicate findings, assumptions, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* improve solution performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency through model, query, pipeline, and architecture improvements.
* reduce complexity and redundant data handling by standardizing analytical processes and adopting modern azure-based technologies.
* support vehicle and software launches by delivering readiness insights and analytical tools.
* document analytical methods, data lineage, operating procedures, and known limitations so solutions can be maintained and adopted across teams.
contribute reusable patterns, best practices, and mentoring that increase the impact of the broader analytics organization.  

  

**expected business outcomes**
------------------------------

* deliver committed critical analytics features for internal customers with clear acceptance criteria and production support plans.
* launch or improve pre-emptive monitors that identify emerging vehicle, software, or product-quality concerns earlier than traditional reactive processes.
* provide trusted dashboards and alerts that enable real-time, data-driven decisions for engineering, quality, warranty, and launch teams.
* improve the performance, scalability, usability, and cost profile of existing analytics products.
* demonstrate measurable customer value through reduced manual effort, faster issue investigation, improved launch readiness, or earlier risk mitigation.
* increase adoption by working directly with software domains and operational teams to understand how insights are used and where capabilities should expand.
* strengthen analytical governance through documented definitions, validation methods, data quality checks, and repeatable operating practices.
* selects appropriate analytical methods based on the business question, data limitations, and decision context.
* tests assumptions and validates results using sound statistical and domain-informed practices.
* balances detection sensitivity, false positives, explainability, and operational usefulness.
* starts with how internal customers make decisions and designs the solution around that workflow.
* converts complex data into clear, actionable insights.
* builds trust through responsiveness, follow-through, transparency, and data quality.
* owns outcomes across discovery, development, deployment, support, and improvement.
* troubleshoots issues quickly and follows assigned work through completion.
* designs solutions that are maintainable, scalable, secure, and cost-conscious.
* explores practical new methods and technologies when existing approaches do not adequately solve the problem.
* identifies opportunities to automate manual processes and improve performance.
* takes educated risks while using validation and safeguards to minimize downside.
* works effectively with engineering, quality, warranty, analytics, and business partners.
* listens actively, shares information, and builds productive relationships.
mentors others and contributes reusable knowledge to the organization.  

  

**representative work in this role**
------------------------------------

* develop pre-emptive detection for emerging product-quality issues and other customer-impacting patterns.
* build algorithms that summarize suspect behavior and help engineering teams identify problematic charging conditions or stations.
* create dashboards and alerts that provide timely visibility into vip vehicle concerns, launch readiness, fleet behavior, and production risks.
* improve ingestion, query, and dashboard performance while reducing manual preparation and cloud-resource costs.
integrate additional signals—including warranty, diagnostic, software, and operational data—to improve detection confidence and business context.  

  

**measures of success**
-----------------------

success will be evaluated through a combination of technical quality, customer impact, and organizational contribution, including:

* accuracy, precision, recall, timeliness, and operational usefulness of deployed detection solutions.
* adoption and satisfaction among engineering, quality, warranty, and launch-readiness customers.
* reduction in time required to investigate issues, prepare meetings, extract data, or respond to high-priority risks.
* reliability, performance, scalability, maintainability, and cost efficiency of production analytics products.
* completion of committed critical features and effective production support.
* quality of documentation, data definitions, validation practices, and knowledge sharing.
demonstration of gm behaviors: own the outcome, think customer, innovate now, win with integrity, commit to customers, and one team.  

  

**your skills & abilities (required qualifications)**
-----------------------------------------------------

* bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of data engineering/development or related experience
* experience applying statistical analysis, machine learning, anomaly detection, forecasting, classification, or related data-science methods to real-world business or engineering problems.
* strong python skills for data analysis, algorithm development, automation, and production-oriented data workflows.

title: Senior Real Estate & Facilities Data Analyst
description:
**overview of position**

the senior real estate & facilities analyst supports the global corporate real estate organization by transforming complex portfolio, financial, occupancy, lease, project, facilities, workplace, sustainability, and employee data into accurate reporting, actionable insights, and decision-support materials.

this role combines advanced analytics, data governance, business intelligence, technology enablement, and practical artificial intelligence capabilities with strong corporate real estate knowledge. the analyst develops dashboards, scorecards, forecasts, scenario models, business cases, and executive presentations that support portfolio optimization, workplace strategy, capital investment, lease decisions, operational improvement, and long-term planning.

the successful candidate is detail-oriented, technically capable, and able to communicate complex findings clearly to executive, financial, operational, and technical audiences while partnering effectively across functions and with external service providers.

**what will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?**

**data analytics, governance & portfolio analysis (25%)**

* collect, cleanse, reconcile, validate, manipulate, and analyze structured and unstructured data from multiple internal and external systems.
* maintain data standards, definitions, ownership, validation procedures, business rules, quality controls, and documentation across corporate real estate data sources.
* monitor data quality, identify discrepancies and root causes, and coordinate remediation with internal teams and external service providers.
* analyze occupancy cost, utilization, lease activity, facilities operations, capital projects, sustainability, workplace experience, employee work arrangements, and portfolio risk.
* develop key performance indicators, benchmarks, forecasts, trends, scenario models, and ad hoc analyses to support portfolio optimization, site consolidation, workplace strategy, lease decisions, and capital investment.

**business intelligence, reporting & technology (25%)**

* build, manage, and continuously enhance centralized dashboards, scorecards, reporting tools, and analytical platforms for site-level and consolidated portfolio reporting.
* translate business requirements into scalable data, reporting, visualization, and technology solutions using advanced excel and business-intelligence tools.
* automate recurring data collection, validation, analysis, and reporting to reduce manual effort and improve the speed, consistency, and reliability of insights.
* support system integrations, data pipelines, interfaces, data warehousing, application programming interfaces, and connections between source systems and reporting platforms.
* maintain recurring real estate & facilities metrics, balanced scorecards, capital budgeting, fixed-asset reporting, and operational reporting as required.

**artificial intelligence & innovation (20%)**

* serve as a corporate real estate resource for artificial intelligence, generative ai, intelligent automation, and emerging analytical technologies.
* identify, prioritize, test, and implement practical ai use cases for document analysis, lease abstraction, portfolio research, forecasting, data-quality monitoring, executive reporting, and employee-service delivery.
* partner with technology, information security, legal, risk, and data governance teams to support responsible and policy-compliant ai adoption.
* develop user guidance, demonstrations, training materials, and adoption support while maintaining awareness of developments in ai, analytics, commercial real estate technology, and workplace intelligence.

**executive reporting & decision support (20%)**

* convert complex data and analysis into clear, concise business recommendations, dashboards, scorecards, business cases, and executive presentations.
* communicate portfolio performance, risks, trends, opportunities, business impact, and recommended actions through effective data visualization and storytelling.
* tailor reporting for executive, operational, financial, and technical audiences and support annual planning, quarterly reviews, leadership meetings, and strategic initiatives.

**stakeholder & program support (10%)**

* partner with real estate, facilities, finance, procurement, human resources, technology, risk, sustainability, security, and regional teams to define business questions, reporting requirements, and priorities.
* coordinate cross-functional analytics and technology initiatives, including plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, deliverables, adoption, and performance measures.
* maintain productive relationships with service providers, technology vendors, consultants, and data partners; support continuous improvement and other analyses identified by leadership.

**what are the requirements needed for this position?**

**education**

* bachelor’s degree in data analytics, business analytics, information systems, computer science, finance, real estate, business administration, engineering, or a related field.

**professional experience**

* five or more years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data governance, technology, corporate real estate, finance, or a related discipline.
* experience developing complex analyses, dashboards, reports, data-quality processes, or technology-enabled solutions using information from multiple systems.

**knowledge and skills**

* advanced proficiency in microsoft excel, including complex formulas, pivottables, power query, data modeling, scenario analysis, charts, and large-dataset manipulation.
* experience developing dashboards and visualizations using power bi, tableau, or a comparable business-intelligence platform.
* understanding of data governance, data quality, master data, business definitions, controls, validation, and ownership.
* professional experience using artificial intelligence or generative ai tools and an understanding of responsible-use considerations.
* strong analytical, organizational, project-management, problem-solving, written, verbal, presentation, and executive-communication skills.
* ability to translate technical or analytical findings into clear business recommendations, manage multiple priorities independently, and collaborate across functions and organizational levels.

**what other skills/experience would be helpful to have?**

* masters degree in a relevant field.

**professional experience**

* experience supporting a geographically dispersed corporate real estate portfolio or working within a fortune 500 company.
* knowledge of portfolio strategy, transactions, lease administration, occupancy planning, facilities management, capital projects, workplace experience, sustainability, financial modeling, forecasting, benchmarking, and scenario planning.
* experience with integrated workplace management systems, lease-administration platforms, facility-management systems, occupancy technologies, or corporate real estate databases.
* experience working with outsourced service providers, technology vendors, consultants, and cross-functional global teams.

**knowledge and skills**

* working knowledge of sql, python, dax, data warehouses, cloud platforms, application programming interfaces, or data-integration tools.
* experience with microsoft power platform, including power bi, power automate, power apps, or copilot.
* experience implementing ai-enabled workflows, large language models, intelligent automation, or predictive analytics.
* intermediate or advanced microsoft powerpoint skills and strong data-visualization and storytelling capabilities.
* relevant certification in analytics, data governance, artificial intelligence, project management, power bi, or commercial real estate.

title: Data Analyst II - Windreich Department of AI & Human Health Research
description:
we are inviting applications for a **data analyst position in data science and machine learning with a specific interest in applications to clinical data, including electronic health records (ehr).**

the data analyst ii oversees activities related to data integrity, security and enhancement of the value of data. the data analyst ii may direct the movement of data across multiple systems; oversee its validation and organization and make sure that data is available to appropriate people and systems within an organization. the data analyst ii will also develop and execute reports that will be important assets of the practice as they continue to develop and evaluate a new model of care.

this position will be in the lab of dr. lili chan housed in the department of artificial intelligence and human health at the icahn school of medicine at mount sinai in manhattan, new york, ny, usa.

key topics of interest include but are not limited to: natural language processing, large language models, predictive modeling for disease outcomes and personalized therapeutic recommendations, working with common data model ehr standards (e.g., omop. we have an interest in many disease domains including nephrology, cardiology, radiology, psychiatry, and others.

**data and resources:**

data resources include (a) access to >8 million patient records in the mount sinai data warehouse (b) the biome biobank program with >30,000 patients with whole exome sequencing data linked to longitudinal clinical data. the candidates will have the opportunity to develop their own research projects and to lead or participate in local as well as international collaborations.

the analyst will join a dynamic team of data scientists, geneticists, and clinicians and participate in unique opportunities to apply deep learning for important scientific breakthroughs and to directly impact patients’ lives in a clinical setting.

* work with the clinical and administrative staff of the practice to define data reporting needs
* develop analytic reports that are easily understandable by clinical and administrative staff.
* use modeling techniques and tools in analyzing and specifying data structure
* implement best practices in data management to ensure the integrity of the data, the quality of data processes and deliver analyzable or analyzed data to a variety of internal and external clients of the affiliated practice
* maintain data integrity and completes data analysis as necessary
* complete data capture, data extraction and analysis
* develop, maintain or implement procedures for data entry, data cleaning, documentation and other administrative tasks
* document, implement, maintain or recommend operating methods to improve processing, distribution, data flow, collection, database editing procedures
* may define parameters for file or space utilization
* work closely with it management and staff
* access data in the data warehouse, as required
* assist clinical and administrative staff with queries, statistical analyses, reports and technical difficulties related to data retrieval
* design and write custom applications needed to ensure the database meets requirements for the entry, management and reporting of data
* identify and recommend solutions to data management issues
* maintain knowledge of the current regulations and technologies related to data management
* write and prepare manuscripts and other materials for internal and external audiences
* perform other related duties
* help to build and perpetuate a practice environment and culture of collaboration, respect, learning, flexibility and fun among all team members

* bachelors degree in computer science, statistics and/or related field required, or combination of equivalent work experience and education. masters degree in relevant field of study preferred (e.g., biomedical informatics, clinical informatics, statistics, epidemiology, computer science, etc.).
* 3+ years of analytics experience including report development and database application/management experience, preferably in a large medical center or healthcare environment

**preferred:**

* significant experience in large language models (llms), natural language processing (nlp), and machine learning is preferred, ideally demonstrated through published research and/or publicly available code. expertise in developing, fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying llms is preferred, including experience with modern deep learning frameworks and llm tooling (e.g., pytorch, hugging face transformers, tensorflow) and techniques such as prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (rag), and model evaluation.
* expertise with programming and statistical software experience in r and/or python.
* formal computer science, statistics, or epidemiological training is a strong advantage.
* familiarity with the publication process.

**your work:** you will work across a diverse enterprise data ecosystem that includes cloud and on-premises platforms, data warehouses, data lakes, etl/elt pipelines, streaming technologies, data integration platforms, orchestration tools, metadata and governance solutions, and emerging ai-enabled data capabilities. you will collaborate with software engineers, qa engineers, technical analysts, solution architects, data engineering, infrastructure, security, governance, analytics, and business teams to support production workloads, improve data availability and quality, and reliably deliver data products and services.

**data platform operations and reliability**

----------------------------------------------

* learn and participate in the adoption of ai and generative ai technologies within engineering and operational solutions.

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and progressive experience in software engineering.

title: Sales Admin
description:
**benefits:**

* health insurance
* opportunity for advancement
* paid time off
* training & development
* dental insurance

**who we are**

zero impact solutions is an end-to-end renewable energy provider. we design, finance, build and maintain ev charging, fleet electrification, solar microgrid, battery energy storage and hydroponic systems for commercial and enterprise clients – and we handle every step in-house: sales, provisioning, design and engineering, contracting and construction, servicing and maintenance. we are a licensed c-10 contractor with construction crews across california, and our projects are backed by state and utility incentive programs (such as calevip, utility make-ready programs and lcfs credits) that provide a steady, reliable flow of revenue.

we are growing fast and we run lean. if you want to work on real infrastructure with a small, fast-moving team – and you like using technology to get more done – we want to speak with you.

**the role**

the sales admin is the operational engine behind our sales team. you own the systems, data and project cadence that turn a signed proposal into a funded, permitted and built project: keeping our crm accurate, our rebate applications on schedule, our customers informed, and our sales reps focused on selling.

this is not a clerical position. we are looking for someone who thinks like a business analyst, works like a project manager, and uses ai tools every day to work faster. you will support deal flow directly (proposals, quotes, customer follow-up), manage a caseload of active projects across sales, engineering, incentives and construction, and continuously improve how the sales organization operates.

**how your time is spent:** sales support & deal flow (40%) · project management (35%) · crm, data & ai-driven process improvement (25%)

**what you'll do**

**sales support & deal flow** *(40%)*

* build and send proposals, quotes and follow-up materials for the sales team; keep proposal templates, pricing sheets and collateral current.
* qualify inbound leads, schedule discovery calls and site assessments, and keep the pipeline moving with timely, professional follow-up by phone and email.
* prepare rfp/rfq and bid responses: track requirements, assemble documents, coordinate inputs from engineering and construction, and submit on time.
* prepare, submit and track incentive and rebate applications (calevip, utility make-ready programs, lcfs registration) – these deadlines directly affect revenue.
* support contract execution: assemble agreements, route for signature, collect site documentation, and hand projects off cleanly to engineering and construction.
* serve as a point of contact for customers, utilities and partners during the sales-to-construction transition.

**project management** *(35%)*

* own a caseload of active projects from signed proposal through construction kickoff; maintain milestone schedules, deadlines and current status for each.
* run weekly status reviews with sales, engineering, incentives and construction; publish clear status reports and action items.
* track risks, issues and dependencies (permits, utility interconnection, rebate approvals, equipment lead times) and escalate early.
* keep project trackers, documentation and dashboards accurate in salesforce and smartsheet so leadership always knows where every deal stands.

**crm, data & ai-driven process improvement** *(25%)*

* administer and improve our salesforce crm: data accuracy, custom fields, validation rules, record-triggered flows, reports and dashboards.
* use ai tools daily (chatgpt, claude, microsoft copilot, salesforce einstein) to draft proposals and customer communications, summarize rfps and program guidelines, research prospects, and clean and analyze data.
* automate repetitive work with salesforce flows, smartsheet automations, zapier/power automate or simple scripts – and measure the time saved.
* build and maintain sales and pipeline reporting (conversion rates, proposal turnaround, rebate status, project aging) in salesforce, excel or power bi.
* document business processes, own the sales playbook, and propose and implement improvements.
* other duties as assigned.

**what you bring**

* **experience:** 1–3+ years in sales operations, sales support, business analysis, crm administration or project coordination. strong recent graduates with substantial internship or project experience are encouraged to apply.

  

* **sales skills:** comfortable on the phone and in front of customers; writes clear, persuasive proposals and emails; follows up relentlessly and keeps commitments.

  

* **project management:** has managed multiple concurrent projects with real deadlines; knows how to run a status meeting, maintain a schedule, and track risks and action items. familiar with agile/scrum or traditional methods and tools such as jira, smartsheet, ms project, asana or monday.

  

* **ai fluency:** uses generative ai as part of daily work – prompting, drafting, summarizing, analysis – and can show examples of using ai to work faster or automate a workflow.

  

* **crm:** hands-on salesforce experience; admin-level skills preferred (flows, reports and dashboards, data loader, user and permission management). hubspot or similar considered.

  

* **data:** advanced excel/google sheets (pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas); dashboards in power bi, tableau or salesforce; sql is a plus.

  

* **communication:** excellent written and verbal communication; able to work confidently with customers, utilities, engineers and field crews.

  

* **mindset:** analytical, solution-oriented and organized; handles high-stakes, short-notice problems calmly; thrives in a fast-paced, small-company environment.

  

**nice to have**

* bachelor's degree in business, computer science, analytics, engineering or a related field; mba a plus.
* salesforce administrator certification.
* pmp, capm, pmi-acp or scrum certification
* ai credentials such as pmi's generative ai for project managers, microsoft ai fundamentals or salesforce ai associate.
* experience with process automation, workflow design or light scripting (python, apex, power query).
* experience in ev charging, solar, construction, utilities or another incentive-driven industry.
* startup or small-team experience.

**why this role**

you will see the whole business – sales, incentives, engineering and construction – and own the systems that connect them. people who succeed in this seat grow into sales, sales operations or project management roles as we scale.

**to apply:** send your resume and a short note describing one workflow you automated or one way you use ai in your work today.

equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

we are seeking a highly experienced and technically accomplished senior staff engineer to join our network platform engineering (npe) team. in this role, you will serve as the final gatekeeper of quality before network operating systems (nos), fabric interconnection/ix features & new product features are deployed into our production environment. you will design rigorous test methodologies, build advanced staging topologies, and validate complex architectures to ensure the highest standards of reliability, scalability, and performance.

  
  

this is a senior individual contributor role at the intersection of network infrastructure & software engineering. you will partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders across product, engineering, operations, and observability teams to deliver solutions that accelerate the velocity and reliability of network certification, testing, and deployment pipelines.

  
  

this is a high-impact, high-visibility position that requires strong engineering judgment, a bias for action, and the ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and business units

  
  

**responsibilities**

* nos & feature certification: design, execute, and document comprehensive test plans to certify new nos releases, fabric interconnection & new product features before production deployment
* architecture simulation: build and maintain large-scale staging environments that replicate complex service provider and data center topologies
* regression & scale/performance testing: conduct interoperability, scalability, and high-availability testing across multi-vendor environments
* vendor liaison: collaborate directly with network vendors to track software bugs, validate hotfixes, and influence product roadmaps
* production readiness: partner with production engineering teams to develop safe deployment playbooks and rollback strategies

network engineering & automation

* develop comprehensive test plans and certification strategies; lead hands-on technical deep-dives to verify that architectural designs, new nos features, and customer use cases perform as expected in lab and production-equivalent environments
* act as a subject matter expert for service provider & dc networking technologies including bgp (ibgp/ebgp, policy, route reflectors), mpls (ldp, rsvp, segment routing), evpn, isis, and ospf, sr, qos, in multi-vendor environments
* excellent understanding of technologies such as vxlan, epl, evpl, eplan, evplan, eaccess, etree in multi-vendor environments
* support vendor evaluations and feature gap analyses, provide technical guidance on network hardware and nos selection aligned to architectural requirements

* strong skills in network automation tools and programmatic interfaces to optimize certification workflows
  

**qualifications**

required expertise

* 7+ years of experience in network engineering and automation
* bachelor’s in electrical engineering, electronics, computer engineering or related field preferred
* excellent understanding of osi layers, hands-on experience with routing and switching in multi-vendor, large-scale environments (required)
* deep proficiency in service provider and data center networking protocols
* routing: bgp (ibgp/ebgp, route policies, communities, route reflectors), ospf, is-is, bird
* mpls: ldp, rsvp-te, segment routing (sr-mpls, srv6)
* overlay/underlay: vxlan, evpn, l3vpn, l2vpn
* network virtualization: cnf, vnf, sr-iov, dpdk
* networking vendor : nokia, juniper, cisco, arrucs
* experience with network test equipment and traffic generators e.g spirent, keysight/ixia, spirent, avalanche, iperf, trex etc.
* good programming proficiency in network automation tools (e.g., python, ansible, pyats, netmiko, rest api) alongside programmatic interfaces (netconf, restconf,gnmi)
* familiarity with deploying, testing and troubleshooting network features within docker container & kubernetes (k8s) clusters
* experience with ci/cd pipelines (e.g., github, github actions, jenkins) and devops best practices
* familiarity with hybrid cloud architecture, hands-on experience with aws networking services (vpc, transit gateway, direct connect etc.
* explore, evaluate, and integrate ai/ml tools and large language models (llms) to streamline certification processes, including automated test case generation, log anomaly detection, and predictive root-cause analysis for lab failures
* relevant industry certifications (e.g., cisco ccie, juniper jncie,aws sa etc.) is a plus

title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer - Cloud Web Platforms
description:
headquartered in the united states, **tp-link systems inc.** is a global provider of networking devices and smart home products, consistently ranked among the world’s leading providers of wi-fi devices. serving customers in over 170 countries, tp-link develops innovative technologies that connect millions of users and devices worldwide.

at tp-link, we believe technology can make life smarter, simpler, and more connected. we are committed to delivering high-quality products and cloud services that power modern networking, security, and smart home experiences.

**about the role**

tp-link is seeking a **software quality assurance engineer** to join our cloud web platforms quality engineering team. in this role, you will help ensure the quality of tp-link's global websites, web applications, and ai-powered customer experiences, which reach millions of users across dozens of countries and languages.

you will drive quality throughout the development lifecycle—from reviewing requirements and identifying risks to designing tests, expanding automation coverage, investigating failures, and supporting release decisions. the work ranges from product pages and content-management platforms to ai-powered search and support assistants. you also have the opportunity to contribute to testing the cloud services and apis behind these experiences. throughout, you'll work closely with software engineers, product managers, designers, and senior quality engineers.

this role is ideal for a quality engineer who enjoys both breadth and depth: someone comfortable moving between browser-based ui testing, backend api validation, and automation, and who wants to grow expertise across web and cloud technologies.

**responsibilities**

* develop risk-based test strategies and execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing for websites, web applications, content-management systems, apis, and supporting cloud services.
* participate in requirements reviews and design discussions to clarify acceptance criteria, identify risks early, and improve product testability.
* build and maintain automated ui and api tests using python, javascript, or typescript and frameworks such as playwright, cypress, selenium, or equivalent tools. integrate automated tests into ci/cd pipelines.
* validate backend apis, service integrations, database behavior, and data integrity using api tools, code-based test frameworks, and sql.
* investigate failures and isolate root causes using browser developer tools, network traces, application logs, system telemetry, and database queries.
* perform release validation across browsers, devices, and screen sizes, including responsive ui, visual regression, functional, and end-to-end testing to ensure seamless product rollouts.
* conduct web performance, load, and accessibility testing, monitoring metrics like core web vitals and ensuring compliance with wcag guidelines.
* produce clear test reports, defect analyses, and go/no-go risk assessments to support release decisions.
* advocate for qa best practices, test-code quality, and continuous improvement, using ai-assisted tools where appropriate to improve engineering productivity.

  
**requirements**

**required qualifications**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in software quality engineering, with significant experience testing web applications.
* solid understanding of software testing principles, test design techniques, and the software development lifecycle.
* hands-on experience testing web applications across browsers, devices, and screen sizes, using browser developer tools to inspect network requests, console errors, and page behavior.
* experience developing and maintaining automated ui and api tests in python, javascript, or typescript using playwright, selenium, cypress, or similar frameworks.
* experience testing restful apis with tools such as postman or code-based test frameworks, and validating data using sql.
* working knowledge of how websites are built and delivered, including html, css, javascript, http, redirects, caching, and content-management systems.
* familiarity with ci/cd pipelines, git, and jira or similar defect-tracking tools.
* strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain quality risks and test results clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience owning quality for a web product, website migration, or cms platform from planning through release.
* experience testing seo elements, structured data (schema.org), analytics and tag implementations, or localized content across many locales.
* experience testing ai or llm-powered features such as chatbots, search, or recommendations, including approaches for evaluating non-deterministic output.
* experience with web performance and accessibility testing tools such as lighthouse, webpagetest, or axe.
* experience testing applications deployed on aws or other public cloud platforms, or backend services built on microservices.
* familiarity with visual regression testing tools such as percy, applitools, or chromatic.
* experience leveraging ai-powered tools such as github copilot or other ai-assisted testing solutions to improve testing efficiency and engineering productivity.
* experience with networking products, smart home technologies, connected device ecosystems, or e-commerce websites.

**why join tp-link**

* shape the quality of tp-link’s global websites and web experiences, used by customers in over 170 countries.
* work across web and cloud technologies, from browser-based applications to the apis and services behind them.
* help define how the team tests emerging ai-powered features such as conversational assistants and intelligent search.
* build scalable automation using modern frameworks and ai-assisted engineering tools.
* collaborate with talented engineering, product, and design teams across global locations.
* grow your career with broad ownership and visible impact on tp-link’s next generation of web and cloud experiences.

tp-link is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. we celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive.

 **benefits**

*salary range: $100,000 - $130,000*

* fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance (partial coverage for dependents)
* contributions to 401k funds
* 15 days accrued vacation
* 11 paid holidays
* bi-annual pay increases

at tp-link systems inc., we are continually searching for ambitious individuals who are passionate about their work. we believe that diversity fuels innovation, collaboration, and drives our entrepreneurial spirit. as a global company, we highly value diverse perspectives and are committed to cultivating an environment where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. beyond compliance, we strive to create a supportive and growth-oriented workplace for everyone. if you share our passion and connection to this mission, we welcome you to apply and join us in building a vibrant and inclusive team at tp-link systems inc.

title: AI Engineer, Forward Deployed (Copilot and Azure AI Foundry)
description:

the ai engineer is a hands-on builder who works directly with client teams to design, build, and ship production ai solutions on microsoft 365 copilot, copilot studio, and azure ai foundry (now microsoft foundry). this is an individual contributor role. you will write the code, configure the agents, wire up the data, and get solutions into the hands of real users.

you will work inside a collectiv delivery team alongside a project lead, architects, and data engineers. you will partner directly with client business and it stakeholders to turn a business problem into a working ai solution, then harden it for production.

**key responsibilities**

**copilot solutions**

* build declarative agents, copilot connectors, and plugins that extend microsoft 365 copilot with client data and workflows
* build copilot studio agents, topics, actions, and autonomous agents for business processes
* connect copilot to sharepoint, teams, microsoft graph, dataverse, and line-of-business systems
* write and iterate on prompts, instructions, and agent configurations based on test results and user feedback

**azure ai foundry solutions**

* build custom agents and ai applications in azure ai foundry for use cases that go beyond out-of-the-box copilot
* select, deploy, and configure models from the foundry model catalog, and explain the trade-offs in cost, quality, and latency
* implement agentic workflows with tool calling, multi-step orchestration, and human-in-the-loop controls
* integrate ai solutions with enterprise systems through apis, azure functions, power automate, and logic apps

**retrieval and data foundations**

* partner with collectiv data engineers to connect ai solutions to microsoft fabric, databricks, and other enterprise data platforms

**evaluation and production readiness**

* build evaluation sets and test harnesses that measure answer quality, groundedness, hallucination rate, safety, latency, and cost
* implement logging, monitoring, and tracing for deployed agents and models
* apply security, identity, and governance controls using microsoft entra id, microsoft purview, and azure ai content safety
* use version control, ci/cd, and code review standards for all ai solution code and configuration

**consulting and collaboration**

* work directly with client stakeholders to gather requirements, run working sessions, demo progress, and manage expectations
* translate business problems into scoped, buildable ai use cases with clear success metrics
* train client users and administrators on the solutions you build and support adoption after go-live
* contribute reusable patterns, accelerators, and documentation to collectiv's ai practice

* bachelor's degree from an accredited university in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 4+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or microsoft 365 and power platform development
* 1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying generative ai or llm-powered solutions in production or client environments
* hands-on experience with microsoft 365 copilot extensibility and copilot studio
* hands-on experience with azure ai foundry or azure openai
* experience building rag solutions with azure ai search
* strong python or c# skills
* experience working in azure (storage, compute, identity, networking)
* ability to work independently in a client-facing consulting role

**preferred qualifications**

* experience with microsoft agent framework, semantic kernel, or autogen
* experience with power platform, dataverse, and power automate
* experience with microsoft fabric, databricks, or power bi
* experience with llmops practices including evaluation frameworks, prompt management, and model monitoring
* familiarity with security, privacy, and compliance considerations for ai in regulated industries
* consulting experience across multiple clients or industries

**what success looks like in this role**

* ai solutions you build reach production and are used by real people, not just demoed
* clients trust you as the engineer who knows how to make copilot and foundry work in their environment
* your solutions are measured, documented, secure, and supportable after handoff
* you contribute patterns and accelerators that make collectiv's next ai engagement faster

**why collectiv**

join collectiv for a rewarding career in a fully remote work environment with quarterly in-person team experiences and competitive compensation. we provide a clear growth trajectory with professional development opportunities and a top-shelf benefits package. enjoy unlimited time off and 100% covered health insurance, encompassing medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family. our comprehensive offerings, from a competitive 401(k) with a 4% match to educational assistance, tech stipend, and discounts on various goods and services, demonstrate our commitment to your well-being and success.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, New Verticals Agentic Foundations
description:
**about the team**
------------------

agentic foundations, part of new verticals ml, builds the core ai/ml intelligence that powers high-quality, scalable agents at doordash, and proves it through flagship agent experiences such as the ask grocery assistant. we operate as a closed loop: new models, evals, and representations make our agents better, and real-world agent usage surfaces the gaps that drive our next foundations work.

**about the role**
------------------

we're looking for a senior machine learning engineer to join agentic foundations with a primary focus on vertical agent development. you will own the continuous improvement of our flagship agents, starting with the ask assistant, using an eval-driven loop to make them faster, more cost-efficient, and more reliable for millions of customers. you will also help us bring this approach to new agentic experiences for merchants and dashers, turning promising ideas into production-ready agents.

this is a chance to work at the intersection of llms, agents, post-training, and evals on problems that ship. you will partner closely with engineers working on agentic memory, agent-compatible product representations, and post-training of small language models (slms), so that what we learn from production agents feeds directly back into our foundations, and what we build there makes our agents better.

you will report into the engineering lead on our new verticals ai/ml team. we expect this role to be hybrid with some time in-office and some time remote.

**you're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **raise the quality of our consumer agents:** build and refine our eval harness-optimization loop to pinpoint failure modes, then iterate on prompts, tools, skills, and context, and measure the impact on real customer tasks.
* **find the best balance of quality, latency, and cost:** run rigorous experiments, including fine-tuning open-weights models and deploying small language models (slms) where they can replace or augment larger llms.
* **launch new agents:** take agentic opportunities for merchants and dashers from early exploration to production.
* **turn foundations into product impact:** work with teammates on agentic memory, agent-compatible product representations, and post-training slms for steerable generative recommendation, and bring those capabilities into production agents.
* **shape the roadmap:** partner with engineering, product, and business leaders to define an ml-driven strategy for our fast-growing grocery and retail delivery business.

**we're excited about you because you have…**
---------------------------------------------

* 3+ years of industry ml experience, including hands-on work building and shipping llm-based agents (tool use, context management, prompting, guardrails) and improving them with evals and data
* experience with post-training or fine-tuning of open-weights models (e.g., sft, preference optimization, or rl), ideally including small language models, and sound judgment on quality, latency, and cost trade-offs
* strong foundation in nlp and machine learning, with proficiency in python and frameworks such as pytorch or tensorflow
* m.s. or phd in computer science, statistics, math, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience, plus a collaborative, growth-minded approach and a drive for measurable impact

**about doordash**

at doordash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from dashers to merchant partners to consumers. we are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  
  
doordash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. we're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Unsecured Installments
description:
**about upstart**

at upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all americans. every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced ai to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

as the leading ai lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. but the numbers only hint at the impact. every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

we’re proudly digital-first, giving most upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the us and canada. digital-first doesn’t mean distant. we’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. and whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in columbus, austin, the bay area, or new york city, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

if you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

**the team:**

unsecured installments is one of upstart's core lending products, helping borrowers access credit through a seamless, digitally native experience. the team owns critical parts of the borrower journey across offer generation, pricing, underwriting, funding, and borrower experience, while working closely with the broader lending platform that powers upstart at scale. recent work has focused on improving borrower flows, repricing and rate flexibility, partnership experiences, and the overall quality of the customer-facing experience.

as a senior software engineer on the unsecured installments team, you'll be a technical leader for the frontend and full-stack experiences that borrowers interact with directly. working primarily in react and typescript, you'll own the delivery of large, multi-month projects, shape the architecture of the team's mobile-web and full-stack surfaces, and set a high bar for quality across the borrower experience. you'll partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to turn ambiguous problems into durable, well-architected solutions, and you'll mentor other engineers along the way.

**how you’ll make an impact**

* own the design and delivery of large, complex backend and full-stack initiatives, from planning and sequencing through launch and long-term maintenance.
* set technical direction for the team's service architecture, apis, data models, and system integrations, owning a 3–6 month roadmap and proactively addressing systemic gaps that threaten reliability or team effectiveness.
* partner closely with product, frontend, design, platform, and other backend engineers to translate roadmap priorities and borrower needs into scalable, high-quality systems.
* raise the bar for engineering excellence through thoughtful service and api design, data integrity, testing, observability, security, and operational rigor across business-critical lending workflows.
* lead through ambiguity by breaking down loosely defined problems into clear, testable plans and using data to inform tradeoffs involving scope, scalability, performance, reliability, and customer experience.
* mentor and grow other engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance, and serve as a trusted collaborator across the team.
* contribute to how the team uses ai in development workflows and product capabilities, with a pragmatic view of where it can create meaningful leverage.

**minimum qualifications**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, and 6+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* deep proficiency designing and building backend services and apis in a language such as python, java, kotlin, go, ruby, or node.js.
* strong experience with service architecture, api design, data modeling, relational or non-relational databases, and distributed systems.
* track record of independently leading the design and delivery of large, business-critical backend or full-stack projects in production.
* experience building reliable production systems, including testing, monitoring, incident response, performance optimization, and long-term operational ownership.
* ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments where product requirements, constraints, and system boundaries evolve over time.
* strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and align product and engineering partners.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience serving as the backend or full-stack technical lead for a product team or business-critical system.
* experience building consumer-facing products or high-volume transactional systems with strong requirements around reliability, scalability, correctness, and security.
* background in fintech, lending, payments, or other regulated financial products involving complex workflows and high quality expectations.
* experience with distributed systems, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, or service-oriented architectures.
* familiarity with cloud infrastructure, relational and non-relational data stores, messaging systems, and ci/cd workflows.
* experience with experimentation, feature flagging, or platform capabilities that support iterative product improvements in production.
* hands-on experience leveraging generative ai in product features or internal engineering workflows.
* passion for building products that expand access to credit and improve financial outcomes for consumers.

**position location** this role is available in the following locations: remote

**travel requirements** as a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. the majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the u.s but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. the in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

in addition, upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

in addition, upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

$153,000—$218,500 cad

**what you'll love**

at upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. here’s what you can expect:

* competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly
* retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or group retirement savings plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (usd in the us, cad in canada)
* employee stock purchase plan (espp) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (us only)
* comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for us and supplemental health coverage for canada.
* health savings account contributions from upstart for eligible plans (us only)
* income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security
* paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**who we are**

at kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. so why work at kyndryl? we are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

**the role**

your role
  
the forward deployed engineer (fde) is a delivery-first role for early career engineers who want to work where ai systems meet real enterprise complexity.
  
  
as an fde, you will embed directly with customer delivery teams to help build, prototype, and deploy ai-enabled solutions in production environments. this is not a traditional software engineering role and not classic consulting. it is a hybrid role designed for real-world ai deployment, where success is measured by outcomes and production scaled solutions, not experiments.
  
  
you will deliver defined technical components under guidance from senior engineers, while developing consulting fundamentals through direct customer exposure. you will work with modern ai development tools, generative and agentic ai architectures, and enterprise cloud platforms, learning how to translate technical work into customer value.
  
  
what you will do
  

* customer engagement & solution integrity: partner with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into high‑quality, fit‑for‑purpose technical solutions, prioritising the right outcome over the fastest one
* rapid prototyping: build and iterate custom ai solutions tailored to customer needs, leveraging agentic ai frameworks
* ownership, deployment & partnership: own delivery end to end, from scoping to production. work as part of the customer team to engineer and deploy production‑ready solutions that drive adoption and measurable business outcomes.
* optimization: troubleshoot and enhance system performance, scalability, and reliability
* field intelligence: systematically capture deployment learnings, document best practices, and proactively share insights to inform enhancements to kyndryl’s core platforms and frameworks
* continuous learning: adapt quickly to emerging technologies and evolving customer requirements by engaging in ongoing professional development
* platform contribution: actively contribute to the evolution of kyndryl’s ai platforms through feedback, code contributions, and collaboration with product teams

kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against covid-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective covid-19 vaccination policies. those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

**who you are**

required skills and experience
  
  

* programming proficiency: demonstrable expertise in python, (or another modern language such as c#, node.js or typescript); experience working with ai/ml frameworks like tensorflow or pytorch is a plus
* software engineering: solid grasp of the software delivery lifecycle, version control (git & github), and data engineering tools such as pandas and spark
* cloud & distributed systems: experience with cloud ai platforms (aws, azure, google ai) and distributed computing architectures

  
preferred skills and experience
  
  

* open-source ecosystems: familiarity with community-driven ai tools and libraries, including hugging face and relevant repositories
* t-shaped profile: deep technical expertise in one or two domains, with broad understanding across ai/ml, cloud, and consulting
* agentic ai systems: experience designing, building, or integrating multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks (e.g., langgraph, semantic kernel, agent framework, autogen, crewai), including the development of agent protocols and coordination mechanisms
* retrieval-augmented generation (rag) & knowledge systems: practical knowledge of deploying rag architectures and integrating structured and unstructured knowledge sources into ai solutions
* performance & security: knowledge of system-level optimisation and security best practices for scalable ai systems
* business acumen: ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate technical value to diverse stakeholders, including executive audiences
* flexibility: willingness to travel and work on customer premises as required
* education: degree-level qualification in computer science, informatics, data science, engineering, or a closely related discipline - or equivalent professional experience

  

**based in the dallas-fort worth metroplex (or ready to relocate immediately) with a hybrid schedule of 3 days onsite per week at the frisco, tx**

the compensation range for the position in the u.s. is $73,440 to $139,680 based on a full-time schedule.

your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job-related skills and experience. for part time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. the pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement.

california (san francisco bay area): $88,080 to $167,520

california (all other): $80,760 to $153,600

this position will be eligible for kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of kyndryl’s applicable plans. you may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. note: if this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program.

applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.

  

equal opportunity employer

all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

  

**being you**

diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. but we’re not doing it single-handily: our kyndryl inclusion networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. this dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. that’s the kyndryl way.

**what you can expect**

with state-of-the-art resources and fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including microsoft, google, amazon, skillsoft, and many more. through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. at kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

title: Digital Manufacturing Engineer
description:
at capgemini engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. from autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique r&d and engineering services across all industries. join us for a career full of opportunities. where you can make a difference. where no two days are the same

**location**
------------

this is a remote role.

**about the job you're considering**
------------------------------------

we are building modern, highly customized digital applications on top of the ignition platform to support complex discrete manufacturing operations. this is a hybrid industrial software engineering role, combining hands-on experience with scada and industrial data systems with strong modern software development fundamentals.

candidates should be comfortable working with live plant-floor data through opc, kepware, tags, and historians, while also building robust, maintainable web-based applications.
  
you will use ignition as the application platform — integrating real-time and historical data and extending perspective with python scripting, javascript, css, sql, and apis to create scalable desktop and mobile manufacturing solutions.
  
this is also a highly field- and customer-facing role. during site visits, you will work independently throughout the customer facility with operators, trades, engineers, supervisors and managers to understand equipment and workflows, determine what data is needed and how to acquire it, and translate those needs into useful solutions. success requires strong communication, maturity, emotional intelligence, and the ability to build trust across a diverse user community while representing our company professionally.
  
hands-on industrial data experience is required, with ignition, kepware, and canary experience preferred. this is not primarily a plc programming or traditional hmi configuration role; we are looking for engineers who can bridge ot systems, industrial data, modern application development and the people who use those systems.

**your role**
-------------

* design and develop responsive industrial web applications using ignition perspective and supporting web technologies
* extend ignition’s out-of-the-box components using javascript, css, and python scripting to meet complex business and operational requirements
* build modular, maintainable application architectures that support long-term scalability and reuse data & systems integration
* connect equipment and control systems to ignition using opc, kepware, tags, and related industrial technologies
* configure and troubleshoot real-time and historical data collection
* integrate applications with industrial and enterprise systems including: sql databases, sap, sharepoint, active directory, opc and historian data sources (kepware, canary, etc.), rest apis
* design efficient data models and queries optimized for real-time operational usemanufacturing collaboration
* work directly in the manufacturing environment with trades, engineers, it, supervisors, and managers to understand equipment, processes, and operational needs
* determine what machine and process data is required, how it can be acquired, and how it should be presented to support end users
* translate diverse user needs into intuitive applications and visualizations, adapting effectively to different technical backgrounds and communication styles
* build trusted client relationships and represent the engineering team and company professionally
* implement robust error handling, logging, and diagnostics
* ensure solutions meet performance, security, reliability, and compliance requirements
* produce clear technical documentation and solution architecture diagrams.

**your skills and experience**
------------------------------

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field
* we are looking 5 -7 years of practical ignition experience including custom development and integration services.
* strong experience with web ui development concepts: html5, css , javascript, responsive design and modern ui patterns
* proficiency in python scripting for application logic and automation
* solid experience working with sql databases and relational data models
* experience integrating external systems using rest apis or web services
* ability to design maintainable, modular software — not just single-purpose screens
* hands-on experience with scada/hmi systems and live industrial data
* experience configuring and troubleshooting opc connections, tags, and historian data
* ability to understand equipment, controls, production workflows, and real-time operational requirements
* experience with ignition, kepware, canary, or comparable technologies strongly preferred customer & manufacturing aptitude
* comfortable working independently in an active industrial environment to understand equipment, processes, and user needs firsthand
* able to communicate effectively with operators, maintenance trades, engineers, supervisors, and management strong judgment, interpersonal maturity, and ability to build trust with users of widely varying technical backgrounds
* able to translate loosely-defined operational problems into practical, intuitive digital solutions.
* ability to travel 25% to client site in va.

the base compensation range for this role in the posted location is: $53,580 - $122,400.

these may include, but are not limited to: geographic location, education and qualifications, certifications and licenses, relevant experience and skills, seniority and performance, market and business consideration, internal pay equity.
  
it is not typical for candidates to be hired at or near the top of the posted compensation range.
  
in addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for additional compensation such as variable incentives, bonuses, or commissions, depending on the position and applicable laws.

* paid time off based on employee grade (a-f), defined by policy: vacation: 12-25 days, depending on grade, company paid holidays, personal days, sick leave

description:
**benefits:**

**who we are**

zero impact solutions is an end-to-end renewable energy provider. we design, finance, build and maintain ev charging, fleet electrification, solar microgrid, battery energy storage and hydroponic systems for commercial and enterprise clients – and we handle every step in-house: sales, provisioning, design and engineering, contracting and construction, servicing and maintenance. we are a licensed c-10 contractor with construction crews across california, and our projects are backed by state and utility incentive programs (such as calevip, utility make-ready programs and lcfs credits) that provide a steady, reliable flow of revenue.

we are growing fast and we run lean. if you want to work on real infrastructure with a small, fast-moving team – and you like using technology to get more done – we want to speak with you.

**the role**

the sales admin is the operational engine behind our sales team. you own the systems, data and project cadence that turn a signed proposal into a funded, permitted and built project: keeping our crm accurate, our rebate applications on schedule, our customers informed, and our sales reps focused on selling.

this is not a clerical position. we are looking for someone who thinks like a business analyst, works like a project manager, and uses ai tools every day to work faster. you will support deal flow directly (proposals, quotes, customer follow-up), manage a caseload of active projects across sales, engineering, incentives and construction, and continuously improve how the sales organization operates.

**how your time is spent:** sales support & deal flow (40%) · project management (35%) · crm, data & ai-driven process improvement (25%)

**what you'll do**

**sales support & deal flow** *(40%)*

* build and send proposals, quotes and follow-up materials for the sales team; keep proposal templates, pricing sheets and collateral current.
* qualify inbound leads, schedule discovery calls and site assessments, and keep the pipeline moving with timely, professional follow-up by phone and email.
* prepare rfp/rfq and bid responses: track requirements, assemble documents, coordinate inputs from engineering and construction, and submit on time.
* prepare, submit and track incentive and rebate applications (calevip, utility make-ready programs, lcfs registration) – these deadlines directly affect revenue.
* support contract execution: assemble agreements, route for signature, collect site documentation, and hand projects off cleanly to engineering and construction.
* serve as a point of contact for customers, utilities and partners during the sales-to-construction transition.

**project management** *(35%)*

* own a caseload of active projects from signed proposal through construction kickoff; maintain milestone schedules, deadlines and current status for each.
* run weekly status reviews with sales, engineering, incentives and construction; publish clear status reports and action items.
* track risks, issues and dependencies (permits, utility interconnection, rebate approvals, equipment lead times) and escalate early.
* keep project trackers, documentation and dashboards accurate in salesforce and smartsheet so leadership always knows where every deal stands.

**crm, data & ai-driven process improvement** *(25%)*

* administer and improve our salesforce crm: data accuracy, custom fields, validation rules, record-triggered flows, reports and dashboards.
* use ai tools daily (chatgpt, claude, microsoft copilot, salesforce einstein) to draft proposals and customer communications, summarize rfps and program guidelines, research prospects, and clean and analyze data.
* automate repetitive work with salesforce flows, smartsheet automations, zapier/power automate or simple scripts – and measure the time saved.
* build and maintain sales and pipeline reporting (conversion rates, proposal turnaround, rebate status, project aging) in salesforce, excel or power bi.
* document business processes, own the sales playbook, and propose and implement improvements.
* other duties as assigned.

**what you bring**

* **experience:** 1–3+ years in sales operations, sales support, business analysis, crm administration or project coordination. strong recent graduates with substantial internship or project experience are encouraged to apply.

  

* **sales skills:** comfortable on the phone and in front of customers; writes clear, persuasive proposals and emails; follows up relentlessly and keeps commitments.

  

* **project management:** has managed multiple concurrent projects with real deadlines; knows how to run a status meeting, maintain a schedule, and track risks and action items. familiar with agile/scrum or traditional methods and tools such as jira, smartsheet, ms project, asana or monday.

  

* **ai fluency:** uses generative ai as part of daily work – prompting, drafting, summarizing, analysis – and can show examples of using ai to work faster or automate a workflow.

  

* **crm:** hands-on salesforce experience; admin-level skills preferred (flows, reports and dashboards, data loader, user and permission management). hubspot or similar considered.

  

* **data:** advanced excel/google sheets (pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas); dashboards in power bi, tableau or salesforce; sql is a plus.

  

* **communication:** excellent written and verbal communication; able to work confidently with customers, utilities, engineers and field crews.

  

* **mindset:** analytical, solution-oriented and organized; handles high-stakes, short-notice problems calmly; thrives in a fast-paced, small-company environment.

  

**nice to have**

* bachelor's degree in business, computer science, analytics, engineering or a related field; mba a plus.
* salesforce administrator certification.
* pmp, capm, pmi-acp or scrum certification
* ai credentials such as pmi's generative ai for project managers, microsoft ai fundamentals or salesforce ai associate.
* experience with process automation, workflow design or light scripting (python, apex, power query).
* experience in ev charging, solar, construction, utilities or another incentive-driven industry.
* startup or small-team experience.

**why this role**

you will see the whole business – sales, incentives, engineering and construction – and own the systems that connect them. people who succeed in this seat grow into sales, sales operations or project management roles as we scale.

**to apply:** send your resume and a short note describing one workflow you automated or one way you use ai in your work today.
