title: Sales Admin
description:
**benefits:**

* health insurance
* opportunity for advancement
* paid time off
* training & development
* dental insurance

**who we are**

zero impact solutions is an end-to-end renewable energy provider. we design, finance, build and maintain ev charging, fleet electrification, solar microgrid, battery energy storage and hydroponic systems for commercial and enterprise clients – and we handle every step in-house: sales, provisioning, design and engineering, contracting and construction, servicing and maintenance. we are a licensed c-10 contractor with construction crews across california, and our projects are backed by state and utility incentive programs (such as calevip, utility make-ready programs and lcfs credits) that provide a steady, reliable flow of revenue.

we are growing fast and we run lean. if you want to work on real infrastructure with a small, fast-moving team – and you like using technology to get more done – we want to speak with you.

**the role**

the sales admin is the operational engine behind our sales team. you own the systems, data and project cadence that turn a signed proposal into a funded, permitted and built project: keeping our crm accurate, our rebate applications on schedule, our customers informed, and our sales reps focused on selling.

this is not a clerical position. we are looking for someone who thinks like a business analyst, works like a project manager, and uses ai tools every day to work faster. you will support deal flow directly (proposals, quotes, customer follow-up), manage a caseload of active projects across sales, engineering, incentives and construction, and continuously improve how the sales organization operates.

**how your time is spent:** sales support & deal flow (40%) · project management (35%) · crm, data & ai-driven process improvement (25%)

**what you'll do**

**sales support & deal flow** *(40%)*

* build and send proposals, quotes and follow-up materials for the sales team; keep proposal templates, pricing sheets and collateral current.
* qualify inbound leads, schedule discovery calls and site assessments, and keep the pipeline moving with timely, professional follow-up by phone and email.
* prepare rfp/rfq and bid responses: track requirements, assemble documents, coordinate inputs from engineering and construction, and submit on time.
* prepare, submit and track incentive and rebate applications (calevip, utility make-ready programs, lcfs registration) – these deadlines directly affect revenue.
* support contract execution: assemble agreements, route for signature, collect site documentation, and hand projects off cleanly to engineering and construction.
* serve as a point of contact for customers, utilities and partners during the sales-to-construction transition.

**project management** *(35%)*

* own a caseload of active projects from signed proposal through construction kickoff; maintain milestone schedules, deadlines and current status for each.
* run weekly status reviews with sales, engineering, incentives and construction; publish clear status reports and action items.
* track risks, issues and dependencies (permits, utility interconnection, rebate approvals, equipment lead times) and escalate early.
* keep project trackers, documentation and dashboards accurate in salesforce and smartsheet so leadership always knows where every deal stands.

**crm, data & ai-driven process improvement** *(25%)*

* administer and improve our salesforce crm: data accuracy, custom fields, validation rules, record-triggered flows, reports and dashboards.
* use ai tools daily (chatgpt, claude, microsoft copilot, salesforce einstein) to draft proposals and customer communications, summarize rfps and program guidelines, research prospects, and clean and analyze data.
* automate repetitive work with salesforce flows, smartsheet automations, zapier/power automate or simple scripts – and measure the time saved.
* build and maintain sales and pipeline reporting (conversion rates, proposal turnaround, rebate status, project aging) in salesforce, excel or power bi.
* document business processes, own the sales playbook, and propose and implement improvements.
* other duties as assigned.

**what you bring**

* **experience:** 1–3+ years in sales operations, sales support, business analysis, crm administration or project coordination. strong recent graduates with substantial internship or project experience are encouraged to apply.

  

* **sales skills:** comfortable on the phone and in front of customers; writes clear, persuasive proposals and emails; follows up relentlessly and keeps commitments.

  

* **project management:** has managed multiple concurrent projects with real deadlines; knows how to run a status meeting, maintain a schedule, and track risks and action items. familiar with agile/scrum or traditional methods and tools such as jira, smartsheet, ms project, asana or monday.

  

* **ai fluency:** uses generative ai as part of daily work – prompting, drafting, summarizing, analysis – and can show examples of using ai to work faster or automate a workflow.

  

* **crm:** hands-on salesforce experience; admin-level skills preferred (flows, reports and dashboards, data loader, user and permission management). hubspot or similar considered.

  

* **data:** advanced excel/google sheets (pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas); dashboards in power bi, tableau or salesforce; sql is a plus.

  

* **communication:** excellent written and verbal communication; able to work confidently with customers, utilities, engineers and field crews.

  

* **mindset:** analytical, solution-oriented and organized; handles high-stakes, short-notice problems calmly; thrives in a fast-paced, small-company environment.

  

**nice to have**

* bachelor's degree in business, computer science, analytics, engineering or a related field; mba a plus.
* salesforce administrator certification.
* pmp, capm, pmi-acp or scrum certification
* ai credentials such as pmi's generative ai for project managers, microsoft ai fundamentals or salesforce ai associate.
* experience with process automation, workflow design or light scripting (python, apex, power query).
* experience in ev charging, solar, construction, utilities or another incentive-driven industry.
* startup or small-team experience.

**why this role**

you will see the whole business – sales, incentives, engineering and construction – and own the systems that connect them. people who succeed in this seat grow into sales, sales operations or project management roles as we scale.

**to apply:** send your resume and a short note describing one workflow you automated or one way you use ai in your work today.

title: Senior Business Analyst (Finance & Sales)
description:
**about nebius:**

nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global ai economy. we are building a full-stack ai cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house ai/ml infrastructure.

built by engineers, for engineers. from large-scale gpu orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied ai.

listed on nasdaq (nbis) and headquartered in amsterdam, we have a global footprint with r&d hubs across europe, the uk, north america and israel. our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and ai r&d.

### **about tavily (acquired by nebius)**

in a rapidly evolving world, trust in ai depends on ai agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. search is the foundation that makes this possible.  
  
tavily provides the search and intelligence layer that powers ai agents and retrieval systems with trustworthy, real-time information. we work with some of the most innovative teams in ai, from fast-growing startups to global enterprises, helping them build agents that are not only intelligent, but informed.

### **the role**

we're looking for a business analyst to partner closely with our finance and sales teams and turn data into decisions. you'll be the owner of the company's most important metrics: revenue (arr/mrr), bookings, pipeline, conversion, net revenue retention, gross margin and more. beyond reporting the numbers, you'll uncover the drivers behind them, build the analyses that shape planning and go-to-market strategy, and help leadership answer the critical questions:  
this is a high-ownership, hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in a board-deck conversation as in a sql editor, and who ships analysis that changes what the business does next.

**your responsibilities will include:**

* own the company's core business metrics end-to-end: define them, build the single source of truth, and make sure finance, sales, and leadership are all looking at the same numbers.
* partner with finance on revenue recognition, forecasting, budgeting, and board/investor reporting; turn usage and billing data into reliable financial views.
* partner with sales on pipeline health, funnel conversion, win/loss, sales cycle, quota attainment, territory and segment performance, and compensation analytics.
* proactively monitor key business metrics, investigate trends and anomalies, and surface actionable insights to stakeholders before they ask.
* build and maintain revenue and pipeline models that connect product usage and billing data.
* write production-quality sql and python to model data, automate recurring reporting, and run analyses at scale.
* translate findings into clear recommendations and drive alignment across finance, sales, and leadership.
* support strategic initiatives: pricing and packaging changes, segment strategy, capacity planning, and go-to-market experiments, with before/after impact measurement.

**we expect you to have:**

* 5+ years of experience as an analyst, of which 2+ years of experience as a business analyst, fp&a analyst, revenue/sales operations analyst, or equivalent.
* 2+ years working in a saas company; you understand arr, bookings, nrr, cac, payback, pipeline coverage, and the metrics that drive a saas business.
* hands-on experience supporting finance and/or sales teams, with a track record of owning metric definitions that the company relies on.
* strong sql and comfort working with large, messy datasets across different sources.
* hands-on experience using python for data analysis and data modeling in a production environment.
* bsc in economics / finance / statistics / math / industrial engineering or equivalent.
* familiarity with modern data tooling (snowflake/bigquery, dbt, bi tools like omni/looker/tableau).

**it will be an added bonus if you have:**

* experience at an api-first, developer-focused, usage-based, or plg (product-led growth) company.
* experience with usage-based billing and revenue recognition (stripe, metronome, netsuite).
* experience with crm analytics (hubspot, salesforce) and sales compensation / quota design.
* statistical foundation for experimentation and causal inference.
* experience with airflow or similar orchestration tools.
* mba or msc in a quantitative field.

**key employee benefits in the us:**

* **health insurance:** 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.
* **401(k) plan:** up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.
* **parental leave:** 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.
* **remote work reimbursement:** up to $85/month for mobile and internet.
* **disability & life insurance**: company-paid short-term, long-term and life insurance coverage.

**benefits & perks:**

* competitive compensation
* career growth and learning opportunities
* flexibility and ownership
* collaborative and innovative culture
* opportunity to work on impactful ai projects
* international environment and talented teams

**what's it like to work at nebius:**

fast moving - bold thinking - constant growth - meaningful impact - trust and real ownership - opportunity to shape the future of ai

title: Artificial Intelligence Quality Engineer (Full-time Hybrid, Morrisville, NC Based)
description:
the ai quality engineer is responsible for ensuring the reliability, accuracy, and safety of ai-driven solutions from the earliest stages of development. this role is deeply integrated into the development lifecycle, focusing on building quality products by designing sophisticated evaluation frameworks for llms, agentic systems, and intelligent automation. the ai quality engineer ensures that ai models and ai agents behave predictably, follow complex workflows, and meet the high standards required for clinical and operational healthcare environments.

**this position is full-time hybrid. selected candidate must come into the home office in morrisville on wednesdays, for business meeting as needed, reside within 50 miles of morrisville north carolina.**

**responsibilities & duties**

ai evaluation & framework design

* design and implement scalable ai quality engineering strategies supporting llm solutions, agentic systems, and enterprise ai platforms
* develop and maintain ai evaluation frameworks, including the creation of validation datasets, quality scoring methodologies, and automated testing workflows
* execute advanced evaluation techniques, including running llm-as-judge, code-based, and multi-turn evaluators on real production traces
* calibrate llm judges to ensure their assessments align with human expert preferences and clinical accuracy
* drive model and prompt optimization by helping the team determine the most effective system prompts and optimal model selections for specific use cases

agentic system validation & regression testing

* perform side-by-side performance analysis to quantify how changes to agent components impact overall performance, ensuring updates do not introduce regressions
* trace full agentic runs and conversations to visualize every step an agent takes, utilizing distributed tracing and specialized ai assistants (e.g., polly) to pinpoint failure modes
* identify usage patterns and common failure modes using insights agents to provide executive-level summaries of system reliability

collaborative development & human-in-the-loop (hitl)

* partner with ai engineering, aiops, and security from the beginning of the development cycle to build quality into the architecture
* enable subject matter experts (smes) (clinical, operational, and data teams) to review agent outputs and annotate traces, fostering a robust human-in-the-loop validation process
* collaborate across agile delivery teams to coordinate testing activities, including sprint planning, defect management, and release readiness

observability & runtime reliability

* support runtime reliability by integrating quality controls with observability tools, monitoring for model drift, and assisting in incident response
* leverage telemetry and distributed tracing to ensure ai-enabled systems maintain high availability and performance in production environments

**minimum requirements**

education & experience

bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, artificial intelligence, or a related field from an accredited college or university, and three (3) years of experience developing, implementing, and deploying software, machine learning, and/or artificial intelligence solutions. experience must include integrating, deploying, monitoring, and maintaining ai/ml models and/or third-party ai/ml tools within production environments for internal business operations and/or customer-facing applications.

at least two (2) years of experience utilizing python and related machine learning and artificial intelligence libraries and frameworks to develop, test, deploy, and support ai/ml solutions is required.

**knowledge, skills, & abilities**

* ai quality engineering & evaluation: designing and executing ai-native testing approaches, including llm-as-judge, code-based evaluators, and multi-turn evaluators for agentic systems.
* agentic & generative ai validation: evaluating the reasoning, tool-use, and workflow reliability of agentic workflows and large language models (llms) using both proprietary and open-source models.
* ai observability & tracing: using platforms like langsmith for distributed tracing, monitoring agent runs, and analyzing production traces to identify failure modes.
* advanced programming & frameworks: python and libraries used for automated testing and evaluation.
* rag & vector database evaluation: validating retrieval-augmented generation (rag) architectures.
* llmops & lifecycle management: managing prompt configurations, evaluation pipelines, and version control for models, prompts, and outputs to ensure consistency and prevent regressions.
* ai-augmented productivity: ability to utilize ai tools (github copilot) to accelerate testing automation, documentation, and quality engineering tasks.
* technical communication & leadership: ability to translate complex ai performance metrics and evaluation findings into actionable insights for clinical, operational, and engineering stakeholders.

**employment for this position is contingent upon a satisfactory background check and credit check, which will be performed after acceptance of an offer of employment and prior to the employee's start date.**

**salary range**

$107,607-$137,198/annually

  

**exact compensation will be determined based on the candidate's education, experience, external market data and consideration of internal equity.**  
*an excellent fringe benefit package accompanies the salary, which includes:*

* *medical, dental, vision, life, long term disability*
* *generous retirement savings plan*
* *flexible work schedules including hybrid/remote options*

**position highlights**

the mel and enid zuckerman college of public health (mezcph) invites applicants to apply to join our team as an applications development programmer analyst i (temporary). primary responsibilities include work on i-detect, a one health participatory surveillance platform where community members report health events in people, animals and the environment, for early detection of public health threats. the front-end engineer builds the parts of i-detect that participants and health departments see and use, from registration and reporting to maps and weekly reports. the role works with the product owner to turn user stories into wireframes and working screens.

the university of arizona has been recognized for our innovative work-life programs.

  

**duties & responsibilities**

* develop and maintain front-end and back-end components of the i-detect web and/or mobile platform.
* build functionality to support the collection, management, processing, and visualization of self-reported participatory surveillance data.
* develop and maintain databases, apis, dashboards, user interfaces, and other system components required by the platform.
* translate functional requirements, wireframes, and user feedback into working software features.
* conduct software testing, troubleshoot technical issues, identify and resolve bugs, and perform ongoing quality assurance.
* support integration of external data sources, apis, mapping tools, analytics, and other technologies as required.
* implement appropriate data security, privacy, access-control, and secure coding practices, particularly for community-reported health information.
* optimize the platform for performance, reliability, usability, accessibility, and scalability.
* document source code, system architecture, apis, development processes, testing procedures, and technical decisions to support continuity and future development.
* use version control and established software development practices to manage code changes, releases, and deployments.
* participate in regular project meetings, demonstrations, code reviews, and development planning with supervising faculty and the broader project team.
* incorporate feedback from faculty, public health subject-matter experts, users, and other stakeholders into iterative improvements to the platform.
* support deployment, maintenance, updates, and troubleshooting of the platform throughout the project lifecycle.
* perform other software development and technical duties related to i-detect as assigned by the supervising faculty.

knowledge, skills and abilities:

* knowledge of accessible and responsive web design (wcag) for users with different devices, languages and levels of digital literacy.
* skill in building participant-facing features with html, css and javascript, such as registration, reporting forms, weekly reports and interactive maps.
* skill in turning user stories into wireframes and working screens, including with ai-assisted design and coding tools.
* ability to design for privacy, with clear consent screens and views that show each user only the data their role and jurisdiction allow.
* ability to test the interface with participants and health department staff and improve it based on their feedback.
* knowledge of api design, authentication and role-based access control, including rules for sharing data across state, county, city and tribal jurisdictions.
* knowledge of privacy practices for health data, such as de-identification under hipaa safe harbor, and how to apply them in database and api design.
* skill in designing postgresql schemas that bring together human, animal and environmental reports, including location data.
* skill in building and evaluating llm services with checks for accuracy and verifiable sources before results reach public health users.
* ability to write tested, documented code and to review code from teammates and ai coding assistants.
* knowledge of aws services for hosting and protecting a web application (e.g., ec2, s3, iam and backups), and of docker compose deployments on linux.
* knowledge of security and compliance practices for health data, including encryption, access logs, least-privilege access and de-identification (hipaa safe harbor).

* skill in setting clear rules for how ai coding agents (e.g., codex) access the codebase, and how their changes are reviewed, tested and merged.
* ability to lead the team technically: set coding and documentation standards, review pull requests, mentor developers and turn user stories into technical specifications.
* ability to plan and estimate work with the product owner in weekly sprints.

* experience building interactive maps (e.g., mapbox or leaflet).

title: Data Scientist II
description:
**company description**

since opening our first self-storage facility in 1972, **public storage** has grown to become the **largest owner and operator of self-storage facilities** in the world. with **thousands of locations** across the u.s. and europe, and more than 170 million net rentable square feet of real estate, we're also one of the largest landlords.

we've been recognized as **a great place to work** by the great place to work institute. and, our employees have also voted us as having **best career growth**, ranked us in the **top 5% for work culture**, and in the **top 10% for diversity and inclusion**.

we're a member of the **s&p 500** and **ft global 500**. our common and preferred stocks trade on the new york stock exchange.

public storage is the nation’s leading self-storage provider, recognized for its iconic orange doors and commitment to delivering simple, reliable solutions to millions of customers across the country. we are expanding our creative team to enhance our consistent and engaging visual brand presence.

 **job description**

at public storage, data science sits right next to the decisions. prices move every day across thousands of locations, and our models help decide them. as a data scientist ii, you’ll be the go-to data scientist for one part of the business: customer and revenue, capital allocation (acquisitions, development and finance), or operations. you’ll be part of their planning, shape the questions, and build the models they rely on.

we’re a small, senior team that works like a startup inside an s&p 500 company. ideas get to production quickly, you own your work, and it shows up in the business rather than in a slide deck.

*what you’ll do*

* **build and own production models.** pricing and elasticity, promotions, marketing effectiveness, demand forecasting, retention, lifetime value and recommendation. you’ll write production-grade python and sql, and use llms, embeddings and rag where they’re the right tool.
* **be the data science partner for your business area.** join their planning, turn ambiguous questions into well-scoped problems, and present results as decisions and dollars, not model metrics.
* **run experiments that change what we do.** design and analyze a/b tests, holdouts and quasi-experiments. set the success metric before launch and report the honest result after it.
* **build once, reuse everywhere.** work from our shared customer and real estate data and certified metrics, and add reusable models to a shared catalog so the next problem starts faster.
* **grow the team around you.** mentor analysts and junior scientists through code review and pairing, and back up a teammate’s business area when needed.
* **own the full model lifecycle.** versioning, retraining, drift monitoring and documentation, meeting our model governance standards before anything goes live.

*what success looks like*

* business partners depend on your models every week.
* your experiments change what the company does, not just what it knows.
* junior scientists get better because of your code reviews.

  
**qualifications**  

* bachelor’s degree in a stem or quantitative field, such as statistics, computer science, economics, engineering or applied mathematics.
* 3+ years in a production data science role, or 2+ years with a master’s, or 1+ year with a phd.
* strong sql and python in production settings, not notebooks alone.
* applied statistics in both frequentist and bayesian frameworks, plus experimental design and causal inference.
* a track record of shipping models that drove measurable business outcomes.
* experience with a cloud data platform. google cloud and bigquery preferred; snowflake, aws or azure considered.
* able to turn an ambiguous business question into a scoped problem, and explain uncertainty and trade-offs to non-technical partners.

*preferred*

* 5+ years of production data science in pricing, revenue management, marketing, real estate, retail or consumer analytics.
* the modern ml stack: scikit-learn, xgboost/lightgbm, pytorch, pymc, prophet, and experiment tracking with mlflow or vertex ai.
* mlops experience: model registries, ci/cd, scheduled retraining and monitoring.
* dbt and orchestration tools such as airflow or cloud composer.
* hands-on experience with llm applications, vector search, rag or agentic ai workflows.

  
**additional information**

**workplace**

* one of our values pillars is to work as one team and we believe that there is no replacement for in-person collaboration but understand the value of some flexibility. public storage teammates are expected to work in the office five days each week with the option to take up to three flexible remote days per month.

public storage is an equal opportunity employer and embraces diversity. we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

\*\*sponsorship for work authorization is not available for this posting. candidates must be authorized to work in the u.s. without restrictions or requiring sponsorship now or in the future. we do not provide training plans or support for f-1 opt, stem opt extensions, or future visa sponsorship.\*\*

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
localize (https://localizejs.com/) is seeking a senior devops / platform engineer to join our growing product engineering team. as localize expands, the scalability, reliability, and performance of our infrastructure and applications have become paramount. as a critical member of our product engineering team, you will own and improve localize's technical infrastructure, databases, and platform tooling, including monitoring, alerting, and maintenance. your scope extends beyond delivering product tickets: you will strengthen the software development lifecycle (sdlc) and be responsible for the scalability, stability, reliability, performance, and security of the localize platform.

you will partner closely with leadership and fellow product engineers to translate business priorities and customer needs into execution, remove obstacles, and make thoughtful tradeoffs that keep the team moving forward. like every product engineer at localize, you are expected to be customer-obsessed and business-aligned: connect technical decisions to customer trust, product quality, and business outcomes. this role reports directly to the engineering manager.

**key responsibilities:**

* oversee and manage localize's infrastructure across aws and cloudflare.
* ensure the scalability, reliability, performance, and security of localize's data stores, specifically redis and mongodb, through effective configuration, monitoring, query optimization, and backup management.
* own and improve deployment ~~process.~~and release processes, emphasizing automation, repeatability, safe rollouts, and reliable rollback procedures.
* partner with product engineers to improve the full sdlc, including development environments, ci/cd, automated quality and security checks, and release readiness. treat this work as a core engineering responsibility alongside product delivery.
* take a leading role in infrastructure security and soc 2 type ii compliance, partnering with engineering leadership and compliance stakeholders to operate and improve technical controls, maintain audit-ready evidence, support audits, and remediate findings. responsibilities include access management, vulnerability management, change management, logging, and backup and recovery controls.
* help lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews, translating lessons into improvements that protect customers and reduce recurring operational risk.
* prioritize infrastructure and sdlc improvements based on customer impact, business priorities, and risk. communicate tradeoffs clearly and assess results through reliability, delivery speed, security, and cost-efficiency.
* own and improve monitoring of uptime and performance using tools such as datadog, clickhouse, hyperdx, and more
* identify, plan and implement improvements and optimizations for infrastructure regarding cost, reliability, scalability.
* develop and maintain detailed documentation and maps of our infrastructure and dependencies.
* actively learn new technologies and systems to improve the efficiency and capabilities of our infrastructure.

technologies

*experience with the specific technologies below is a plus unless listed under must-have skills. security and compliance, including support for soc 2 type ii, are core responsibilities of this role—not optional areas of involvement.*

* aws: elastic beanstalk, sqs, cloudfront, ec2, elasticache, route 53, vps
* platforms: kubernetes, aws beanstalk, argocd, github actions
* languages: terragrunt, opentofu, terraform
* monitoring: clickhouse, datadog, hyperdx, grafana
* security & compliance: soc2 type ii
* cloudflare dns, workers, zero trust (warp)
* business intelligence: stitch, metabase, snowflake
* application technology: mongodb (atlas + cloud manager), typescript, react

**must-have skills:**

* 5+ years engineering experience. at least 4 years of experience in a devops role.
* expertise in managing and optimizing infrastructure in aws.
* redis and mongodb, including configuration, monitoring, optimization, and management of backups.
* expertise in infrastructure as code (iac) tools opentofu and terragrunt
* experience with manual or automated deployment & release management.
* understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment (ci/cd) processes and tools.
* hands-on experience securing production infrastructure, including least-privilege access controls, vulnerability remediation, secrets management, and security monitoring.
* ability to translate security and compliance requirements into repeatable engineering practices, maintain evidence of control operation, and support soc 2 type ii audit readiness and remediation.
* experience partnering with product engineers to improve the sdlc and balance feature delivery with reliability, security, and developer productivity.
* a customer-obsessed, business-aligned approach: understand how infrastructure decisions affect customers, prioritize work by impact, and explain technical tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* skills in assessing and optimizing performance of infrastructure and applications for improved performance, reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
* proficiency in command line scripting
* disaster recovery planning including data integrity and availability in case of emergencies.
* experience with apm and logging tools such as datadog, new relic, sentry, or kibana.

**nice-to-have skills or experience:**

* product engineering languages and frameworks such as typescript, react, mongoose, less, and more
* applied llm engineering:
  + hands-on experience integrating llms into production systems (openai, anthropic, gemini, or similar)
  + strong understanding of prompt engineering, context engineering, and token management
  + experience designing or implementing rag pipelines, embeddings, and vector search
  + familiarity with emerging llm infrastructure patterns and protocols (e.g., mcp, tool/function calling, agents)
* working in a fast-paced environment where you're accountable for your work and you're passionate in working with customers

**benefits & perks:**

you'll be joining a close knit and talented team, with plenty of opportunity for professional growth. we offer compensation + benefits that are on par with large companies, while also placing a high value on maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

* competitive salary
* 401(k) plan + 4% matching
* 100% company-paid health, dental, and vision insurance
* company-paid life insurance and ad&d insurance
* work anywhere in north america (we are 100% remote)
* new macbook (or computer of your choice)
* monthly stipend for home internet costs
* generous pto package

**about localize:**

the localize platform is used by 700+ companies to automate the translation of their web and mobile applications and bring their products & services to new markets at record speed. we support organizations like the bay area toll authority (https://www.bayareatollpaymentplan.org/s/) in translating their payments website, baptist health (https://www.baptistjax.com/) in making their healthcare site multilingual, and the massachusetts department of elementary and secondary education (https://www.doe.mass.edu/) in offering their content in several languages. to see our product in action, click any of those links and use the website's language switcher to switch from english to another language.

localize works by providing a code snippet (similar to the google analytics javascript snippet) that our customers add to their website/web app. the localize snippet pulls in content from the page into the localize dashboard where our customers log in to add translations and manage their content. localize automatically deploys those translations to the customer's production site, reducing development costs and accelerating time to market.

we are a team of ~30 people working fully remote. we offer competitive pay, a full benefits package, and a culture with an emphasis on work + life balance.

**to apply:**

along with your resume, send us a cover letter that showcases your personality and tells us why we should hire you. previous experience working in a remote position is a must.

*this position is only open to applicants who reside in and are eligible to work in the us.*

title: Data and Analytics Architect
description:
at orion180, we don’t just stand out for what we do; we shine because of how we do it. our mission is to deliver an exceptional insurance experience through innovative technology, unparalleled customer service, and a comprehensive suite of products. our vision is to be the premier global provider of insurance solutions and redefine the insurance industry.

orion180 is proud to call three vibrant cities home. our headquarters on florida’s stunning space coast in melbourne offers an exceptional quality of life, with affordable housing, excellent transportation, and close proximity to major cities like orlando, tampa, and miami. our irving, texas, office places us in a dynamic center of culture, business, and entertainment, keeping us closely connected to innovation and growth. our draper, utah, location, nestled in the heart of the salt lake valley, connects us to a rapidly growing tech ecosystem and provides access to the outdoor lifestyle and natural beauty the region is known for.

**about the role:**

we believe analytics isn't a back-office function. it's not a reporting layer bolted onto the business after the real decisions get made. it's the foundation that tells you where risk actually lives, where growth is hiding, and where you're missing opportunities before it's too late to do anything about it.

that belief is driving real investment in our people, platforms, and in how deeply analytics is woven into the way we operate. from underwriting to distribution to customer experience, we're building a data culture where insight drives action.

it also means evolving how we think about the role of a data and analytics architect.

the expectation isn’t just technical execution. it’s curiosity. ownership. the ability to step into ambiguity, frame the problem, and help guide the business toward better decisions.

**what you’ll do:**

in this role you will be designing and governing scalable data platforms on the microsoft cloud. key responsibilities include bridging the gap between complex core insurance systems (policy admin, claims, billing) and our analytical consumers, implementing data lakehouse architectures, ensuring data governance, and leading cloud migrations and platform integrations. ideal candidates require expert-level proficiency in azure data services and data modeling. you will collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business leaders to turn raw data into scalable, production-ready assets for real-time analytics engines, portfolio risk platforms, and client-facing digital products.

**data architecture & modeling**

* design secure, scalable, and resilient data architectures using the medallion (bronze/silver/gold) pattern and **delta lake** pattern in close partnership with the enterprise innovation & technology (i & t) organization.
* lead physical and logical data modeling efforts across relational, dimensional (kimball / star schema), and data vault methodologies.
* develop high-performance data processing logic using pyspark, spark sql, and python on **azure databricks** and synapse analytics.
* define data abstraction layers ensuring third-party saas and legacy databases map cleanly to machine-readable schemas for efficient and measurable consumption.
* architect secure, scalable model context protocol (mcp) servers and gateways to connect llms and ai agents to internal analytical data repositories.

**platform & engineering standards**

* establish architectural patterns and best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and pipeline orchestration.
* evaluate, benchmark, and recommend components of our modern data stack in alignment with i & t’s strategy and be an active participant/contributor to the architecture review board.
* work closely with data engineers to conduct architecture reviews and mentor engineers on scalability and pipeline efficiency.
* architect semantic layer solutions and data product structures to power self-service power bi implementations.
* architect high-throughput batch and streaming pipelines to ingest structured transactional policy/claims data as well as unstructured data (e.g., adjuster loss notes, fnol images, aerial and satellite imagery surveys).
* collaborate with data science and machine learning teams to ensure clean, structured feature stores and data pipelines for future ml models and applications.

**governance, quality & security**

* implement automated data quality monitoring, data lineage tracking, and metadata management frameworks across the data lifecycle.
* partner with the enterprise technology and security and compliance teams to enforce role-based access control (rbac), data masking, and compliance standards (soc 2, gdpr, ccpa).

**architectural leadership**

* partner with the i & t architecture team to build and optimize complex etl/elt workflows utilizing **azure data factory** and **microsoft fabric data pipelines.**
* work closely with data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to deploy ai/ml models and business intelligence solutions (e.g., power bi).

**what we’re looking for:**

* **education:**
* bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
* united states citizen or green card holder required.

**experience:**

* 7+ years in enterprise data architecture with demonstrated expertise in leading data platform initiatives and modernizing data estates.
* expert in **azure data lake storage gen2**, **azure synapse analytics**, **azure databricks**, **azure data factory**, and **microsoft fabric**.
* strong knowledge of relational and nosql systems like **azure sql database** and **azure cosmos db**.
* experience designing real-time architecture using **azure event hubs** and **stream analytics.**
* high proficiency in **python**, **sql**, **pyspark**, and **spark sql**.
* ability to integrate **geospatial** data types and visualization platforms for location intelligence that removes data fragmentation and technical bottlenecks.
* preferred credentials include **microsoft certified: azure data engineer associate** or **azure solutions architect expert.**

**skills & attributes:**

* excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* strong communication and collaboration abilities across technical and non-technical teams.
* ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, results-driven environment

***this position is 100% onsite in our irving, tx location***

we are interested in candidates who are developing capabilities aligned with modern, forward-looking analytics practices. this includes experience or familiarity with semantic data modeling and governed metric layers, working within scalable cloud data platforms (e.g., snowflake, databricks), and integrating analytics within broader data engineering workflows. exposure to emerging capabilities such as ai-assisted analysis, automated insight generation, and advanced data visualization techniques is highly valued.

**what’s in it for you:**

**join our team & make an impact!** at orion180, we don’t just meet expectations, we exceed them. if you’re ready to take your career to the next level and be part of a growing, forward-thinking company, apply today!

* dynamic environment: on-site role with a fast-paced and collaborative team culture. results-driven office where your contributions make a real impact.
* compensation: competitive base pay and performance bonuses.
* career growth: mentorship, growth tracks, and professional development.
* benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401k, paid holidays, pto and more!

the office environment is fast-paced and collaborative. an employee must be willing and able to work their regularly assigned work schedule onsite, and in times of need, be able to work an extended schedule depending on company or departmental needs, project requirements, or customer demands.

while performing general duties for this position, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, and/or walk around (including the use of stairs). other demands include the ability to openly communicate with others by talking, listening, comprehending, and reading; being able to lift light objects (<25 lbs); and using standard office equipment such as computers, printers, and phones. in addition, there is an occasional need to bend, twist, or squat down to open/close cabinets and reach for files or other standard office-type objects.

orion180 is an equal opportunity employer. all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities during the application process. applicants who need accommodations may email hr@orion180.com to request assistance.

at icf our digital modernization division is an information technology and management consulting organization that delivers integrated, strategic solutions to federal clients. we bring expertise in cloud, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, data modernization, and digital transformation to support mission-critical government programs.

the ml ops engineer will develop and maintain machine learning pipelines, model registries, deployment frameworks, monitoring solutions, and automated workflows that support enterprise ai initiatives. working closely with data scientists, data engineers, cloud architects, platform engineers, and trustworthy ai stakeholders, this role enables the successful operationalization of machine learning capabilities across cloud-based environments.

* design, build, and maintain production-grade mlops pipelines for model training, evaluation, validation, registration, deployment, monitoring, retraining, rollback, and retirement.

title: US- Java Engineer - Pricing
description:
at moneygram, we're combining the strength of a trusted global brand with the agility of a tech-forward, growth driven culture. with 85+ years of experience and a presence in more than 200 countries and territories, we've built a foundation of stability and trust to help millions of people around the world send funds quickly, securely, and affordably.

if you're eager to shape the future of cross-border payments and financial services, join us as we transform how the world moves money.
  
  
**about the role & team culture:**  
we are looking for strong engineering and product professionals who excel in a dynamic environment. at moneygram, we value engineers who can navigate ambiguity without waiting for direction and take ownership of outcomes rather than simply completing tasks. in this role, you will be expected to make sound decisions using available information, communicate proactively, and balance autonomy with collaboration. we are building a culture where individuals seek solutions rather than assigning blame, always aiming to build trusted relationships across functions while maintaining a steadfast focus on business and customer outcomes over functional wins.
  
  
**job summary:**  
we are seeking a highly skilled a java engineer with 2-5 years of experience to contribute to the design, development, and deployment of our high-volume enterprise applications. in this role, you will architect and build robust, secure, and compliant transactional backend systems, optimize billing/pricing engines, and drive technical excellence. you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to build high-performance, low-latency financial software hosted on aws.
  
  
**core responsibilities:**  

* architect, design, and implement high-availability, fault-tolerant enterprise java applications.
* write clean, secure, and highly optimized code utilizing modern java features to handle large-scale financial transactions.
* design and scale distributed microservices architectures optimized for transactional consistency and speed.
* optimize complex data models, design transactional database schemas, and manage relational and nosql databases.
* build and secure robust apis for seamless third-party financial network integrations and erp connections.
* manage and automate secure cloud-based deployment pipelines using modern devops practices on aws.
* lead code reviews, enforce strict financial security coding standards, and mentor engineering team members.
* identify financial transactional bottlenecks, optimize query performance, and ensure zero-downtime production deployments.

**required technical skills:**  

* core tech: java 17 / java 21, spring boot, spring cloud, hibernate orm, and jpa.
* architecture: microservices, event-driven architecture, cqrs, distributed transactions (saga pattern), and domain-driven design (ddd).
* databases: postgresql, oracle db and couchbase.
* messaging & streaming: apache kafka.
* cloud & devops: aws (highly preferred; experience with azure or gcp is acceptable), docker, kubernetes, and jenkins or gitlab ci.
* testing & tools: junit 5, mockito, testcontainers, automated contract testing, maven, or gradle.

**experience requirements:**  

* minimum 2 to 5 years of professional backend software engineering experience.
* proven track record of working on large-scale distributed systems, enterprise saas products, or transactional banking/financial applications.
* extensive experience building and deploying software within agile/scrum environments.
* demonstrated experience migrating monolithic applications to distributed microservices architectures.

**qualifications & competencies:**  

* bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* strong system-level troubleshooting skills with the ability to make sound decisions using available data.
* self-starter mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity and execute tasks without waiting for step-by-step direction.
* exceptional proactive communication skills to build trusted relationships and influence outcomes across cross-functional teams.
* excellent english written and verbal communication skills

**preferred (good to have) skills:**  

* direct experience building or maintaining complex pricing-related applications, financial billing engines, monetization platforms.
* hands-on technical exposure or integration experience with ouaf framework or oracle revenue management system (ormb).
* familiarity with integrating machine learning models into java backends, using ai apis, or implementing predictive intelligence for financial workflows (e.g., fraud detection, intelligent routing).
* hands-on experience with google cloud platform analytics tools such as bigquery, looker, cloud dataflow, or dataproc for financial data processing.

moneygram is a global payments network built to move money across borders with speed, simplicity and trust. its omnichannel platform empowers consumers, developers and agents to transfer cash, fiat and stablecoin however it works best for them.

description:

bachelor’s degree and four (4) years of related experience or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be considered.

other qualifications

* support enterprise environments including claude, openai, gemini, github, microsoft 365 copilot, cometai, splunk, and related cloud and infrastructure services.
* participate in incident response and on-call activities, using observability data to restore service quickly, document root causes, and implement corrective actions.
* maintain service catalogs, knowledge bases, architecture documentation, monitoring standards, operational procedures, and technical training materials.
* consult with schools and departments, communicate technical concepts to varied audiences, and facilitate workshops on ai, generative ai, and service observability.
* assume technical lead responsibilities, mentor junior engineers, and promote consistent engineering, documentation, and operational practices across the team.
* research emerging ai, machine learning, observability, automation, cloud, and platform engineering technologies and apply relevant advancements to university services.

physical demands and working conditions physical activities working conditions additional information

* knowledge of machine learning techniques, generative ai architectures, large language models, model evaluation, prompt engineering, and responsible ai practices.
* proficiency in python and working knowledge of one or more additional languages or scripting tools such as powershell, bash, r, javascript, or c++.

118,500.00 - 171,825.00

**education**

title: Associate Software Engineer, AI Solutions
description:
the exciting world of scientific research is fueled by people with a passion for solving complex problems. at cayuse, we are committed to our customers' success by empowering organizations to conduct globally connected research that advances their impact on science, discovery and society. we build on that commitment with proven, integrated and easy-to-use technology that delivers exceptional value, and world class service and support that accelerates outcomes.

but we are more than just an empowering platform powered by advanced technologies. we are a collaboration of exceptional, highly skilled people with multi-disciplinary expertise, and are building our team to support our ambitious growth plans. cayuse's foundational strength comes from our customer and employee focused values and commitment to industry-leading solutions. it's an exciting time to become a key member of our growing team.

join our remote first culture as an associate engineer, an entry-level, hands-on engineering role focused on building ai capabilities directly into cayuse products. you will work alongside senior engineers to design, build, test, and ship ai agents, model context protocol (mcp) servers, and llm-powered features that help research institutions and their administrators work faster and with less manual effort. this is not a data science or ml research role. it is a software engineering role for someone early in their career who writes solid code, learns quickly, and wants to grow into a strong ai engineer by shipping real features to real customers.

#### 

#### **responsibilities**

as an associate engineer, you will contribute across the full development cycle of ai-powered product features, with mentorship and code review from senior engineers. success in this role means delivering well-tested, maintainable code, understanding the problems you're solving, applying feedback, and progressively taking on more complex engineering responsibilities.

* **ai agent development:** build and maintain ai agents that use large language models (such as claude) to complete multi-step tasks within cayuse products — calling tools, retrieving data, and taking actions on behalf of users. implement prompts, tool definitions, and orchestration logic under the guidance of senior engineers.
* **mcp server development:** help build and extend model context protocol (mcp) servers that allow ai assistants to securely interact with cayuse products. work with senior engineers to implement tools, apis, authentication, and permission checks using established engineering standards. write clear documentation and tests to ensure these integrations are reliable and reusable.
* **hybrid ai validation:** help turn ai-extracted rules, such as requirements parsed from funding opportunity instructions, into deterministic, auditable validations that run alongside existing form rules and are reviewed by people before use.
* **product integration:** integrate ai features into existing cayuse applications through platform apis. build on the shared capabilities and patterns set by the architecture team instead of one-off implementations, and partner with product teams so ai fits naturally into customer workflows.
* **testing & evaluation:** write unit and integration tests for ai features, and help build evaluation sets that measure the accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost of llm outputs. contribute to time-boxed ai pilots and help document whether each should go, pivot, or stop. investigate failures, identify root causes, and propose fixes.
* **deployment & operations:** ship code through ci/cd pipelines to cloud environments (aws, including amazon bedrock). add logging and monitoring to ai services and help troubleshoot production issues.
* **learning & collaboration:** participate in code reviews, design discussions, and sprint ceremonies. keep current with the fast-moving ai tooling ecosystem and share what you learn with the team.
* **governed ai platform:** develop ai features using cayuse's shared ai platform and established engineering standards. learn how our platform handles model access, security, tenant isolation, usage tracking, and auditing. work with senior engineers to ensure new features follow these patterns rather than introducing one-off solutions.
* **responsible ai & security:** follow established security and privacy standards when developing ai features. learn to recognize and test for risks such as prompt injection, unauthorized data access, and inaccurate ai outputs. work with senior engineers to ensure ai features respect user permissions, protect customer data, and maintain proper tenant isolation. raise potential security or reliability concerns early.

#### **qualifications**

**core experience**

* 0–2 years of professional software development experience, including internships, co-ops, or apprenticeships.
* demonstrated ability to build working software through coursework, internships, personal projects, open-source contributions, or hackathons. a portfolio or github profile is strongly encouraged.
* exposure to team-based development using version control (git), code review, and agile practices.
* bs in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**technical skills**

* **software development:** proficient in at least one general-purpose language (python or typescript/javascript preferred; java with spring boot also valued). solid grasp of data structures, apis, error handling, and writing tests.
* **ai & llm fundamentals:** demonstrated interest in ai technologies and how they can be applied to software development. experience experimenting with llm apis, prompt engineering, tool calling, or retrieval-augmented generation (rag) through coursework or personal projects is a plus. a willingness to learn and understand how these technologies work is more important than prior experience with any specific ai framework.
* **agents & mcp:** familiarity with the model context protocol, agent frameworks, or ai coding assistants (such as claude code or github copilot).
* **apis & integration:** working understanding of rest apis, json, and authentication basics (api keys, oauth).
* **cloud & infrastructure:** exposure to a cloud platform (aws preferred; amazon bedrock a plus), containers (docker), or ci/cd pipelines is a plus.
* **data fluency:** comfortable writing basic sql queries and working with structured data. exposure to snowflake or another cloud data warehouse is a plus.

**collaboration & communication**

* clear communicator — writes readable code, documentation, and pull request descriptions, and raises questions early when blocked.
* strong problem-solving instincts: you break ambiguous tasks into smaller steps and work through them methodically.
* coachable and growth-oriented — you seek out feedback and apply it.
* collaborative and adaptable — effective in a remote-first environment and when coordinating across offshore, nearshore, and onshore teams.
* genuine curiosity about how ai is changing software and knowledge work, paired with practical judgment about where it adds real value.

  

**benefits**

* competitive medical benefits (ppo + hsa available)
* vision, dental, short-term disability fully covered by cayuse
* unlimited pto + holidays + flexible work schedule
* remote work stipend
* equal paid parental leave
* 401k with employer matching

the **senior business data analyst** translates business needs into scalable, high-quality data and analytics solutions.

this is a hands-on senior analytics role combining strong business ownership with technical depth. you will work directly with stakeholders to understand business problems, clarify outcomes and requirements, investigate data, generate insights, and deliver analytical products from discovery through implementation.

you will join the smart infrastructure, asset management software information technology (si ams it) data & ai team and work across sales, marketing, customer success, finance, and other commercial functions. marketing will be an important area of focus, making previous experience in marketing analytics or related commercial domains particularly valuable.

the role offers significant ownership and visibility within a small, collaborative data & ai team. you will work with modern technologies including snowflake, dbt, sql, python, power bi, and qlik, while contributing to the continued evolution of our analytics, data products, and ai capabilities. we expect you to be an early adopter of generative ai, using it to accelerate delivery and expand into adjacent technical areas.

this role is ideal for an experienced analyst who enjoys owning the full analytics lifecycle, from understanding business problems and defining requirements through data modeling, analysis, visualization, and stakeholder adoption.

**you’ll make an impact by**

**business partnership and requirements engineering**

* partner with business stakeholders to understand problems, desired outcomes, success criteria, and business value.
* handle ongoing business requests as a trusted partner, not a ticket taker, focusing on the business need behind each ask.
* translate business needs into clear, actionable data and analytics requirements.
* resolve missing or ambiguous requirements and break larger problems into manageable use cases.
* build strong understanding of assigned business domains, processes, metrics, and business logic.
* lead discovery, solution demonstrations, validation, and business sign off for assigned use cases.
* collaborate with global stakeholders across north america and europe, with core working hours aligned to eastern time business operations.

**data analysis and insight generation**

* extract, combine, analyze, and validate complex datasets using advanced sql and analytical tools.
* identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and actionable business insights.
* apply statistical and analytical methods to support business decisions.
* assess data quality, completeness, and fitness for purpose.
* translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for stakeholders.
* use generative ai tools, such as claude code or gh copilot, to accelerate sql, dbt, and power bi development, and share what works with the team.

**data products and business intelligence**

* design and develop dashboards, visualizations, and analytical products using power bi, qlik, and other relevant tools.
* create intuitive data experiences that enable stakeholders to act on insights.
* contribute to reusable data products, shared metrics, and standardized analytics solutions.
* support use cases across customer segmentation, marketing effectiveness, revenue analytics, retention, and predictive analytics.

**data modeling and technical delivery**

* understand source systems, warehouse structures, data relationships, business definitions, and analytical data models.
* create or adapt analytical data models and transformations for individual use cases.
* work with platforms such as snowflake and tools such as dbt.
* investigate analytical data issues and partner with data engineering on production pipelines and shared models.

**end to end solution ownership**

* own assigned data use cases from initial business problem through delivery, validation, and adoption.
* act as solution lead and coordinate contributions from data engineering, data science, bi, ai, and other specialists.
* proactively manage dependencies, risks, and data availability constraints.
* share knowledge and reduce dependency on individual experts through office hours, training, self-service reporting, and recurring metric deep dives.

**data quality and governance**

* apply established data standards, definitions, governance requirements, and documentation practices.
* identify data quality risks and coordinate resolution with appropriate owners.
* maintain awareness of security, privacy, responsible data usage, and enterprise governance requirements.
* support traceability and consistency of important business metrics and analytical outputs.

**this is how you'll win us over**

* 7+years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* advanced sql skills, including complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, and analytical transformations.
* strong analytical and data modeling capabilities, including experience working with relational data, transformations, data quality, validation, and complex datasets.
* demonstrated experience partnering with business stakeholders to translate business problems into analytical requirements and pragmatic solutions.
* proven track record of uncovering insights through data mining and analysis, and applying business acumen to recommend actions that shaped decisions.
* experience developing dashboards, visualizations, or analytical applications using power bi, qlik, or comparable bi platforms.
* hands-on experience with salesforce or other crm data, such as opportunities, accounts, leads, and campaigns.
* experience working with a modern cloud data platform such as snowflake, databricks, azure, aws, or comparable technologies.
* ability to independently investigate business and data problems and deliver analytical solutions with limited supervision.
* strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and navigate ambiguity.

**you'll thrive even more if you also bring**

* experience working in smaller or lean analytics teams where individuals are responsible for multiple stages of the analytics lifecycle, from requirements gathering through solution delivery
* experience supporting marketing analytics or other commercial functions such as sales, customer success, revenue operations, or commercial finance.
* hands on experience with snowflake and dbt or comparable data transformation tooling.
* python experience for data analysis, automation, or analytical development.
* experience with go-to-market systems data, such as marketing automation, attribution, and customer success platforms.
* familiarity with dimensional modeling, semantic data models, and data pipelines.
* exposure to machine learning, predictive analytics, segmentation, ai enabled use cases, or enterprise data governance.
* familiarity with prompt engineering, ai-assisted analytics, predictive modeling, experimentation frameworks, or model performance evaluation.
* experience supporting saas, subscription, software, or recurring revenue business models.

**what success looks like**

within the first 6 to 12 months, the successful candidate should be able to:

* become a trusted analytics partner capable of independently leading complex business initiatives from discovery through business impact.
* build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels, from field teams to senior leadership, in one or more commercial domains.
* handle a steady flow of business requests with insights and recommendations that stakeholders act on.
* turn loosely defined business problems into structured, executable analytical solutions.
* deliver reliable analysis, data models, and bi solutions with limited day to day support.
* navigate si ams data structures and identify appropriate data sources, models, and dependencies.
* become a trusted owner of business logic, data investigation, and analytical delivery within assigned domains.
* collaborate effectively with data engineering, data science, ai, and other specialist functions.
* produce clear documentation covering business definitions, data sources, analytical logic, lineage, and solution design.
* contribute to a scalable and resilient data & ai environment through strong ownership, reusable solutions, and knowledge sharing.

title: Data & AI Analyst
description:
**data & ai analyst**

**the opportunity**  
• data and ai analyst at a growth-oriented energy company
  
• collaborate with senior technical professionals to develop the data and ai foundations that support critical refining & logistics, retail, and finance operations across par pacific.
  
• gain hands-on experience developing and deploying enterprise software solutions in google cloud platform (gcp).
  
• work closely with business and technical teams to understand complex business processes and transform manual, repetitive work into automated, scalable cloud-based workflows.
  
• grow your skills through hands-on work by building real-world solutions as part of larger technology initiatives, with experienced technical professionals providing mentorship and guidance on architecture, standards, and code reviews.
  
• reporting to the director, enterprise data and applications, you will work day-to-day with our senior developer and data architect, to contribute to the development of data pipelines, internal tooling, and ai-enabled automation.

key activities include:
  
data & sql
  
• assist in building and maintaining etl workflows on google cloud platform, primarily in bigquery, with support from the data architect on modeling and design decisions
  
• contribute to data quality checks, validation logic, and documentation for pipelines the team owns
  
• support ad hoc data pulls and analysis requests from business teams, escalating larger requests to the appropriate data resource
  
cloud & development practices
  
• deploy and maintain assigned components in gcp under the direction of senior team members, building foundational fluency in the services par pacific already runs on
  
• learn and apply the team's development practices: version control, code review, environment promotion, basic ci/cd, and infrastructure-as-code exposure
  
• assist with monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting for workflows the team supports
  
• follow established security, access, and governance standards; raise questions early when a requirement is unclear

ai & automation
  
• sit with business stakeholders to understand how work actually gets done today — the manual steps, the handoffs, the spreadsheets — and help document those processes clearly
  
• partner with the senior developer and data architect to evaluate where ai and automation are a good fit, and where they are not
  
• translate agreed-upon business logic into working prototypes, then help harden those prototypes into reliable, automated services deployed through the enterprise's existing cloud platforms
  
• assist in integrating ai components with enterprise data sources and identity/access tooling, connecting the pieces between systems that do not yet talk to each other
  
• contribute to testing, evaluation, and iteration of automated workflows once they are live

collaboration
  
• work closely with a small, lean technical team where your work is visible and your questions get answered directly
  
• coordinate with business, erp, and infrastructure teams to gather requirements and confirm assumptions before building
  
• communicate progress, blockers, and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  
note: this description is intended to give you a general overview of the position. additional responsibilities and opportunities may be identified based on current business needs.

**qualifications**  
to meet the basic qualifications for this role, you will have legal authorization to work permanently in the united states for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship.

additional qualifications include:
  
• high school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, information systems, or a related field preferred
  
• minimum 1 year of professional experience in software development, data engineering, data analysis, or a comparable technical role required; relevant internship, co-op, bootcamp, or substantial personal project work will be considered
  
• working proficiency in sql, including joins, aggregation, and window functions, with the ability to reason about query performance, required
  
• proficiency in python for scripting, data manipulation, and automation preferred
  
• foundational understanding of cloud concepts and at least introductory hands-on exposure to gcp or aws (compute, storage, iam basics) required
  
• familiarity with modern ai tooling — llm apis, prompting, or agent frameworks — and a practical sense of what these tools are and are not good at, required
  
• demonstrated ability to break a problem down, ask clarifying questions, and communicate a solution in plain language required
  
• comfort working in a lean environment where priorities shift
  
• experience with git and collaborative version control workflows preferred
  
• exposure to data modeling concepts (dimensional, relational, or semantic) preferred
  
• exposure to bi tooling such as looker or power bi preferred
  
• exposure to containers, ci/cd pipelines, or infrastructure-as-code preferred
  
• exposure to workflow orchestration tools such as apache airflow or cloud composer preferred
  
• familiarity with oil & gas, retail, or finance data types (e.g., retail data, sap extracts, operations feeds) preferred
  
• cloud fundamentals certification (gcp associate cloud engineer, aws cloud practitioner, or equivalent) preferred

**about us**  
at par pacific, we own and operate market-leading energy and infrastructure businesses in logistically complex markets. we have built a team of downstream industry veterans and subject matter experts to lead our organization with an entrepreneurial spirit and a collaborative, problem solving approach. we bring our diverse strengths and motivation to complex markets where we seek out diamonds in the rough. as a nimble, growing organization, we actively pursue new opportunities with corporate financing know-how, respond to local market demands, and adapt to changing external environments.

**more good reasons to work for par pacific**
  
  
**unique culture and rich values**  
there is nothing ordinary about par pacific - a niche player in the energy space. and there's certainly nothing ordinary about par pacific employees. we are driven, hardworking, entrepreneurial-minded professionals who love to win. our rich values describe how we approach our work: respect for others, integrity, collaborative innovation, and heart. if that describes you, you'll fit right in.
  
  
**location, location, location**  
because par pacific operates in some of the most beautiful places throughout the country, our employees get to make these places their home and enrich their lives. the office where you'll work is in the citycentre in houston, texas, located on the west side of houston near i-10 and the sam houston tollway. it's a vibrant area of the city with plenty of places for lunch or to wind down after work.

**opportunistic growth strategy**  
at par pacific, we look for operations with strong fundamentals and great employees who can move a business forward. our management team has deep experience in the energy industry, as well as in leading mergers, acquisitions, and integrations of newly acquired companies.
  
  
**focused on the future**  
we are an energy company that has recognized the imperative and embraced the opportunity to begin the transition from fossil fuels. we are developing products that help reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
  
  
**excellent compensation and benefits**  
in addition to a competitive salary, we offer a strong comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision insurance, a robust allotment of paid time off, a 401(k) with company match, retirement savings plans, educational reimbursement, and more. full-time employees (and their families) are offered medical (with prescription coverage), dental, vision, voluntary critical illness, accident, life/ad&d insurance, flexible spending account and employee assistance program. employees can purchase company stock at discounted prices through the employee stock purchase program.

**our headquarters**
  
par pacific holdings, inc., based in houston, texas, owns, manages and maintains interests in energy and infrastructure businesses. we are a growing energy company focused on renewable and conventional fuels in the western united states. par pacific also owns 46% of laramie energy, llc, a natural gas production company with operations and assets concentrated in western colorado. our common stock is publicly traded on the nyse under the trading symbol "parr".

**our refineries and logistics operations**  
we own and operate refineries in hawaii, montana, washington, and wyoming, with total operating throughput capacity of over 219 mbpd. par pacific owns and operates one of the largest energy networks in hawaii with 94,000 bpd of operating refining capacity, a logistics system supplying the major islands of the state and 90 retail locations. in the pacific northwest and the rockies, par pacific owns and operates 125,000 bpd of combined refining capacity and related multimodal logistics systems.
  
  
**our retail operations**  
we own and operate over 90 retail locations in hawaii under the hele and 76 brands and over 30 retail locations in washington and idaho under the nomnom brand.

par pacific prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable law.
