title: Software Engineer
description:
software engineer  
  
  
kipsu is a growth stage minneapolis-based technology company that has grown to over 100 employees. at kipsu, we help service professionals meet the moment - from partnering with some of the largest hospitality brands in the world to working with clients in the multifamily and healthcare industries. our best-in-class technology enables organizations around the globe to better serve their customers through streamlined messaging, data-driven performance metrics, sentiment analysis and workflow management. as one of the twin cities’ leading tech companies, kipsu has cultivated a reputation for a strong company culture and is consistently recognized by the star tribune as a top workplace.  
  
the opportunity  
  
kipsu is hiring a back-end-focused, but full-stack capable, software engineer to join one of our cross-functional delivery teams in minneapolis. you'll be part of our services practice, the engineers who build the server-side applications, apis, and data layer behind our platforms.  
  
the team is currently building kipsu's next-generation identity and access management system: the services that handle sign-in, enterprise single sign-on, and permissions for every kipsu user. team focus will shift over time as priorities change, so we're looking for someone who enjoys learning new parts of a system as much as going deep on one.  
  
you'll work across our technology stack: typescript, react, php, kotlin, and more – ship features end to end, and help the team make sound technical decisions as we modernize the platform.  
  
what you'll do

* build complete features independently, from request handling and business logic through data persistence.
* design and build well-structured rest apis with clear resource models, consistent error handling, input validation, and documentation other teams can integrate against.
* write efficient sql, manage schema migrations safely, and use transactions and redis caching where they fit.
* apply secure design patterns as a matter of course, especially authentication, authorization, and input validation, which are central to identity work.
* author technical designs for features and moderately complex work, covering integration points, testing, observability, and deployment.
* instrument your code with structured logging and meaningful metrics, and design for failure when a dependency is slow or unavailable.
* investigate and resolve bugs and production issues independently, finding root cause rather than patching symptoms.
* write unit tests that cover edge cases and failure paths, and add coverage to existing code as you work in it.
* review teammates' pull requests promptly and give feedback that improves the code.
* work within our ci/cd pipelines and containerized environments, and troubleshoot build and deployment issues when they come up.

we encourage the use of ai coding assistants and agents throughout your day-to-day work. you will stay accountable for everything you ship, so you must review, test, and understand what a tool produces.  
  
what we’re looking for  
  
what you bring

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with most of it on the back end.
* hands-on experience full-stack experience in application development. you don't need to know our exact stack, but you need to have shipped code to production.
* working experience with relational databases (mysql, postgresql, sql server, or similar): writing joins and aggregations, reasoning about query performance, and making schema changes.
* experience building or consuming rest apis, including http methods, status codes, and error handling.
* a habit of writing unit tests and debugging systematically.
* familiarity with git, pull-request-based code review, and ci/cd workflows.
* clear written and verbal communication. you raise blockers early, ask good questions in planning, and follow through on commitments.
* curiosity and adaptability. you pick up new languages, codebases, and domains quickly, and you're comfortable when team priorities change.

nice to have

* production experience with php and/or kotlin (or another jvm language), typescript, react, react native, node
* experience with identity and access management: oauth 2.0, openid connect, saml, enterprise sso, or role-based authorization.
* experience working in a large, long-lived codebase while new services are carved out of a monolith.
* exposure to messaging and asynchronous patterns (queues, pub/sub, event-driven workflows).
* experience with redis or other caching layers, including cache invalidation trade-offs.
* experience with docker, cloud infrastructure, or infrastructure-as-code such as terraform.
* experience with observability tooling: structured logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
* experience building integrations with external partner systems, or working in b2b saas.

how you work

* you own outcomes. you break work into small increments, ship working software often, and adjust when priorities change.
* you communicate proactively. you share progress, blockers, and timeline risks without being asked, and you give reasonable estimates.
* you collaborate across functions. you work well with product, qa, support, and other engineering teams, and you listen before you respond.
* you connect your work to the bigger picture. you understand why the team is building what it's building and bring observations from your work back to the practice.
* you're open-minded and eager to grow. you take feedback well, seek out unfamiliar parts of the system, and help raise the bar for the team.

what makes kipsu different

* we’re a solid, stable company, and we enthusiastically embrace our founding startup spirit– everyone pitching in and working to the same goals.
* our culture– we have a team of highly motivated colleagues who are all in it together. we all succeed as one, and we all learn from our mistakes holding our interdependence in high regard.
* our unique philosophy– we bootstrapped this company ourselves and are in it for the long-term. there is a distinct sense of purpose and ownership at kipsu as we do things on our own terms.
* remarkable growth– with nearly a decade of advancement, we continue to accelerate. it’s an exciting time to be here.

why you’ll love it here

* unity– everyone here is committed to the same mission. our core values are not platitudes but our pact. we believe in the best in each other while always reaching to be better.
* transparency– our leadership gets into the details. we all gather for weekly space to discover how each team is doing so that we have a full understanding of the business and think like a ceo.
* trust– our team members are given the trust and license to excel at their jobs, and are supported along the way to continuously grow.
* mentorship - we all have more to learn and something to teach. the lessons are beyond technical. we celebrate our busy hive of shared growth.
* respect– our success and future as an industry leader depend on actionable commitment to cultivating a diverse and equitable team. everyone here has a voice that is heard and respected. we seek open and honest conversation on our journey to be active stewards of our shared communities.
* purpose– everyone here is closely connected to the result of their work. every day our team gets to see the impact of what they do enhancing the value of our customers’ work in their own professions. our goals are explicitly tethered to our mission of building relationships.

we are proud to offer a competitive suite of benefits including: health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, 401k with a company match, unlimited/responsible vacation time, life insurance, flex spending account, and commuter benefits.

the pay range for this role is $80,000-$90,000/year depending on experience.

one last thing – at kipsu, we believe that our values, success, and future as a leader in our industry require a vibrant and diverse workforce. this is one of the many challenges we seek to solve, and we are intentional and active in recruiting talent of all identities and building an environment that is inclusive of all backgrounds. we need your contribution to our team. please consider rolling up your sleeves and joining us on our journey.

title: Software Engineer, Internal Tools
description:
**about north cloud**

the public cloud is rapidly evolving, with businesses investing over $200 billion annually in cloud technology. as ai accelerates demand for scalable infrastructure, cloud costs are soaring, and most teams still rely on spreadsheets to manage them.

at north, we’re building the next-generation cloud, ai, and data spend management platform. we give companies real-time visibility, control, and automation over their digital asset finances so they can grow efficiently without wasting time or money.

backed by top-tier investors and trusted by companies managing complex cloud environments, north is building the financial operating system for the public cloud.

**about the role**
------------------

### **be our first internal tools engineer**

you'll be north's **first dedicated internal tools engineer**, joining our engineering team to build this function from the ground up. this is an opportunity to establish the technical foundation, architecture, and best practices for how we develop internal tools, integrations, and automations across the company.

you'll have significant ownership over identifying opportunities, setting technical standards, and building scalable solutions that can be reused as north grows. rather than inheriting an established roadmap or legacy systems, you'll help define what internal tooling looks like at north and shape how we approach automation across the organization.

while this is a hands-on individual contributor role, **your work will lay the groundwork for a future internal tools team**. as the company scales, the systems, processes, and engineering practices you establish will serve as the foundation for expanding the function.

we’re looking for an **internal tools engineer** to join our engineering team and build the systems, automations, and tools that make north operate faster and more effectively.

you’ll work across all of north to identify manual, repetitive, or inefficient workflows and turn them into reliable software. that could mean building an internal application from scratch, integrating systems through apis, automating a multi-step operational workflow, or using ai to eliminate work that previously required significant manual effort.

you won’t just receive a list of tickets. we want someone who can understand a problem, determine whether and how it should be automated, propose a technical approach, and own the solution through production.

we care about building internal systems with the same engineering discipline we apply to our customer-facing product. the goal isn’t to create a collection of one-off scripts—it’s to build reliable, maintainable, reusable tooling that can scale with the company.

you’ll sit within engineering while partnering closely with teams across north, giving you visibility into how the entire business operates and the opportunity to improve it through software.

**what you’ll do**
------------------

* **build internal tools from end to end.** design, develop, deploy, and maintain applications and services that help north’s teams operate more efficiently.
* **automate manual workflows.** identify repetitive or time-consuming processes across the company and replace them with reliable software and automation.
* **build ai-enabled workflows.** use llms, apis, agents, and other ai technologies where they can meaningfully reduce manual work or improve decision-making.
* **connect our systems.** build integrations between the platforms north uses across engineering and the broader organization, creating reliable data and workflow connections between them.
* **build python services and apis.** develop maintainable backend services that power internal applications, integrations, and automations.
* **create internal interfaces.** build lightweight dashboards, applications, and interfaces that make internal systems intuitive for non-engineering users.
* **design reusable systems.** build service layers, libraries, abstractions, and integrations that can support multiple workflows instead of solving the same problem repeatedly.
* **own architecture decisions.** determine the right technical approach for new tools and automations, including when to build, integrate, automate, or keep a process manual.
* **own tools in production.** monitor, debug, maintain, and improve the systems you build as workflows and business requirements evolve.
* **build for reliability.** implement strong testing, observability, error handling, permissions, and guardrails so internal automations can be trusted.
* **work directly with internal users.** understand how teams actually work, translate their problems into technical requirements, and iterate based on feedback.
* **experiment quickly.** prototype new approaches—including ai-powered solutions—while knowing when an experiment needs to become production-quality software.

**what we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* 3–7 years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems
* strong python experience and the ability to write clean, maintainable, idiomatic code
* experience building backend services, apis, integrations, or internal applications
* strong understanding of rest apis, webhooks, authentication, and working with third-party platforms
* experience automating workflows or building tools that meaningfully reduced manual work
* ability to take an ambiguous operational problem and independently turn it into a technical solution
* experience designing and operating production systems rather than only building prototypes
* ability to write reusable code and abstractions instead of relying on one-off scripts
* strong fundamentals around git workflows, code review, testing, and collaborative software development
* strong critical thinking skills—you reason from first principles, evaluate tradeoffs, and can explain why you chose a particular approach
* pragmatic use of ai and llm coding tools: you use them to move faster while still understanding the code, architecture, and tradeoffs behind what you ship
* strong testing discipline and an understanding that internal tooling still requires reliability, security, and maintainability
* strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* comfort operating independently in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change quickly
* a builder mentality—you naturally notice inefficient processes and start thinking about how software could make them better

**nice to have**
----------------

* experience building ai-powered internal tools, agents, or llm-based workflows
* experience with llm apis, prompt engineering, tool calling, rag, or agentic systems
* experience with workflow automation platforms such as n8n, zapier, or similar tools
* experience building internal admin panels, dashboards, or lightweight frontend applications
* javascript or typescript experience
* experience integrating saas platforms across functions such as engineering, sales, recruiting, finance, or operations
* experience with aws and cloud infrastructure
* infrastructure-as-code experience with tools such as terraform
* experience with databases, data pipelines, or event-driven architectures
* experience in a startup or similarly fast-moving environment
* experience owning an internal platform or tool from initial problem discovery through ongoing production support
* outstanding recognition in competitions, technical projects, open-source work, or business ventures

**work setup**
--------------

we offer both hybrid work models based out of our dumbo brooklyn office, as well as remote us, with opportunities to travel to the office for team onsites.

**benefits**
------------

* unlimited pto
* 16 weeks of paid parental leave (birthing parents receive an additional 4 weeks at 50% pay)
* two company-wide breaks per year: one around labor day and one at the end of the year
* aetna medical ppo plan with the majority of the premium covered by north
* dental and vision insurance
* flexible spending account (fsa) for health expenses and commuter benefits
* 30-day sabbatical every 4 years

**compensation**
----------------

**$150,000 – $200,000 base salary, depending on experience + equity**

 **the pay range for this role is:**  
150,000 - 200,000 usd per year(usa)

title: AI Algorithmic Trader — Interview Today, Start Tomorrow!
description:
ai algorithmic trader — memelabs, inc.

memelabs, inc., a new startup division of memehouse la, is hiring a systematic trader-researcher to answer one question: can an ai learn to trade and improve itself, or does it only look like it is learning? you will design the strategies, the tests and the learning loop, on the world's largest dexs.

please only apply if you are able to start right away

**this role starts immediately.** the 45- and 90-day milestones run from your first day, so we can only consider candidates who are available to begin now. if you need a notice period or a later start date, please do not apply for this opening.

job details

**company**

memelabs, inc. (a startup division of memehouse la)

**location**

beverly hills, ca — in person and remote

**employment type**

full-time, part-time, w-2 employee, or contract

**annual base salary**

$120,000–$280,000

**additional compensation**

$5,000 performance-based signing incentive, earned through two initial-delivery milestones targeted for the first 90 days

about us

memehouse la is launching a startup division, memelabs, inc., where we build ai software that turns information into useful decisions and reliable workflows. our focus is practical: secure ai deployments, connected systems, and applications that deliver measurable value.

one of those applications is a systematic crypto trading program on the world's largest decentralized exchanges, across btc, eth, sol and other major markets. an ai agent writes the backtests, bots, analysis and hourly market reads; it keeps a memory of what it tried and grades its own past predictions.

so far the evidence says the ai is not yet learning, which is why this role exists:

* a grid fitted to our in-house ai market model's levels made **+0.43%/day** on the data it was tuned on and **0.25%/day** on the next eight weeks.
* the model's trade setups, tested on 1,497 trades, matched **random entries with the same stops and targets** almost to the basis point.

we want someone who finds these results interesting, not discouraging.

about the role

as our ai algorithmic trader, you are the human in the loop between an ai that can build a trading bot in an hour and a market that punishes anything untested. you will design systematic strategies, build the evaluation that decides which ones are real, and engineer the loop that lets the ai learn from every result.

this is a hands-on role with ownership of meaningful deliverables. you will explain trade-offs to non-traders, document decisions, and help establish repeatable practices as the team grows.

what you will do

* **design strategies:** create systematic strategies with clear entry, exit, sizing and kill rules, and turn each into a testable hypothesis.
* **build the self-improvement loop:** decide what the ai remembers, how it grades its own calls, which changes it may make alone and which need a human; then prove with numbers whether it improves.
* **evaluate quality:** build repeatable backtests with realistic fills, fees and slippage, walk-forward splits, held-out data, and a control for every result (random entries, random levels, a plain grid).
* **grade the ai market model:** score its levels, setups and stated odds against simple baselines, and decide what, if anything, should drive bots.
* **run paper and live bots:** move survivors to paper beside a control, then small live size; monitor, scale or retire them.
* **operate dependable systems:** exchange-side stops, software loss limits, a 90%-of-equity deploy cap, observability, versioning and rollback for every bot.
* **protect sensitive information:** least-privilege keys, secrets management, dry-run-first transfer scripts, and safeguards against prompt injection into the ai's tools.
* **improve the function:** review code, document decisions in shared memory, and help mentor additional researchers as the team expands.

strategies you'll build and test

**family**

examples we run or have tested

**grid and ladder**

static and dynamic grids, re-centring ping-pong ladders, staggered take-profits across many small orders

**mean reversion**

buying support and fading resistance from model-picked levels, vwap and range fades

**breakout and momentum**

close-above / close-below triggers, trailing take-profits, trend-gated entries

**accumulation**

dca and twap drips with price gates and breakeven stops

**signal-driven**

on-chain flows, funding, open interest, liquidation clusters, stablecoin dominance, tradingview alerts

**regime switching**

hourly on/off switchboards, volatility and chop filters, scheduled-event kill switches

the interesting work is not any single strategy. it is building the process that tells the ai which ideas work, why, and what to try next.

what we are looking for

* **systematic strategy experience:** 3+ years designing, building and running your own systematic trading strategies, with live results you can walk us through, across several types (grid, mean reversion, momentum, signal-driven), including ones that failed and why.
* **software engineering ability:** strong python; you can read a 600-line bot and spot the bug in its order logic, and you write maintainable code, apis and automated tests.
* **statistics you actually use:** out-of-sample testing, noise vs edge, power and sample size, overfitting and multiple comparisons.
* **exchange and execution know-how:** order types, post-only and reduce-only, trigger stops, rate limits, partial fills.
* **applied ai experience:** working fluency with ai coding agents and llm tooling, plus the habit of verifying their output instead of trusting it.
* **backend fundamentals:** comfort with sql, git, linux, docker, api authentication and scheduled jobs.
* **security awareness:** sound handling of keys, wallets, permissions and model limitations.
* **ownership and communication:** you scope work, raise blockers early, document decisions, and kill your own strategies when the data says so.
* **demonstrated capability:** relevant professional experience, substantial project work, or equivalent evidence. a specific degree is not required.

helpful additional experience

* **self-improving agents:** memory, reflection, graded predictions, prompt or workflow evolution, acceptance tests.
* **market microstructure:** order-book depth, queue position, liquidation cascades, funding.
* **on-chain dex trading:** order-book dexs and their sdks, wallets, transfers and withdrawals.
* **market data:** on-chain and derivatives data (glassnode, coinglass) and a view on what in them is signal.
* **forward testing:** a paper-trading or shadow-trading harness you have built.
* **team contribution:** open-source work, technical writing, or mentoring.

ai models, tools and infrastructure

we expect hands-on familiarity with many of the tools below and real depth in a few. tell us which ones you have used in production and for what.

**area**

tools and technologies

**frontier llms and assistants**

claude (anthropic), chatgpt and gpt models (openai), grok (xai), gemini (google), mistral, deepseek

**open-weight models**

llama (meta), hermes (nous research), qwen, mistral and mixtral, deepseek, gemma, phi

**ai coding agents**

codex (openai), claude code, cursor, github copilot, aider

**agent frameworks and protocols**

claude agent sdk, openai agents sdk, model context protocol (mcp), langchain and langgraph, llamaindex, crewai, autogen

**agent memory and retrieval**

embeddings, rag, vector stores (pgvector, qdrant, chroma, pinecone), structured memory files, reflection loops

**training and fine-tuning**

pytorch, hugging face transformers, trl and peft, lora and qlora, unsloth, axolotl, rlhf and dpo

**reinforcement learning for trading**

gymnasium, stable-baselines3, ray rllib, finrl

**model serving and inference**

vllm, sglang, llama.cpp, ollama, hugging face tgi, tensorrt-llm; quantization (gguf, awq, gptq)

**evaluation and observability**

weights & biases, mlflow, langsmith, langfuse, promptfoo; graded-prediction and acceptance-test harnesses

**quant and backtesting**

pandas, numpy, polars, duckdb, vectorbt, backtrader, freqtrade, hummingbot, quantconnect, tradingview and pine script

**exchange and on-chain**

dex and cex rest/websocket apis, ccxt, web3.py, ethers.js, wallet and key management, bridges

**market data**

glassnode, coinglass, exchange order-book and trade feeds, funding and open-interest data

**hardware**

nvidia gpus (rtx 4090/5090, a100, h100) with cuda; apple silicon (m-series, mlx) for local models; always-on linux or macos servers; low-latency vps near exchange endpoints; hardware wallets

**cloud and operations**

aws, gcp, lambda or runpod gpu cloud, docker, kubernetes, linux, git, ci/cd, cron and launchd schedulers, ngrok or cloudflare tunnels, secrets managers (1password, vault)

how we work

* **evidence decides.** a result counts only out-of-sample, after fees, against a control.
* **tune on one period, judge on the next.** in-sample winners are a hypothesis, not a strategy.
* **paper before live, small before large.** a new bot earns size over weeks, not hours.
* **the ai builds; a human gates money.** agents research, code and test. launching, sizing and moving funds stay with people.
* **ask the exchange, don't model it.** verify every stop is live and every fill is real.
* **write it down.** every test, result and mistake goes into shared memory so it is never repeated.

your first 90 days

* **first 30 days:** learn the strategy library, bots, ai memory files and risk controls; audit which backtest and live numbers you trust and why; set up your environment and evaluation approach.
* **target by day 45 (milestone one):** a shared test harness with controls built in (random entries, random levels, plain grid), plus a scorecard that tracks whether the ai's ideas and market calls are improving, with reproducible setup and first results.
* **target by day 90 (milestone two):** at least one strategy that beats its control on unseen data and in paper trading, running live at small size with monitoring, kill switches and a launch-and-rollback runbook, and a written first answer on whether the ai is improving.

compensation and $5,000 signing incentive

the annual base salary range is $120,000–$280,000. the starting offer will reflect the responsibilities of the position, demonstrated skills, relevant experience, and internal pay equity; the $5,000 incentive is separate from base salary.

we offer a $5,000 gross performance-based signing incentive, structured as a new-hire milestone bonus rather than an upfront payment:

* **milestone one: $2,500.** earned on completion of the agreed test harness, ai scorecard and initial results, targeted for day 45.
* **milestone two: $2,500.** earned on completion of the agreed validated strategy, live monitoring, runbook and written ai-improvement assessment, targeted for day 90.

written milestone requirements and objective acceptance criteria will be provided before employment begins. each installment is earned when its criteria are satisfied and will be paid on the next regular payday, or earlier if required by applicable law, less required tax withholdings.

the 45- and 90-day dates are delivery targets, not minimum-service or automatic-forfeiture dates. once earned, an installment is not conditioned on continued employment through its payment date and does not have to be repaid if employment later ends. milestones measure delivery of the agreed work, not trading profit.

benefits

* **health coverage:** employer-sponsored health insurance, subject to plan eligibility and terms.
* **retirement benefits:** 401(k) participation, subject to plan eligibility and terms.
* **time off:** unlimited paid time off under the company's written policy, plus applicable paid sick leave and other legally protected leave.

why join us?

you will own a live experiment in whether ai can learn to trade, and shape how it is built and run. we value clear thinking, candid communication, responsible handling of capital and data, and strategies that hold up beyond the backtest.

equal opportunity and accommodations

memelabs, inc. is an equal opportunity employer. we consider qualified applicants without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law and provide reasonable accommodations during the application process and employment.

how to apply

submit your resume, a github profile or portfolio if available, and one page on a systematic strategy you built and later killed: what it was, what the backtest said, and what made you stop it. applications to: saturntrader@abtrust.ai. please do not submit confidential information or proprietary code belonging to a current or former employer or client.

description:
***this is a contingent position, and employment is dependent upon element 84 receiving the contract award and the candidate successfully obtaining a noaa badge. we anticipate hiring multiple people for this position.***

element 84 is a woman-owned small business that works with public, private, and non-profit sector clients to develop geospatial data processing pipelines & build software that helps answer big questions about our health, our infrastructure, and our changing planet. we solve challenging problems across a wide range of industries, but our super power is cloud-based geospatial data processing, remote sensing, and earth science systems. our headquarters is located in alexandria, va and we have a satellite office in philadelphia, pa. element 84 also supports a large remote workforce from a variety of other states.

**a few other things you should know**
--------------------------------------

* element 84's values are: we invest in each other, we are reliable, and our work benefits our world.
* element 84 works on meaningful projects that are challenging—from a technical, people, and team perspective. we make an impact on large projects through our leadership and expertise, both formal and informal.
* element 84 values life outside of work. we offer parental leave for everyone and support each other through family challenges like medical problems, adoptions, and new babies.
* element 84 has had a flexible work schedule since our founding in 2010.
* element 84 is committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and respect for all individuals as we constantly strive to create a work environment where everyone feels welcome and supported.

**about you**
=============

you are curious about the world, are constantly learning, driven to lead (formally or informally), and have a strong work ethic. you're interested in solving impactful problems in science, medicine, and other projects that have a societal good. you can work independently or with a team, prioritize your projects, and be effective without micromanagement.

you'll care about writing. our team is remote and written communication is essential. in addition to caring about a well-crafted email and a succinct conference abstract, you understand that good writing is good design and engineering.

**about the role**
==================

element 84 is seeking a highly experienced and motivated **senior devops engineer** with a strong background in architecting reliable, scalable cloud systems and a proven record of utilizing infrastructure as code in complex deployments to support our innovative projects.

in this role, you'll be instrumental in leading the design, implementation, and operation of cloud-native solutions for complex operational systems, collaborating closely with technical teams and customers.

the ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in designing, deploying, and supporting enterprise-grade software within cloud environments, with a strong emphasis on infrastructure as code principles. while direct experience with geospatial applications isn't required, a curiosity and aptitude for working in this domain will be beneficial.

**what you'll be working on**
-----------------------------

* leading the design and implementation of robust, scalable, and secure cloud-native solutions on aws.
* collaborating with security experts to translate organizational security requirements into secure and compliant cloud implementations.
* developing and maintaining infrastructure-as-code to manage and provision infrastructure across numerous azure and aws accounts, ensuring consistency and efficiency.
* maintaining and optimizing ci/cd automation pipelines to facilitate rapid and reliable software deployments.
* crafting automation scripts in python, bash, javascript, and other relevant languages to streamline operational workflows.
* contributing to the development and maintenance of infrastructure supporting generative ai applications on domain-specific datasets.
* automating the creation and management of front and back-end applications, pipelines, security tooling, etc.

**required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 6+ years of experience in software development, with 3+ years specifically focused on cloud technologies.
* strong, hands-on experience with iac is a must, including writing, maintaining, and troubleshooting complex configurations for cloud environments.
* strong experience developing in one or more programming languages (e.g., python, bash, javascript).
* demonstrable experience designing, deploying, and managing infrastructure and services on a major cloud platform.
* ability to clearly document and communicate intricate architectural concepts at various levels, including delivering presentations, creating visual representations of architectures, and writing white papers.
* demonstrated experience in negotiating tradeoffs between critical factors such as security, performance, maintainability, and cost.
* proven ability to multitask and effectively prioritize work across competing demands and multiple customers.
* extensive experience working within an agile development software team.
* solid experience with linux environments.
* deep understanding of cloud architecture patterns and tradeoffs (e.g., serverless vs. provisioned, managed services vs. self-hosting).
* expertise with build and deployment automation tools.
* proficiency with infrastructure monitoring tools (e.g., cloudwatch, aws config, kibana, splunk, grafana, opentelemetry, honeycomb, etc.)
* experience with data storage and data engineering tools and technologies (e.g., elasticsearch, sql, nosql, dynamodb, redshift, athena, glue, etc.).
* experience with networking tools and technologies and troubleshooting issues (cloudfront, route53, load balancers, api gateway, vpcs, nacls, etc.).
* technical cloud certification (e.g., aws solutions architect associate/professional, aws devops engineer professional, azure solutions architect expert, azure devops engineer expert) or willingness to obtain one.
* **this position requires that applicants be a us person (us citizen or legal permanent resident)** and authorized to work in the united states without sponsorship now or in the future.

**preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* aws solutions architect, aws devops, azure solutions architect expert, azure devops engineer expert, and/or certified kubernetes administrator certifications.
* b.s. in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field (equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree).

title: Senior Databricks Data Analyst
description:
**who we are**

stitch is the global leader in helping brands drive crm performance through braze and databricks. we work with fortune 1000 brands to design and execute martech-driven solutions and lifecycle marketing strategies that drive meaningful outcomes. our fast-growing team spans the us, uk, and canada.

we’re actively building the best customer relationship marketing (crm) consultancy in the world. not the biggest—the best. we’re looking for teammates who are energized by this challenge.

**the role**

as a databricks analyst, you work at every layer between the data and the decision. you write the queries, make the basic data connections you need to get to the right data, and build the reporting clients run on. then you figure out what the data is telling us about the client's business, make the recommendation, and drive it through to action. you work with enterprise marketing, data, and it leaders to turn their databricks investment into measurable business outcomes.

we are looking for an analyst who is hands-on and proactive. you are not just interpreting and storytelling. you are in the workspace, in the sql editor, and in the client conversation. our clients are handing us the keys to their data, and the databricks team has to drive: you spot what needs doing, build momentum, and make sure every engagement has traction and keeps moving forward. you partner closely with stitch's databricks project managers, architects, and data engineers, and you help shape how stitch delivers analytics on databricks.

**who you are**

first and foremost, you're motivated by impact. to be the best crm consultancy in the world, we have to be motivated by performance—both in how our work drives outcomes for our customers, and for how our work drives outcomes for stitch.

this means you're not content with status quo—you're always looking towards what's next and seeking opportunities to grow yourself, grow our customers, and grow stitch. you have relentless standards and uphold them unapologetically. you move nimbly, take ownership, drive things forward, and make the people around you better. you're driven and can't sit still. you don't wait for momentum, you create it. when a client hands you the keys to their data, you start driving. if this sounds like you, you will thrive here.

**what you'll do**

* query and analyze client data in databricks using sql (and python where needed) across silver and gold layers to answer business questions quickly and accurately.
* make the basic data connections you need to get to the work: connect sources and set up simple ingestion, and partner with data engineers on more complex pipeline builds.
* build and maintain dashboards, reporting, and genie spaces that let client marketers self-serve on governed data.
* interpret data and present clear, prioritized recommendations to marketing and data stakeholders. examples include: customer behavior, audience performance, lifecycle health, and revenue drivers
* drive recommendations through to action. build the case, align stakeholders, and stay with the work until it is implemented and measured.
* design kpi frameworks, segmentation and lifecycle strategy, identity and customer 360 support, audits, methodology contributions, and qbr/ebr participation.
* support customer identity and customer 360 work by profiling sources, validating data quality, and testing outputs, partnering with data engineers on the build.
* reconcile audiences and data between databricks and activation platforms such as braze, and find and fix the root cause when counts don't match.
* develop audience segmentation strategies and lifecycle stage definitions using first-party, behavioral, and crm data in the lakehouse.
* run data audits and readiness assessments that give clients a clear, recommendation-driven view of where their data stands and what to do next.
* present findings and recommendations to client marketing, data, and it leaders, and participate in qbrs and ebrs alongside client partners.
* partner with databricks project managers, architects, and data engineers to keep engagements on track and surface risks and opportunities early.
* use ai tools (e.g., genie, gemini, claude) to speed up analysis, documentation, and qa.
* contribute to stitch's databricks methodology: reusable queries, dashboard templates, assessment tools, and analytics accelerators that raise the standard of every client engagement.
* manage your time to meet billable targets of 36+ hours per week.
* obtain dbx accreditations and dbx data analyst certification.
* travel up to 20% for client meetings, workshops, and onsite engagements.

**what success looks like**

* clients see you as the person who knows their data and their business—not just someone who pulls reports. they come to you for what to do next.
* you get to the data yourself. queries, connections, and dashboards don't sit waiting on other teams.
* your recommendations get implemented, and you can point to the business results they drove.
* the engagements you're on keep moving. leadership sees momentum and traction, not stalled work.
* your queries, dashboards, and frameworks are reusable, and they help stitch scale its databricks practice.

  
**requirements**

**what you bring**

* strong, hands-on sql. you write your own queries against large datasets and don't wait for someone else to pull the data.
* working experience in databricks (strongly preferred) or a comparable cloud data platform such as snowflake or bigquery—experience with sql warehouses, unity catalog, and notebooks or equivalent.
* enough data engineering knowledge to be self-sufficient: comfortable connecting data sources, setting up basic ingestion, and working with bronze, silver, and gold data layers, without needing to be a data engineer.
* experience building dashboards and reporting in databricks ai/bi, power bi, tableau, or equivalent.
* experienced with analytics data design patterns such as star schema. experience designing and building datasets following a similar design pattern is a plus.
* independently interprets data in the context of the client's business, makes recommendations without guidance, and drives them to completion.
* exceptional communicator who can explain technical findings to marketers and executives, and business priorities to technical teams.
* python (pyspark or pandas) is a plus. marketing analytics experience with crm, lifecycle, or customer data is a strong plus.

**how you consult**

* at senior level, you’re managing outcomes, not tasks. how you communicate and build trust determines whether clients see stitch as a vendor or a partner.
* translate delivery complexity into business language. lead meetings that drive decisions, not just updates.
* build relationships at multiple levels. communicate effectively with c-suite, project leads, and technical teams, especially client and it data leaders.
* lead with the “why”. connect the business outcome to the technical work so it teams have a reason to prioritize and change course.
* present risks with recommendations and tradeoffs, not just alerts.
* navigate scope boundaries with confidence — knowing when to hold firm and when to adapt
* own outcomes. lead without being asked. identify what needs doing and do it.
* stay persistent and constructive through slow-moving it processes. keep momentum without burning trust.

**tools you'll use**

* databricks: sql editor, sql warehouses, unity catalog, notebooks, basic ingestion and jobs, ai/bi dashboards, genie
* sql, python (pyspark), github
* bi platforms such as power bi or tableau
* stitch’s internal ai tooling

**qualifications**

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
**job description:**

ryan companies us, inc. has an immediate career opportunity for an artificial intelligence engineer to join our growing data and artificial intelligence team. reporting directly to the director of ai, this high-impact role operates on the front lines of ryan’s construction operations. this is an **in-office** role for our minneapolis headquarters office, 4 days per week, 1 day work-from-home. it will require weekday travel for likely 4-5 days per month to construction sites mostly in the midwest.

unlike traditional centralized engineering roles, the forward deployed ai engineer will be heavily embedded with our construction project teams; partnering side-by-side with project managers, superintendents, project engineers, and field operations. you will act as the technical bridge between enterprise ai capabilities and day-to-day jobsite workflows, rapidly prototyping, integrating, and deploying custom ai solutions directly into field operations.

this role requires strong hands-on ai coding proficiency, deep cloud expertise on google cloud platform (gcp), a product-focused mindset, and a willingness to operate on active project sites to drive tangible business value in construction delivery.

with more than 88 years in business and 17 offices (and growing!), ryan offers comprehensive commercial real estate solutions to customers across the us. we bring a collaborative, relationship-driven approach to delivering spaces where people thrive and businesses succeed. join a company with an outstanding culture and competitive benefits. at ryan, we don’t just build buildings – we build stories.

  

**what you can expect to do:**

* field-embedded ai deployment: embed directly into construction project teams to observe, diagnose, and solve operational friction points on jobsites using ai and automation.
* agentic rapid prototyping: leverage state-of-the-art agentic coding environments (e.g., cursor, claude code, codex) to build, test, and iterate on functional prototypes with velocity.
* software & ai engineering: write scalable, robust, and maintainable code to build tailored applications, agentic workflows, and field technology tools.
* cloud development: design, configure, and maintain production solutions within google cloud platform (gcp), leveraging agent engine (vertex ai), cloud run, bigquery, and cloud storage, etc.
* rag and agent development: build and deploy retrieval-augmented generation (rag) applications and autonomous agents to query complex construction documents (drawings, specs, submittals, rfis, change orders).
* construction data integration: connect solutions, models and pipelines into existing construction ecosystems (such as procore, autodesk construction cloud, erps, and document repositories).
* feedback loop and scale: serve as the critical feedback loop between construction site realities and the centralized ai team, turning field-tested prototypes into scalable enterprise solutions.
* culture building: actively participate in fostering ryan’s data and ai culture through promoting data-driven decision-making.

**what we expect you to have:**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying generative ai, machine learning or advanced software solutions in enterprise or field environments.
* advanced proficiency and hands-on workflow mastery utilizing agentic coding environments and ai harnesses (such as cursor, claude code, codex, or comparable tools) to accelerate software architecture, coding, testing, and system delivery.
* proven experience architecting and deploying application and agent solutions specifically on google cloud platform (gcp), including agent engine (vertex ai), cloud run, cloud composer/dataflow, and iam security models.
* demonstrated experience developing custom rag pipelines, fine-tuning llms, working with vector databases, and orchestrating multi-agent systems
* strong coding proficiency in python, sql, typescript/javascript; solid grasp of restful apis, data serialization, and git workflows.
* ability and willingness to travel regularly to active construction sites, participate in job site meetings, and understand field operations.
* bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, software engineering, construction engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**to be successful**

* strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* eagerness to learn the business of construction to create impactful and valuable ai solutions.
* ability to work collaboratively in a team environment with diverse skill sets and work styles.
* resourceful, entrepreneurial, and innovative mindset, with a drive to tackle ambiguous challenges effectively.
* commitment to staying updated on ai trends and leveraging them to deliver business value.
* understanding of ethical and responsible ai principles and practices

**preferred experience**

* prior exposure to architecture, engineering, and construction (aec), commercial real estate, or industrial operations.
* familiarity with construction tools and apis (procore, autodesk bim 360 / acc, bluebeam, dronedeploy).
* experience designing conversational interfaces or automated field data capture workflows (voice-to-text, field forms)

**compensation:**

the base pay range is $100,000 - $130,000/annually. the salary may vary within the anticipated range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, and abilities. position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include commission and/or an incentive program.

position requires verification of employment to work in the u.s.

title: Sr AI Solutions Specialist - Architecture Foundry
description:
are you a highly versatile developer who is passionate about translating cutting-edge generative ai research into production-ready software? do you want to build the smart interfaces, agentic workflows, and automated microservices that will power the future of financial markets?

  

cme group is seeking a **sr ai solutions specialist** to join our revolutionary **architecture foundry** within the central hub. sitting inside our innovative, cross-functional **"architecture-as-a-product"** pod, you will partner directly with enterprise architects and cloud platform engineers to turn visionary architectural concepts into living, breathing ai-powered solutions.

  

in this role, you will be the premier **force multiplier** for our applied architecture stories and epics. rather than building isolated models, you will act as a versatile, multi-disciplinary ai specialist. you will take the robust security patterns, landing zones, and infrastructure blueprints designed by the central hub and use them to engineer reusable application-level templates, multi-agent systems, and production-ready code blocks. by building these "paved paths," you will empower delivery teams across cme group to rapidly adopt and scale secure genai capabilities.

  

**what you'll do**
==================

**applied ai & agentic engineering**
------------------------------------

* **build reusable ai assets:** design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade software templates, reusable sdks, and modular microservices that wrap genai capabilities (e.g., prompt management, retrieval-augmented generation [rag], embeddings) into standard developer tools.
* **architect ai agents:** design and deploy robust multi-agent systems and agentic architectures capable of planning, reasoning, memory retention, tool usage, and execution across complex enterprise apis.
* **translate architecture into code:** partner with enterprise architects to implement their strategic design patterns, turning abstract standards into functional codebases that prove the viability of next-generation ai platforms.
* **prototype to production (mvps):** rapidly develop functional prototypes and proof-of-concepts (pocs) for high-impact ai use cases, ensuring code is clean, modular, and optimized for production hand-off.

**developer enablement & mentorship**
-------------------------------------

* **democratize ai best practices:** package your code into clear, well-documented starter kits and boilerplates, making it incredibly simple for delivery teams to integrate advanced ai without reinventing the wheel.
* **co-create paved paths:** work with the pattern council to certify and publish your templates as standard developer building blocks.
* **collaborative support:** embed briefly with engineering pods to help them adopt your templates, troubleshoot complex api/llm integration issues, and scale their implementations.

  

**what you'll bring**
=====================

**experience & education**
--------------------------

* **professional background:** 3–5+ years of progressive, hands-on software engineering experience, with a proven track record of writing production-grade, highly reusable, and modular code libraries.
* **enterprise exposure:** experience working within large, complex corporate environments or financial services institutions, demonstrating familiarity with enterprise security standards, data privacy controls, and api-driven architectures.
* **education:** bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical discipline.

**technical & ai expertise**
----------------------------

* **software engineering core:** deep proficiency in **python** (the industry standard for ai enablement) alongside experience in enterprise languages (e.g., java, c++, or node.js).
* **generative ai & llms:** hands-on experience developing applications using state-of-the-art large language models (llms) from google (gemini/vertex ai), openai, or open-source ecosystems.
* **agentic frameworks & orchestration:** proven experience building agentic workflows and multi-agent orchestration systems using frameworks such as **langgraph, autogen, crewai, or google vertex ai agent builder** .
* **modern development ecosystem:** strong understanding of semantic search, vector databases (e.g., pinecone, pgvector), chunking strategies, prompt engineering patterns, and rag architectures.
* **api & integration patterns:** advanced skills in building and consuming restful/grpc apis, microservice design, and asynchronous message broker patterns.

**certifications (highly desired)**
-----------------------------------

* **google cloud certified:** professional machine learning engineer or professional cloud developer.
* **specialized ai credentials:** credentials from recognized programs (e.g., deeplearning.ai, tensorflow developer) focusing on natural language processing, llm application development, or agentic architectures.

  

**what you'll get**
===================

* become a cornerstone of a high-visibility function where your contributions directly shape the core technology foundations of financial markets, tackling technical challenges at an unmatched scale.
* a supportive environment fostering career progression, continuous learning, and an inclusive culture.
* broad exposure to cme's diverse products, asset classes, and cross-functional teams.
* a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
* explore our full range of benefits

cme group is committed to offering a competitive total rewards package for our employees that recognizes their contributions to the business and reflects our long-term investment in their future. the pay range for this role is $145,700-$242,900. actual salary offered will be dependent on a wide array of factors including but not limited to: relevant experience, skills, education and comparison to internal employees (where relevant). our compensation program also includes an annual target bonus opportunity for all employees, as well as the opportunity to become an owner in the company through our broad-based equity program. through our benefits program, we strive to offer flexibility, value and choice. from comprehensive health coverage, to a retirement package that includes both a 401(k) and an active pension plan, to highly competitive education reimbursement provisions, paid time off and a mental health benefit, cme group offers a holistic benefits package for our team and their dependents.

**cme group: where futures are made**

cme group is the world’s leading derivatives marketplace. but who we are goes deeper than that. here, you can impact markets worldwide. transform industries. and build a career by shaping tomorrow. we invest in your success and you own it – all while working alongside a team of leading experts who inspire you in ways big and small. problem solvers, difference makers, trailblazers. those are our people. and we’re looking for more.

title: Snowflake dbt Developer
description:
**job description**

**about victaulic**

victaulic, headquartered in easton, pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. with over 6,000 employees spanning 50+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real-world challenges across a wide range of industries. our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. today, our high-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world's most critical and prestigious structures.

**an industry leader with a heart as big as its ambition and innovation**

at victaulic, we're committed to constructing a better world for and with our people.

**let's build a better world together.**

our commitment to our people is built on four pillars:

* we build from within.
* we stand behind our people.
* we foster an environment for constant learning.
* we engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world.

**your impact starts here**

we're seeking a skilled snowflake dbt developer to join our growing it team and build the dbt-based data transformations and snowflake-native data applications that power reporting, integrations, and ai. this role will focus primarily on developing and extending our production dbt project across the medallion architecture, building the semantic models that power bi and ai consumption, and delivering user-facing solutions with snowflake streamlit. the ideal candidate is a hands-on developer with deep expertise in dbt and snowflake, strong data modeling and sql skills, a working understanding of data warehousing and lakehouse patterns, and experience building data applications for business users.

**what you'll build & own**

**dbt transformation development (50%)**

* develop, test, and maintain dbt models across the silver, gold, and platinum layers of the medallion architecture.
* extend the production dbt project, including migrating remaining legacy transformation logic, such as qlik data integration, into dbt.
* build and maintain semantic-layer models in the consumption layer to support bi, integration, and ai consumers.
* implement incremental models, snapshots, and materialization strategies optimized for snowflake performance and cost.
* author dbt tests, including generic, singular, and source freshness tests, and enforce layer contracts, naming conventions, and coding standards.
* maintain dbt documentation, lineage, and exposures so downstream consumers can trust and trace data.
* develop reusable macros and packages to standardize transformation patterns across subject areas.
* participate in pull request reviews and follow the team's github branching and release process for the dbt codebase.
* troubleshoot and resolve dbt model failures, data quality issues, and performance bottlenecks.
* partner with bi analysts and business stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into well-structured dbt models.

**snowflake native application development (25%)**

* design and develop interactive data applications using snowflake streamlit for self-service analytics and operational workflows.
* implement data-driven solutions leveraging snowflake's native capabilities to enable business user productivity.
* build applications that enable business users to interact with data through intuitive interfaces.
* create reusable application frameworks and component libraries for rapid solution delivery.
* integrate snowflake native apps and third-party marketplace applications to extend platform capabilities.
* develop custom udfs and stored procedures to support advanced application logic and business rules.

**data modeling and platform implementation (15%)**

* implement data models and pipelines that follow established bronze, silver, gold, and platinum medallion architecture standards.
* apply data warehouse, data lake, and lakehouse patterns, including apache iceberg and other open table formats, as directed by the data architecture team.
* implement secure data sharing solutions using snowflake marketplace and data sharing capabilities.
* process semi-structured data, including json, parquet, and avro, into well-modeled, consumable structures.
* optimize query performance, clustering, and warehouse usage for dbt workloads and applications.
* contribute recommendations on modeling patterns and platform features to architecture discussions.

**ai support through semantic modeling (10%)**

* build and maintain dbt semantic models, metrics, and business definitions that ai applications and agents can consume consistently.
* develop snowflake semantic views and semantic model definitions that support natural-language querying tools such as snowflake cortex analyst.
* enrich dbt models with descriptions, column-level documentation, synonyms, and metadata that improve ai accuracy and retrieval.
* prepare curated, ai-ready datasets in the consumption layer with clear grain, relationships, and business context.
* collaborate with ai engineering teams to translate ai use-case requirements into semantic and data model changes.
* validate that ai-generated answers align with governed metric definitions and help diagnose data-related accuracy issues.

**what you bring**

**education and experience**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, data engineering, or a related technical field.
* minimum of 3 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data development roles.
* at least 2 years of hands-on experience developing and maintaining dbt projects in production.
* at least 2 years of hands-on experience with the snowflake platform, including advanced features.
* proven track record of developing data applications or analytical solutions for business users.

**technical skills**

* **dbt development:** production experience with dbt, including model design, jinja and macros, testing, packages, documentation, and deployment on snowflake.
* **data modeling:** strong dimensional modeling skills and experience designing layered transformations, including staging, intermediate, and marts.
* **semantic modeling:** experience defining metrics, dimensions, and business logic in a semantic layer for bi and ai consumption.
* **snowflake expertise:** advanced knowledge of snowflake architecture, including data warehousing, data lakes, and emerging lakehouse features.
* **sql proficiency:** expert-level sql skills with experience in complex analytical queries and optimization.
* **application development:** proficiency with snowflake streamlit for building interactive data applications.
* **python programming:** strong python skills for snowpark development, data processing, and application logic.
* **version control:** experience with github, pull request workflows, and branching strategies for data projects.

**specialized knowledge**

* experience migrating legacy etl/elt transformation logic into dbt.
* experience with dbt incremental strategies, snapshots, and model contracts on snowflake.
* understanding of the dbt semantic layer (metricflow) and snowflake semantic views.
* familiarity with how semantic models and metadata support llm-based tools such as snowflake cortex analyst.
* knowledge of medallion architecture patterns and data quality frameworks.
* understanding of open table formats, including apache iceberg, delta lake, and apache hudi, and their integration with snowflake.
* experience with semi-structured data processing, including json, parquet, and avro, in snowflake.
* familiarity with snowflake features including dynamic tables, snowpipe, tasks, and streams.
* understanding of data sharing, marketplace solutions, and cross-cloud data collaboration.

**what sets you apart**

**preferred qualifications**

* **certifications:** dbt analytics engineering certification; snowflake snowpro core, advanced architect, or data engineer certification.
* **dbt ecosystem:** experience with dbt packages such as dbt\_utils and dbt\_expectations, dbt cloud or dbt core orchestration, and data observability tools.
* **ai/ml collaboration:** experience supporting ai or data science teams and understanding how data quality and semantics affect model output.
* **development frameworks:** experience with modern web frameworks, api development, and microservices.
* **cloud platforms:** knowledge of aws, azure, or google cloud data services and integration patterns.
* **data governance:** understanding of data cataloging, metadata management, and governance frameworks.

**key competencies**

**innovation and solution design**

* creative problem-solving approach with the ability to design elegant solutions for complex business requirements.
* strong understanding of user experience principles and ability to design intuitive data applications.
* proactive in identifying opportunities to leverage emerging snowflake and dbt capabilities for business value.
* ability to balance new approaches with practical implementation and long-term maintainability.

**technical excellence**

* deep expertise in data modeling, dbt, and sql development.
* strong analytical mindset for performance optimization and troubleshooting complex issues.
* commitment to code quality, testing, documentation, and maintainable transformation design.
* continuous learning approach to staying current with snowflake and dbt feature sets.

**communication and collaboration**

* excellent ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical business stakeholders.
* strong presentation skills for demonstrating applications and gathering user feedback.
* collaborative approach to working with data engineers, analysts, ai engineers, and business users.
* ability to translate business requirements into data models, metrics, and implementation plans.

**business partnership**

* customer-focused mindset with emphasis on delivering solutions that drive business value.
* understanding of how data models and applications support business processes and decision-making.
* ability to gather requirements, iterate on solutions, and incorporate user feedback effectively.
* strategic thinking about how consistent business definitions enable reliable reporting and ai.

* competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
* career development programs and internal promotion pathways—we build from within

* comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

title: AI Engineer
description:
benefits: health insurance and paid time off (pto).

hi, i'm andreas. come build the new nu image® with us.

i'm the ceo of nu image®, and we're opening a new office in new jersey. i'm looking for an ai engineer to be a founding member of it, and yes, the desk next to mine is open.

here's the setup. we're building the next generation of our technology, and it's a small, tight core: you, working directly with our cto, with ai agents as the force multiplier. you'll own the ai engineering and the hands-on code development.

ai agents do most of the typing here. but make no mistake: you'll own the code, not just prompt it. you'll understand the architecture, read every line the agents write, and be able to debug and fix it by hand when they get it wrong. when something breaks in production, "the agent wrote it" isn't an answer. you are the builder, and the result is yours.

and here's the line i care about most: i don't want someone who waits to be told what to do. see a problem? fix it. see a better way? build it and show us. initiative is the job.

if you're the person at the meetup who can't stop talking about your agent setup, and you can also explain what's happening under the hood, keep reading.

who we are

- nu image® is a us telehealth company. founded in 2004, online since 2008.

- legitscript certified, serving all 50 states.

- we're opening a new office in the mahwah / wyckoff area of new jersey. this role is based there, in person.

- home page: https://nuimage.com

what you'll build (with our cto)

- a modern web platform and internal tools that people actually enjoy using.

- integrations and automation that connect systems and take busywork off people's plates.

- ai-powered workflows, plus the agent setups, guardrails and review steps that let a small core build like a much bigger one.

- secure, reliable, well-tested systems with healthcare-grade privacy and security baked in from day one.

what a week roughly looks like

no two weeks are the same, but expect a mix of:

- agents running in parallel on branches while you review diffs, push back on bad code, and write the tricky parts yourself.

- working through architecture and priorities with our cto, then turning them into shipped code.

- whiteboard sessions on new ideas, and turning the good ones into working prototypes.

- digging into a weird bug by hand: logs, queries, a debugger, and some stubbornness.

- spotting something nobody asked about (a slow query, a flaky job, a tool that would save us hours) and handling it.

- showing what shipped, what broke, and what you want to try next.

perks of the role (just for fun; these are about the job, not benefits)

- founding member of the nj office. you'll help shape how it works.

- first dibs on the whiteboard.

- you pick the office coffee machine. choose wisely.

- you get to name the agents.

- the ceo is one desk over, so your ideas get a fast yes or no.

- your ideas don't sit in a backlog for six months.

must-haves

ai (front and center)

- you ship with ai coding agents daily: cursor, the grok ecosystem (including grok bot), and similar tools. you have a setup, opinions, and receipts.

- you're current with today's ai tools and how they're changing month to month.

- you've built real agent workflows: task breakdown, parallel agents, prompt and agent orchestration, and review loops that catch bad output before it ships.

- you verify agent output: tests first, reading diffs line by line, and not trusting anything that just "looks right."

- you keep sensitive data (customer information, secrets, credentials) out of prompts, logs, and tools that aren't approved for it.

fundamentals (you own the result)

- you can build and debug it yourself, without ai, when needed. reading unfamiliar code, stepping through it, and fixing it by hand is normal for you.

- solid software architecture: you can explain why a system is shaped the way it is, and spot when an agent's design is going to hurt later.
