title: Capability Engineer – Next-Gen Pet Center Technologies
description:
**job description:**  
the capability engineer designs, builds and scales the next-generation technology backbone of royal canin’s rd pet centers – cameras and smart sensors, edge devices, local infrastructure of gpu servers and on-premise machine-learning models – so that every meal and every protocol generates reliable, decision-grade behavioural and intake data. based in lewisburg (rle), the role pilots and proves these technologies at rle, then leads their standardised scale-up to aimargues (rca) and, over time, to the wider mars pet center network. it takes ai-assisted observation (palatability, digestibility, welfare and food-safety/quality signals) from prototype to secure, cross-site operation, releasing associates from manual scoring and feeding harmonised datasets into monarch and then feed royal canin’s multi-modal predictive models. working with pet center operations at both sites, rd, digital/it, mgs services, mgs labs and external partners, the engineer makes rle the technology pilot site and ensures that what works there is replicated at rca, accelerating learning cycles and speed to market.
  
  
what are we looking for?
  
  
bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer or electrical engineering, computer science, data science, mechatronics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. training or certification in networking, server/infrastructure, edge or cloud computing, cybersecurity, ai/machine learning or project management is preferred.
  
  

* hands-on experience designing and deploying camera/video systems and iot sensors in operational environments (ip cameras, poe networks, video management, time synchronisation, lighting and placement).
* practical experience putting computer-vision/machine-learning models into production: python, a deep-learning framework (e.g. pytorch), containerisation (e.g. docker), model optimisation for gpu/edge (e.g. onnx, tensorrt) and validation using precision/recall-type metrics; familiarity with edge devices (e.g. nvidia jetson, raspberry pi) is an advantage.
* experience verifying and monitoring ml models in production: validation on held-out subjects and continuous data, drift detection, model and dataset versioning, retraining workflows and documentation of model performance over time.
* rapid prototyping mindset: builds working prototypes quickly, including with ai-assisted coding tools, and turns successful ones into maintainable, documented, scalable solutions; experience integrating or customising ml tooling (annotation, training, experiment tracking) is an advantage.
* working knowledge of server, storage and network infrastructure (linux/windows, gpu servers, virtualisation, backup, monitoring, tcp/ip, identity and access, firewalls and isolated/air-gapped designs) and cybersecurity fundamentals.
* data engineering skills: data pipelines, metadata models, data-quality checks and integration with data lakes or research data platforms.
* experience taking technology from pilot to multi-site scale: sizing, business cases, standardisation, vendor management, documentation, change management and user training; comfortable working across sites, cultures and time zones (us/europe).
* strong team player in cross-functional project teams: translates between scientists, animal-care operators, facilities and it; builds trust with end users, troubleshoots complex issues, analyses root causes and communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* experience in an rd, laboratory, animal-care, manufacturing or similarly regulated environment is preferred; exposure to animal-behaviour data or annotation/labelling tools is an advantage.

what will be your key responsibilities?
  
  

* own the cross-site next-gen pet center effectiveness technology roadmap: translate rd and operational needs (palatability/deference, digestibility, food safety/quality, welfare) at rle and rca into one phased technology architecture and deployment plan – pilot at rle, scale to rca; own each technology across its lifecycle – requirements, selection, implementation, validation, documentation and handover for scale-up, support upgrades, continuity and retirement.
* pilot at rle, then scale the camera and sensor network: specify, source, install and maintain cameras, connected scales, smart litter boxes, environmental and other iot sensors; prove a first fully instrumented prototype room at rle, extend to site-wide coverage (feeding stations, panel rooms, lodges gardens), then replicate the validated set-up at rca, adapted to local rooms, animals and constraints, with consistent placement, lighting, resolution and camera-zone calibration so models perform reliably at both sites.
* build and run the local compute platform: size, stand up and operate edge devices (e.g. nvidia jetson-class), on-premise gpu servers, storage, backup and networking – first at rle, then as a standard, replicable configuration at rca; start with an air-gapped environment for highly confidential data and move to governed connectivity (mars-approved networking, high-performance computing) as approvals allow. size infrastructure by separating model training/retraining from production inference, and real-time from batch processing.
* industrialise local machine-learning models: deploy, containerise and run computer-vision pipelines (e.g. object detection, segmentation/tracking and video-classification models) on local infrastructure, using standard ml frameworks and inference-optimisation tools (e.g. pytorch, onnx, tensorrt); validate them first on the rle animal population and then at rca, and fine-tune them for new breeds, rooms, sites and use cases with rd behaviour scientists and model developers.
* run the ml model verification programme so performance does not slip: own a verification and validation plan for every model in use – acceptance criteria agreed with rd before go-live (e.g. precision, recall, f1, false-positive rate by behaviour), independent testing on continuous video from the target room and site, and periodic re-verification against expert-coded samples from the ’expert validates’ step. monitor performance and data drift as the pet population changes (animal turnover, new breeds, ages, sizes, coat colours) and as rooms, feeders, cameras, lighting, diets and protocols change; define triggers for recalibration, retraining or rollback; version-control models, training data and thresholds under change control so every result is traceable to the model version that produced it; and re-verify before any roll-out to a new room or to rca.
* integrate and adapt shared ml tooling: integrate, configure and, where needed, modify the shared tools that the ml lifecycle depends on – annotation and labelling, dataset management, model training, experiment tracking and model registries (e.g. open-source annotation platforms, mlflow-type tools) – so researchers, model developers and pet center teams at both sites label, retrain and validate models on one common, governed toolset.
* prototype fast, then scale what works: write and ai-assisted-code local prototypes – apps, scripts, dashboards, data-capture tools and model pipelines (e.g. using github copilot-type coding assistants) – test them with pet center users, and once proven successful harden them into documented, supportable solutions, to scale them into facility operations at rle and rca in collaboration with vco it, mgs and dt teams, and link them to monarch.
* embed ai into pet center workflows: implement the ‘ai pre-codes, expert validates’ workflow (batch processing followed by expert review and correction in shared annotation tools), move associates from paper to tablet-based capture, and integrate new data-capture steps into palatability, digestibility and research protocols at both sites in line with the every meal matters philosophy – without compromising animal welfare or study integrity.
* work as one team with pet center, facilities and rd colleagues: co-define use cases, requirements and success criteria with pet center teams at rle and rca (managers, team leaders, animal-care, palatability/digestibility and welfare technicians, veterinarians) and involve them early in prototyping, testing and roll-out; partner with rd facilities colleagues (methodology expert, method engineer, operations and data technicians, pilot plant and site maintenance/operations) on installation, infrastructure, method integration and shared standards; work with rd scientists and project teams (palatability, digestibility, behaviour and welfare, nutrition, data science and monarch project team) to turn research questions into data-capture solutions and jointly validate model outputs; train and support end users, share progress and lessons learned, and give pet center and rd teams a clear voice in technology priorities.
* own the data pipeline and storage strategy: define retention, compression and edge-processing rules (store ai outputs and compressed video, retain high-quality source selectively for future use cases); structure metadata (site, trial, animal, diet, batch identifiers) and automate ingestion into monarch from both sites so behavioural data connect with pilot plant, rapid analytics (e.g. gc-ims) and pet outcomes for end-to-end prediction models.
* keep the environment reliable and secure: monitor device uptime, server health and storage growth at rle and rca; manage incidents including power-outage recovery; maintain cybersecurity and access control; engage and manage subcontractors for the maintenance of servers, networks, cameras and devices, with subcontracting approved by the site director to ensure reliability and budget compliance; coordinate regional it and mgs services for ongoing support and continuity plans.
* champion safety, compliance, animal welfare and privacy: design, install and operate every technology in line with site safety rules, quality and regulatory requirements, animal-welfare standards and data-privacy and responsible-ai policies; apply best practices and operational excellence – standard work, sops, change control, validation, documentation and continuous improvement – so solutions are safe, compliant and reliable in daily pet center operations.
* lead scale-up and cross-site harmonisation: package each validated rle pilot into a scale-up playbook (technical standards, bill of materials, installation and validation protocols, sops, training) and lead its deployment at rca with local pet center, it and mgs teams; align camera specifications, naming conventions, metadata and quality checks so rle and rca datasets are comparable, reusable for model training and cross-site studies, and ready for extension to the wider mars pet center network.
* drive business cases, partners and technology scouting: provide technical sizing and cost/benefit input to capex business cases for rle pilots and rca scale-up; manage vendors and partners (integrators, camera and hardware suppliers, academic and industrial model developers); scout and pilot emerging technologies (e.g. individual animal recognition, wearables, hyperspectral imaging) with clear benefits, risks and scale-up recommendations.
* live the five principles of mars: apply quality, responsibility, mutuality, efficiency and freedom in daily work – delivering solutions that pet center and rd teams can trust, taking ownership of outcomes, creating shared benefit for teams, pets and the business, using resources wisely, and innovating to shape the future of our pet centers.

what can you expect from mars?
  
  

* the opportunity to learn, develop and take charge of your own career.
* an industry competitive salary and benefits package.
* to be respected and valued.
* the five principles at the center of every decision we make.
* the opportunity to work cross functionally, add value and impact a better world for generations to come.

title: Engineer / Senior Engineer – AI Model Enablement & Software Tools
description:
**company:**
------------

qualcomm technologies, inc.

**job area:**
-------------

engineering group, engineering group > machine learning engineering

**general summary:**

as a leading technology innovator, qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what is possible to enable next-generation experiences and drive digital transformation, creating a smarter, connected future for all.

  
  

as an engineer / senior engineer in the qualcomm ai stack sdk software team, you will contribute to bringing modern ai models to snapdragon platforms using qualcomm’s ai software stack and model-enablement frameworks.

you will work with senior engineers to analyze, adapt, optimize, quantize, compile, and validate ai models, including large language models, vision models, vision-language models, and multimodal models. you will collaborate with ai research and ai accelerator hardware and software teams to understand model architectures, identify operator- and graph-level backend gaps, and integrate reusable solutions into qualcomm’s model-enablement frameworks and sdk.

  
  

this role combines ai/ml software development with graph processing, model optimization, systems software, and on-device execution. you will gain hands-on experience with model loading, graph adaptation, quantization, calibration, compilation, runtime integration, performance analysis, and debugging across software and hardware layers.

  
  

the role emphasizes strong programming fundamentals, hands-on implementation, problem-solving, and collaboration. engineers will work under the guidance of technical leads, while senior engineers will take greater ownership of feature design, implementation, debugging, and delivery.

**minimum qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or related field and 2+ years of hardware engineering, software engineering, systems engineering, or related work experience.

or
  
master's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or related field and 1+ year of hardware engineering, software engineering, systems engineering, or related work experience.
  
or
  
phd in computer science, engineering, information systems, or related field.

**responsibilities**
--------------------

* contribute to the bring-up and enablement of new language, vision, vision-language, and multimodal models on snapdragon platforms.

* study model implementations and computational graphs to understand model inputs, outputs, operators, tensor shapes, data flow, and execution behavior.

* work with ai research and backend teams to identify unsupported operators, graph patterns, precision constraints, and performance limitations.

* implement model re-authoring, operator decomposition, graph transformations, layout changes, and backend-specific adaptations.

* develop reusable model support that can be integrated into qualcomm’s model-enablement frameworks rather than creating isolated model-specific solutions.

the devices team is responsible for the creation and lifecycle management of iot devices enrolled in energyhub programs used to balance the power grid. the team plays a critical role in ensuring the scalability and flexibility of our future by creating a core platform that enables other internal teams to build new features and functionality quickly.

this is an opportunity to join a highly energized team of engineers eager to define and develop key concepts, solve complex challenges with real-world constraints and have a positive impact on our climate future. we are continuing our journey to migrate from a monolithic to a microservices architecture and deliver well defined apis to the broader organization. the primary focus is to integrate any distributed energy resource (der) into our platform in a way that enables multiple use cases without compromising quality and scalability.

as a senior engineer, you support our mission by helping drive major initiatives, providing expertise and guidance from past industry experience, and autonomously developing high-quality solutions that balance multiple constraints while ensuring long-term flexibility.

main responsibilities: what you'll do

* design and implement core platform features that solve for multiple constraints and use cases.
* help drive the transition from a monolithic architecture to a microservices-based approach, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and improved system resilience.
* lead technical initiatives and provide data modeling, contract definition, and api development.
* develop front and back end solutions, ensuring well-structured, high-quality code with automated testing.
* collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, internal engineering teams, and stakeholders to drive high-impact projects.
* work within real-world constraints to develop creative solutions that maintain platform flexibility and scalability.
* contribute to best practices for ci/cd, data modeling, and iterative development (e.g.,pocs, rapid prototyping, milestone-based execution).
* mentor and support other engineers, fostering a strong technical culture of respect, open communication, and collaboration.

required skills and experience: what you need

* 7+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* strong full-stack development experience, including frontend, backend, and relational database modeling and development.
* proficiency in react and java (preferably java 11+).
* experience with web services, grpc/restful apis, and contract-driven development.
* ability to operate independently, help provide technical vision and guide the team toward scalable solutions.
* strong problem-solving skills, capable of balancing multiple use cases while enabling flexibility.
* proven expertise in building dynamic, responsive user interfaces using react and typescript.
* demonstrated proficiency in leveraging ai tools in development and testing to accelerate delivery and enhance code quality.
* strong communication skills, with an emphasis on cross-functional collaboration and working on challenging technical problems.

preferred skills and experience: nice-to-haves

* experience with postgresql, asynchronous messaging (sns/sqs, rabbitmq), mongodb, aws, datadog, and robot framework.
* familiarity with ci/cd pipelines and modern software development practices.
* proven ability to deliver high-quality, iterative value while maintaining execution speed.
* experience or familiarity with energy industry

please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration-related support, is not available for this position at this time.

**why work for energyhub?**

* **collaborate with outstanding people:** our employees work hard, do great work, and enjoy collaborating and learning from each other.
* **make an immediate impact:** new employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. you are empowered to perform as soon as you join the team!
* **gain well rounded experience:** energyhub offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business.
* **work with the latest technologies:** you'll gain exposure to a broad spectrum of iot, saas and machine learning obstacles, including distributed fault-tolerance, device control optimization, and process modeling to support scalable interaction with disparate downstream apis.
* **be part of something important:** help create the future of how energy is produced and consumed. make a positive impact on our climate.

**about energyhub**

energyhub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. we help consumers turn their smart thermostats, evs, batteries, and other products into virtual power plants that keep the grid stable and enable higher penetration of solar and wind power.

to learn more, visit energyhub.com.

**company benefits**

energyhub offers a generous benefits package including 100% paid medical for employees and a 401(k) with employer match. we offer a casual environment, the flexibility to set your own schedule, a fully stocked fridge and pantry, free citi bike membership, secure bike rack, gym subsidy, paid parental leave, and an education assistance program.

**energyhub is an equal opportunity employer**

eoe, including disability/vets. reasonable accommodations are available for individuals with disabilities throughout the application process. if you are a person with a disability needing assistance with the application process, please contact accommodations.apply@energyhub.net.

title: Associate Data Scientist
description:
**job title:** associate data scientist

**reports to:** director of data strategy

**direct reports:** none

**department:** operations

**location:** remote to ar, az, ca, co, fl, ga, il, ma, md, mn, mo, nc, nm, nv, ny, or, pa, tn, tx, ut, or wa

**flsa status:** exempt/salary

**position status:** full-time

**work schedule:** monday - friday 8am - 5pm (pacific) - subject to change based on project assignments/deadlines and location (i.e., time zone)

**base salary range:** $85,000 - $95,000 (commensurate with experience)

**travel:** up to 5% of the time

**job summary**

the associate data scientist will play a key role in developing data-driven solutions that support strategic decision-making and operational efficiency. this position is ideal for someone with a strong foundation in statistics, machine learning, and data science, who is eager to apply these skills in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

the role involves working with structured and unstructured data to build predictive models, automate analytical workflows, and extract insights using techniques such as natural language processing, classification, regression, and clustering. the ideal candidate will be comfortable coding in python, c#, or powershell, and working with databases like microsoft sql server. curiosity, adaptability, and a passion for solving complex problems with data are essential.

**essential duties & responsibilities**

* contribute to the ongoing development and enhancement of our data science platform, including tools for predictive modeling, automation, and machine learning.
* build internal applications and processes that support statistical analysis, natural language processing, and data-driven decision-making across departments.
* develop and maintain data pipelines that support modeling and reporting, leveraging data from our business intelligence systems and external sources.
* ai/llm usage, distillation, and ablation to support corporate ai systems and productivity
* regular worksite attendance in accordance with company’s attendance policy is required for this position.
* other duties as assigned:
  + periodic special projects and duties may be assigned based on company need and requirements.
  + must be able to perform a variety of duties, often changing from one task to another, with frequent interruptions or distractions and within tight deadlines.

**qualifications**

**education / experience**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, data analytics, data science, mathematics, or similar from an accredited college or university is required.
* equivalent work experience, internships, or projects may be substituted for educational requirements.
* 2+ years of on-the-job experience in data analytics and/or data science preferred or an advanced degree equivalent.

**required skills**

* proficient usage of microsoft sql server for data extraction and transformation.
* proficient usage of python for machine learning, statistical modeling, and automation.
* familiarity with ide tools and markdown-based text editors (e.g., visual studio, vs code, notepad++, vim, or emacs).
* solid understanding of data analysis, feature engineering, and model evaluation techniques.
* proficient with version control systems such as git.
* excellent computer skills, including cli/shell interface use, gui navigation, and keyboard shortcuts.
* awareness of data integrity, security, and safe programming practices.
* proficient in microsoft office suite—word, excel, and outlook—with advanced excel skills.
* strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* collaborative team player who thrives in cross-functional environments.
* proactive, self-starter with a goal-oriented mindset and the ability to work independently.
* ability to communicate effectively while exercising diplomacy, sound judgment, and tact.
* ability to work effectively with co-workers, department managers, and external partners.
* ability to work flexible hours depending on departmental project deadlines and/or company events and sponsored programs.

**preferred skills**

* experience with microsoft powershell for automation and scripting.
* understanding of containerization tools like docker.
* familiarity with other object-oriented languages (e.g., c# or rust).
* exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., aws, azure, snowflake) for scalable data science workflows.
* working knowledge of linux environments.

**physical demands**

* **stationary position**: frequently remains stationary up to 50% of the time and sitting up to 8 hours per day
* **move/traverse**: infrequently bend, stand, stoop and/or walk
* **carry weight**: infrequently carry weight and/or lift objects (light to heavy) weighing up to 10 pounds
* **hearing and speech** frequently communicates with the ability to hear and talk on a regular basis with clients who have inquiries about their storage accounts, billing invoice or other related account matters; must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations

**about westport properties**

founded in 1985, westport properties (“wpi”) is an owner-operator of self storage, multifamily and industrial properties across the united states. the company is a fully integrated operator that develops, acquires and manages its portfolio as well as providing third-party management services. as of january 2025, wpi has over 17 million square feet of self storage space under management and its total assets under management is over $3 billion with its us storage centers brand as well as over 650 multifamily units while employing over 600 people nationwide. wpi is a founding partner of the 501(c)3 kure-it, a non-profit organization that raises money for underfunded cancer research, and charity storage, a 501(c)3 that uses vacant storage units to raise money for local charities. to date, kure-it has raised over $15m and charity storage has raised over $1.2m.

title: Sr Data Engineer
description:
**about karoo health**
======================

cardiovascular care is often the #1 cost for health plans and employers, with the current fee for service model incentivizing providers to maximize volume and throughput at the expense of clinical outcomes and patient satisfaction. karoo’s mission is to improve the lives of every cardiac patient in america by transforming the current care model to improve patient outcomes at significantly lower cost. karoo deploys a value-based approach which combines a blend of traditional, guideline-based medicine and state of the art digital tools to accomplish this important mission by enabling the conversion to, and success in, value-based care arrangements for cardiovascular networks, health systems and payers. karoo is backed by leading venture capitalists, including first trust capital partners and bip ventures, and has near and medium-term plans for further rounds.

**senior data engineer**
========================

job description

**overview**
============

**location:** pittsburgh preferred, or remote, u.s.-based

**type:** full-time technical role

**an industry defining company**
================================

karoo is a venture-backed startup, prior to series a, on a mission to transform cardiovascular care. our platform is designed to empower large provider groups and health systems to succeed in value-based care contracts with payers by improving patient outcomes and reducing cost of care through better coordination, analytics, and disease management. while our initial focus is cardiology, we are building a scalable operating system for managing complex conditions across the healthcare spectrum.

this is a rare opportunity to join a mission-driven founding team at a pivotal stage and help define the future of healthcare technology, with the power to improve the lives of patients with cardiovascular disease, the number one cause of death in america today.

**the role**
============

karoo health is seeking a skilled and dedicated developer to join our engineering team. as a software engineer at karoo health, you show a clear passion for quality and love to bring software to life. you are energized by the idea of building something new and want to work on problems that matter.

in order to do this job well, you must be a curious and eager problem solver with a hunger for building well-designed, high-quality solutions. you have a passion for great work and strive to produce simple solutions to complex problems. knowing there are always multiple answers to a problem, you know how to engage in a constructive dialogue to find the best path forward.

when applying, please include a description of why you’re interested in this role.

**what you'll do**
==================

* **design and architect data systems**: lead the design, construction, installation, and optimization of highly reliable, scalable, and secure data architecture.
* **design core healthcare data models:** own the design and evolution of foundational data models and schemas from the ground up, leveraging industry standards such as tuva, omop and fhir to translate clinical, operational, product, and reporting needs into scalable table structures, entities, and relationships.
* **develop data pipelines**: build and maintain complex, production-grade data pipelines that ingest, process, enrich and normalize large volumes of healthcare data ensuring consistency, usability, and data integrity across downstream applications.
* **data quality and governance**: establish and enforce data quality standards, monitoring, and validation processes to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data used for analytics.
* **performance optimization**: implement query tuning, indexing, and partitioning strategies to maximize the performance and efficiency of data processing systems and data retrieval.
* **cloud infrastructure**: design and deploy scalable, secure, cloud infrastructure leveraging infrastructure-as-code best practices.
* **safeguard data**: ensure strict compliance with healthcare data regulations (e.g., hipaa, hitrust) and implement data security best practices.
* **build and maintain emr integrations:** develop direct, bi-directional integrations with electronic medical record platforms.

**what we're looking for**
==========================

  

* deep, hands-on experience working with healthcare data, including healthcare data standards and common data models such as tuva, omop, or fhir.
* demonstrated experience designing core data models and schemas from scratch, including translating business, clinical, product, or user requirements into scalable data structures.
* experience mapping raw healthcare data into standardized healthcare data models, including resolving data quality, normalization, terminology, and structural inconsistencies.
* hands-on experience integrating directly with emr/ehr platforms, ideally including eclinicalworks, athenaone, epic, or comparable systems.
* experience with healthcare data regulations (e.g., hipaa, hitrust) and data formats (e.g. fhir)
* bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience
* minimum 5 years of dedicated professional experience in a data engineering role, preferably within a startup or fast-paced healthcare technology environment.
* expert proficiency in **sql** and at least one programming language used for data processing (**python** or scala).
* deep experience designing and managing **data warehouses** (e.g., snowflake, google bigquery, aws redshift) and experience with data lake technologies (e.g., s3, delta lake).
* demonstrated hands-on experience with **big data processing frameworks** like **apache spark** or dask.
* deep understanding of **cloud platforms (aws preferred)** and cloud-native development, including services like s3, lambda, and rds.
* hands-on experience with workflow orchestration tools such as **apache airflow** or aws step functions for managing data pipelines.
* expert knowledge of system architecture, scalability, and performance optimization for data systems.
* experience with test automation, ci/cd, and devops best practices for data deployments.
* ability to work independently and make high-impact technical decisions.
* must be legally authorized to work in the united states and not require employer sponsorship now or in the future

**why join us**
===============

* competitive salary and equity in an early-stage startup.
* opportunity to define the technical solution from the ground up
* possibly fully remote work environment with flexible hours
* health benefits, learning stipends, and professional development support
* a collaborative and transparent company culture that values creativity and ownership

**equal opportunity statement**
===============================

at karoo health inc (“karoo”), we believe that improving healthcare starts with creating a more equitable and inclusive world, both inside and outside our organization. we are committed to fostering a diverse workforce that reflects the communities we serve, and to building a culture where every team member feels valued, supported, and empowered. our commitment to inclusion is reflected in initiatives such as equitable compensation practices, employee resource groups, inclusive benefits, and more.

karoo health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. we maintain a strict policy of non-discrimination for all applicants and employees. what does that mean for you? it means that we are dedicated to providing a workplace that is inclusive, respectful, and free from discrimination or harassment of any kind.

employment decisions at karoo health are made based on merit, qualifications, and business need, without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. this policy applies to every aspect of the employment journey, from recruitment and hiring to compensation, benefits, training, promotion, performance evaluation, and beyond.

we’re committed to doing the right thing, always, and that includes creating a fair and inclusive hiring process and workplace for all.

**karoo health welcomes all.**
==============================

in the united states, compensation is determined by factors including location, role level, job-related skills, experience, and market conditions. some positions may also be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other benefits. to learn more about karoo health’s benefits, please contact our people team.

title: Senior Data Scientist - AI Engineer (Healthcare)
description:
job summary

we are seeking an **expert‑level data scientist** to lead state‑of‑the‑art research and develop advanced multimodal imaging models for our diagnostic intelligence platform. this role is designed for a senior practitioner with deep experience in medical imaging, radiology workflows, and machine learning research — someone capable of driving innovation from concept and academic rigor through to production‑grade deployment in clinical environments.

**responsibilities**

* lead ideation, research, and development of next‑generation models across ct, mri, x‑ray, ultrasound, and multimodal fusion architectures.
* architect and execute **deep academic‑level research**, including novel model designs, benchmarking, ablation studies, and scientific validation.
